examples.translation: 这部歌剧对于听觉和视觉都是一种享受。

examples.text: My foreign teacher came from Australia.
examples.translation: 我的外籍教师来自澳大利亚。

examples.text: Australia is the hometown of kangaroos.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚是袋鼠的故乡。

examples.text: Sydney is the largest city in Australia.
examples.translation: 悉尼是澳大利亚最大的城市。

examples.text: This book shows that he is an ingenious author.
examples.translation: 这本书表明他是一个有创造力的作家。

examples.text: The book was translated without the sanction of the author.
examples.translation: 这本书未经作者许可就给翻译了。

examples.text: Through them you can vicariously enter into the experience of the author, gaining a fresh, new perspective on the vastness of God's creation and the depths of the human spirit.
examples.translation: 透过书本，你会进入作者的心灵世界，对上帝广大的创造，和人类精神的层次有新的体认。

examples.text: The book is authored by six leading historians.
examples.translation: 这本书由六名权威的历史学家编写而成。

examples.text: He authored two best-sellers.
examples.translation: 他写过两部畅销书。

meanings.meaning: 权力；官方；当局；职权；权威

examples.text: The government is the highest authority in the country.
examples.translation: 政府是国家的最高权力机构。

examples.text: Authorities say the fires do look suspicious.
examples.translation: 官方表示，火灾看起来确实很奇怪。

examples.text: Both the authorities and the media wondered whether insider dealing had been going on.
examples.translation: 官方跟媒体都在怀疑这里面是不是存在内幕交易。

examples.text: The authorities did not interfere with us.
examples.translation: 当局不干涉我们。

examples.text: The new building must be financed by the local authority.
examples.translation: 新大楼的建筑资金必须由地方当局提供。

examples.text: These documents ensure to you the authority you need .
examples.translation: 这些文件使你获得你需要的职权。

examples.text: We see him as an authority on the subject.
examples.translation: 我们把他看作为这方面的权威。

examples.text: He made the best time in the auto race.
examples.translation: 他的汽车赛中开得最快。

examples.text: The auto industry has brought many people to Detroit.
examples.translation: 汽车工业把许多人吸引到了底特律。

examples.text: That auto company is coming out with several new models.
examples.translation: 那家汽车公司将把好几种新型号产品投入市场。

examples.text: The Detroit auto workers went out for higher pay.
examples.translation: 底特律的汽车工人为争取提高工资而罢工。

examples.text: Automation has obsoleted many unskilled workers.
examples.translation: 自动化使很多非技术工人受到淘汰。

examples.text: So is the case with industrial automation.
examples.translation: 在工业自动化方面，情况也一样。

examples.text: He huddled the children into the automobile.
examples.translation: 他急急忙忙地把孩子们推进汽车。

examples.text: We jacked the automobile in order to change a tire.
examples.translation: 我们用千斤顶把汽车托起换个轮胎。

examples.text: There will be an exhibition of the development of automobile industry in our country next week.
examples.translation: 下星期将举办一个关于我国汽车工业发展的展览。

examples.text: The cylinder is an important part for automobile engine.
examples.translation: 气缸套是影响汽车发动机性能的重要零件。

examples.text: The autumn or winter term start in September.
examples.translation: 秋季或冬季学期九月份开始。

examples.text: Autumn crops promised to be equally good.
examples.translation: 秋季作物看来收成也会同样很好。

examples.text: The chill of autumn is in the air.
examples.translation: 秋天的寒意到处感觉得到。

examples.text: I think autumn is the most beautiful season in a year.
examples.translation: 我认为秋天是一年中最美的季节。

examples.text: In Chinese, the classification of the auxiliary verb and the adverb always have dispute.
examples.translation: 摘要汉语中助动词和副词的分类一直有争议。

examples.text: We have an auxiliary generator in case of power cuts.
examples.translation: 我们有一台万一断电时使用的备用发电机。

examples.text: She is an auxiliary nurse.
examples.translation: 她是一名助理护士。

meanings.meaning: 可利用的；可得到的；有空的；有效的；【政】有资格的，适合的

examples.text: Do you have a room available?
examples.translation: 你们有空房间吗？

examples.text: The swimming pool is available only in summer.
examples.translation: 这个游泳池只在夏天开放。

examples.text: All sorts of lamps are available in that shop.
examples.translation: 在那家商店可买到各式各样的灯具。

examples.text: The Prime Minister was not available for comment.
examples.translation: 首相无暇作出评论。

examples.text: When will the plumber be available?
examples.translation: 管道工什么时候有空?

examples.text: This film ticket is no longer available.
examples.translation: 这张电影票不再有效。

examples.text: The round trip ticket is available for two months.
examples.translation: 返程票两个月有效。

examples.text: He stands on the corner of a wide avenue.
examples.translation: 他站在宽阔的林荫道的角落里。

examples.text: The avenue was crowded with people.
examples.translation: 大街上挤满了人。

examples.text: Hard work is a sure avenue to success.
examples.translation: 勤奋是可靠的成功之道。

examples.text: They exploded every avenue but could not find a solution.
examples.translation: 他们探索过各种途径，但是没有找到解决的办法。

meanings.meaning: 取平均值；达到平均水平

examples.text: The average of 4,6 and 8 is 6.
examples.translation: 4,6, 8的平均数是6。

examples.text: Temperatures are below average for the time of year.
examples.translation: 温度低于此时的年平均温度。

examples.text: The average age of the boys in this class is fifteen.
examples.translation: 本班男生的平均年龄是十五岁。

examples.text: Tom's work at school is above the average.
examples.translation: 汤姆的功课是中上等水平。

examples.text: He is an average man, there's nothing special about him.
examples.translation: 他是个普通人, 并没有什么异乎常人的地方。

examples.text: If you average 4, 6 and 11,you get 7 .
examples.translation: 如果你将4，6和11平均，你即得7。

examples.text: Meals average out at 5 per head.
examples.translation: 膳食平均每人5英镑。

examples.text: He devoted all his life to China's aviation.
examples.translation: 他的一生都奉献给了中国的航空事业。

examples.text: At that time aviation was still in its infancy.
examples.translation: 当时航空仍在萌芽阶段。

examples.text: Jets are a new development in aviation.
examples.translation: 喷气式飞机是航空事业上的一个新成就。

examples.text: In old China,there was hardly any machine- building industry,to say nothing of automobile and aviation industries.
examples.translation: 旧中国几乎没有机器制造业，更不用说汽车制造业和飞机制造业了。

meanings.meaning: 避免；逃避；[律]使无效；撤销

examples.text: You should avoid unnecessary repetition.
examples.translation: 你应避免不必要的重复。

examples.text: He'll grab at any excuse to avoid doing the dishes.
examples.translation: 他会随便找个借口来逃避洗碗。

examples.text: No one can avoid his own responsibility.
examples.translation: 没有人能够逃避自己的责任。

examples.text: We await your shipping instructions.
examples.translation: 我们等候你们的装船指示。

examples.text: I am awaiting their reply.
examples.translation: 我正在等待他们的答复。

examples.text: We eagerly await your early arrival.
examples.translation: 我们殷切地期待你早日光临。

examples.text: A warm welcome awaits you.
examples.translation: 你将受到热烈的欢迎。

examples.text: It was completely hopeless. They had to await their doom.
examples.translation: 希望已绝，他们只能坐以待毙了。

examples.text: It is impossible to honor her with the award.
examples.translation: 奖品授给她是不可能的。

examples.text: The child smiled at his teacher as he received the award.
examples.translation: 孩子接过奖品时朝老师微笑着。

examples.text: It is the highest award a producer can receive.
examples.translation: 这是一个制作人所能获得的最高奖项。

examples.text: Bill accepted the championship award on behalf of the team.
examples.translation: 比尔代表他的队接受了冠军奖。

examples.text: The university awarded him an honorary degree.
examples.translation: 这所大学授给他名誉学位。

examples.text: The champion was awarded the gold medal.
examples.translation: 冠军被授予了金牌。

examples.text: She has been awarded first prize four years in succession.
examples.translation: 她已连续四年获得一等奖。

examples.text: The judge awarded costs to the defendant.
examples.translation: 法官判由原告向被告支付诉讼费。

examples.text: Custody of the children was awarded to the mother.
examples.translation: 儿童的监护权已判给母亲。

examples.text: If you were aware of all that, you would change your mind.
examples.translation: 如果你知道了那一切,你会改变主意的。

examples.text: Then he became aware that they were regarding him with interest.
examples.translation: 这时,他意识到他们都在饶有兴趣地看着他。

meanings.meaning: 离开；远离；在远处；一直；朝另一个方向；消失
不在的；遥远的；[棒]出局的；客场的

examples.text: He lives 3 miles away from here.
examples.translation: 他住在距离这里三英里的地方。

examples.text: I hope to get away early in the morning.
examples.translation: 我希望一早就动身离开。

examples.text: He lives in retirement, away from everyone.
examples.translation: 他远离大家隐居着。

examples.text: I tried to keep the child away from the pool.
examples.translation: 我设法使孩子远离水池。

examples.text: We stand on the top of the dam, casting our eyes far away.
examples.translation: 我们站在大坝的顶上往远处看。

examples.text: The baby is sleeping away quietly.
examples.translation: 那婴儿一直安静地睡着。

examples.text: I found him working away in his office.
examples.translation: 我发现他一直不停地在办公室里工作。

examples.text: She looked away as peach flooded her cheeks.
examples.translation: 她双颊泛出红晕,视线转向别处。

examples.text: The radiance of the sunset died away.
examples.translation: 夕阳的余辉渐渐地消失了。

examples.text: The sound fainted away in the distance.
examples.translation: 声音在远处渐渐消失了。

examples.text: The neighbors are away.
examples.translation: 邻居不在家。

examples.text: The city is miles away.
examples.translation: 这个城市在几英里之外。

examples.text: The count is three and two with two away in the seventh.
examples.translation: 现在是第七局，两好球三坏球，两人出局。

examples.text: They lost all their away matches.
examples.translation: 他们输了所有的客场比赛。

meanings.meaning: 非常地；极端地；令人嫌恶地

examples.text: It is awfully boring.
examples.translation: 太叫人厌烦了。

examples.text: I am awfully sorry to wake you up.
examples.translation: 非常抱歉，把你闹醒了。

examples.text: This tin-opener is awfully fiddly.
examples.translation: 这把罐头刀很不好使。

examples.text: It seems to me an awfully selfish way of looking at things.
examples.translation: 在我看来，这是极端可怕的自私自利的看法。

meanings.meaning: 尴尬的；笨拙的；（设计）别扭的

examples.text: It's a little awkward, because he's my friend but I'm still his boss.
examples.translation: 他是我朋友,而我又是他老板,这真有点尴尬。

examples.text: He felt awkward and uncomfortable.
examples.translation: 他感到尴尬和不舒服。

examples.text: He seemed as awkward and rough as ever.
examples.translation: 他跟从前一样拙笨和粗鲁。

examples.text: The handle of this teapot has an awkward shape.
examples.translation: 这茶壶把儿的形状真别扭。

examples.text: The heavy ax was awkward to use.
examples.translation: 这把重斧头不好用。

examples.text: He hacked the box apart with the ax.
examples.translation: 他用斧头把盒子劈开。

examples.text: The man cleft a block of wood in two with an ax.
examples.translation: 那人用斧头把一块木头劈成两半。

examples.text: My colleague got the ax yesterday.
examples.translation: 我的同事昨天被解雇了

examples.text: Five hundred jobs were axed as a result of government spending cuts.
examples.translation: 由于政府缩减经费的缘故，有五百人被突然解雇了。

examples.text: After several months the project was axed by the government.
examples.translation: 数月後政府中止了该项工程。

examples.text: The earth turns (ie rotates) on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.translation: 地球每24小时自转一圈。

examples.text: A wheel revolves round/on its axis.
examples.translation: 轮子是绕轴旋转的。

examples.text: The earth's axis is the line between the North and South Poles.
examples.translation: 地轴是南北极之间的线。

examples.text: The axis of a circle is its diameter.
examples.translation: 圆的轴线是其直径。

meanings.meaning: 婴儿；宝贝儿；孩子气的人

examples.text: She gave birth to a fine healthy baby.
examples.translation: 她生了一个健康漂亮的婴儿。

examples.text: The mother rocked the baby to sleep in its cradle.
examples.translation: 母亲摇动摇篮使婴儿入睡。

examples.text: We've turned the smallest bedroom into a nursery for our new baby.
examples.translation: 我们已将最小的那间卧室改成新生婴儿的幼儿室。

examples.text: Baby, come on, let's go home, I'm tired.
examples.translation: 宝贝儿，快点儿，我们回家吧，我累了。

examples.text: Don't be such a baby.
examples.translation: 别那么孩子气。

examples.text: Since 2001, organic baby food sales have jumped 63%.
examples.translation: 从2001年以来,有机婴儿食品销售额已上升63%25。

examples.text: Don't baby the boy.
examples.translation: 别惯这孩子。

meanings.meaning: 后面；背脊；靠背；后背；后卫
向后的；后面的；偏远的；过时的；积欠的

examples.text: Three people can sit in the back of this car.
examples.translation: 这车的后座可坐3个人。

examples.text: It encouraged him to talk because his back had stiffened in the night and it hurt truly now.
examples.translation: 他靠说话来鼓劲,因为他的背脊在夜里变得僵直,眼下真痛得厉害。

examples.text: You'll make your back ache if you carry those heavy buckets.
examples.translation: 如果你背那些沉重的桶，你的背会痛的。

examples.text: John plays back in the team.
examples.translation: 约翰在这个队打后卫。

examples.text: I'll back you up no matter what's happening.
examples.translation: 不论发生什么事,我都会支持你。

examples.text: I found no evidence to back your interpretation.
examples.translation: 我找不到证据来支持你的解释。

examples.text: You'll have to back the car up into the garage.
examples.translation: 你得倒车，开进车库。

examples.text: He refused to back away from his position.
examples.translation: 他拒绝放弃自己的立场。

examples.text: Stand back! You're stepping on my toes.
examples.translation: 向后站！你踩在我的脚趾头上了。

examples.text: The kangaroo uses its back legs to jump.
examples.translation: 袋鼠是用牠的后脚在跳。

examples.text: I bought some back issues of science magazines yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天我买了几本过期的科学杂志。

examples.text: He has a strong political background.
examples.translation: 他有强大的政治背景。

examples.text: It is wrong to differentiate between people according to their family background.
examples.translation: 根据出身不同而区别待人是不对的。

examples.text: With my working-class background I feel like a fish out of water among these high-society people.
examples.translation: 我出身于工人阶级,在上流社会中感到很不自在。

examples.text: Her marketing background made her a natural choice for the job.
examples.translation: 她的经销经历使她成为这一职位的必然人选。

examples.text: He stayed in the background to escape from the public attention.
examples.translation: 他呆在幕后为了避开公众的注意。

examples.text: He took a picture of me with the pavilion in the background.
examples.translation: 他以那个亭子为背景给我照了一张相片。

examples.text: He took a backward step and ran away.
examples.translation: 他向后退了一步,跑了。

examples.text: This part of the country is still backward.
examples.translation: 这个国家的这个地区仍很落后。

examples.text: Although he is clever, he is backward in giving his views.
examples.translation: 他虽然很聪明，却不善发表他的意见。

examples.text: He looked backward over his shoulder.
examples.translation: 他回头向后看。

examples.text: He stepped backward and fell over the cliff.
examples.translation: 他向后退了一步就从悬崖上掉下去了。

examples.text: Many diseases are caused by bacteria.
examples.translation: 许多疾病是由细菌引起的。

examples.text: Bacteria are too small to see with the naked eye.
examples.translation: 细菌太小，肉眼看不见。

examples.text: It is possible to multiply bacteria and other living organisms in the laboratory.
examples.translation: 在实验室能够繁殖细菌和其他生物。

examples.text: I like to play badminton in my spare time.
examples.translation: 我喜欢在闲暇时打羽毛球。

examples.text: He went to the badminton club at times during his school days.
examples.translation: 他上学时有时到羽毛球俱乐部去。

examples.text: He's in his element when playing badminton.
examples.translation: 他打起羽毛球来真是得心应手。

examples.text: He plays tennis better than badminton.
examples.translation: 他网球比羽毛球打得好。

examples.text: I played badminton with my friends.
examples.translation: 我和朋友打了羽毛球。

examples.text: We go to play badminton in the nearest gym every Sunday.
examples.translation: 每个星期天我们都去最近的体育馆打羽毛球。

meanings.meaning: 把 ... 装进袋子；使膨胀；猎杀

examples.text: He lost his travelling bag when he crossed the desert.
examples.translation: 他在穿越沙漠的时候丢失了他的旅行袋。

examples.text: The boxer's fist thumped into the punching bag.
examples.translation: 拳师猛击吊袋。

examples.text: He put his bag on the luggage rack.
examples.translation: 他把包放在行李架上。

examples.text: The cat had not been fed for weeks and was just a bag of bones.
examples.translation: 那只猫已有几个星期没喂食了，简直成了皮包骨。

examples.text: He brought me a bag of almond paste.
examples.translation: 他给我带来一袋杏仁软糖。

examples.text: They bagged the potatoes to sell them.
examples.translation: 他们把土豆装入袋中出售。

examples.text: A stiff breeze made the sails bag out.
examples.translation: 一股劲风吹得船帆鼓了出来。

examples.text: Let me put your baggage in the trunk.
examples.translation: 我来把你的行李放在汽车后部的行李箱内。

examples.text: Our baggage has cleared customs.
examples.translation: 我们的行李已通过海关检查。

examples.text: The bread is baking in the oven.
examples.translation: 烤箱里正在烤面包。

examples.text: I will bake Tracy several buns now.
examples.translation: 我现在要为特蕾西烤几个小面包。

examples.text: We bake bread and cake in an oven.
examples.translation: 我们用烤箱烘面包与糕点。

examples.text: In some places, bricks are still baked in the sun.
examples.translation: 有些地方仍使用在太阳下晒干砖块的方法。

meanings.meaning: 平衡；天平；平静；结余；差额；调和；制衡
权衡；使平衡；抵消；称重量

examples.text: The girl lost her balance and fell off the balance beam.
examples.translation: 小女孩失去了平衡，从平衡木上摔了下来。

examples.text: Great care must be taken in the use of the balance.
examples.translation: 这种天平使用时必须十分当心。

examples.text: He used a very sensitive torsion balance.
examples.translation: 他利用了一架非常灵敏的扭力天平。

examples.text: Sunday is a great time to balance out whatever area of your life has felt disordered as of late.
examples.translation: 星期天是你最近动荡不安的生活得到平静的大好时机。

examples.text: We need to maintain some semblance of balance and some sense that we are steering the ship of our life.
examples.translation: 我们需要保持平静的外表，和一种我们掌握了我们的生活之舟的意识。

examples.text: Kindly remit us the balance without delay .
examples.translation: 请立即把余额汇给我们。

examples.text: In other words, the balance of trade may deteriorate rather than improve.
examples.translation: 换句话说,国际贸易差额不但不会改善,反而可能会恶化。

examples.text: The balance of the shade and the sun on the tree-trunks and on the ground is beautiful beyond words.
examples.translation: 射在树干与地面上的阳光和树荫，其色彩之调和，真是美得难以形容。

examples.text: EBN is balance in Yin and Yang, sweet and mild, making it a surprisingly pleasant medicinal food.
examples.translation: 燕窝的特质是阴阳调和，带甜温和，使到其成为人们喜欢享用的保健品。

examples.text: The balance of terror has replaced the balance of power.
examples.translation: 恐惧的制衡已经取代了强权的制衡。

examples.text: Locke's ideas on the power balance are still inspiring in modem societies.
examples.translation: 洛克权力制衡思想对现代社会仍然具有启发意义。

examples.text: You have to balance the advantages of living in a big city against the disadvantages.
examples.translation: 你必须权衡住在大城市的利与弊。

examples.text: This year's profits will balance our previous losses.
examples.translation: 本年度的盈利将与上一年度的亏损相抵。

examples.text: The dancer could balance on one toe.
examples.translation: 舞蹈演员可以用一个脚趾平衡。

examples.text: The aviator warped a wing tip to regain balance.
examples.translation: 飞行员使一机翼的端部翘起,以恢复平衡。

meanings.meaning: 球；球状物；炮弹；舞会；愉快的经历；胆量；胡说；（复）睾丸

examples.text: The cat made little rushes to and fro after the ball.
examples.translation: 猫追着球跑过来跑过去。

examples.text: She rolled the socks into a ball.
examples.translation: 她把袜子卷成一团。

examples.text: I cut up the meat for cooking meat balls.
examples.translation: 我把肉剁碎后做肉丸子。

examples.text: His left arm was shattered into matches by a cannon ball.
examples.translation: 他的左臂被一炮弹击碎。

examples.text: How did you enjoy the ball?
examples.translation: 你们在舞会上玩得高兴吗？

examples.text: Tom said he had a real ball at the beach last week.
examples.translation: 汤姆说上个星期他在海滨度过了非常愉快的时光。

examples.text: She balled the letter into a wad.
examples.translation: 她将信揉成一团。

meanings.meaning: 乘气球飞行；激增；如气球般膨胀

examples.text: A balloon floated across the sky.
examples.translation: 有个气球从空中飘过。

examples.text: He balloons his cheeks when he is hesitant.
examples.translation: 他迟疑不决时会鼓起双颊。

examples.text: He tried to balloon around the earth but storms forced him to land in China.
examples.translation: 他试图乘气球做环球旅行，但风暴迫使他降落在中国。

examples.text: Our expenses had ballooned.
examples.translation: 我们的开销大大增加了。

examples.text: Her skirt ballooned in the wind.
examples.translation: 她的裙子让风吹得鼓起来了。

examples.text: The banana is her favorite fruit.
examples.translation: 香蕉是她最喜欢的水果。

examples.text: A banana is mainly pulp, except for its skin.
examples.translation: 香蕉除了果皮之外，主要是果肉。

examples.text: I gave Mary an apple in exchange for my favorite banana.
examples.translation: 我送给玛丽一个苹果换我最喜欢吃的香蕉。

examples.text: Banana, grape, apple, daisy which of these is the odd one out?
examples.translation: 香蕉、葡萄、苹果、雏菊－－这几样东西哪一样与众不同？

examples.text: The proposed tax changes are likely to prove a banana skin for the Government.
examples.translation: 建议中的税务变动很可能给政府带来无穷后患。

examples.text: The band played a lively tune.
examples.translation: 乐队演奏了一支轻快的乐曲。

examples.text: The brass band is banging away in the park.
examples.translation: 铜管乐队在公园里吹吹打打。

examples.text: They are a teenager band made up of four cool boys.
examples.translation: 他们是一支由四名酷哥组成的少年演唱队。

examples.text: A band of robbers held up the train.
examples.translation: 一群强盗抢劫了火车。

examples.text: She used a rubber band to tie her hair.
examples.translation: 她用一根橡皮筋扎头发。

examples.text: In the band of his hat his half-ticket was stuck.
examples.translation: 他的半价车票插在他的帽箍上。

examples.text: She snapped a rubber band deftly around a roll of bills.
examples.translation: 她熟练地把橡皮筋往一卷钞票上一箍。

examples.text: Radio2 can be heard on the long wave band.
examples.translation: 第二广播电台可在长波段收听到。

examples.text: This band combination provides the best delineation between vegetation types.
examples.translation: 这种波段融合提供最好的植物类型差异区分。

examples.text: The children banded together to buy a present for their teacher.
examples.translation: 孩子们合起来为他们的老师买了一件礼物。

examples.text: We band ourselves closely against the invaders.
examples.translation: 我们紧密地团结起来抗击入侵者。

meanings.meaning: 重击；大声敲；剪成刘海；突然巨响

examples.text: The door shut with a bang.
examples.translation: 门砰的一声关上了。

examples.text: He was awakened by a terrific bang.
examples.translation: 一声巨响把他从睡梦中惊醒。

examples.text: He fell and got a nasty bang on the head.
examples.translation: 他跌了一跤，头部磕得很重。

examples.text: She is keeping a long bang.
examples.translation: 她现在是留着长刘海。

examples.text: He fell and banged his knee.
examples.translation: 他跌倒了，膝盖重重撞了一下。

examples.text: I banged my elbow on the corner of the table.
examples.translation: 我的胳膊肘撞著桌子角了。

examples.text: He banged his fist on the table to emphasize his argument.
examples.translation: 他用拳头敲着桌子为自己的辩驳助威。

examples.text: The fireworks banged impressively.
examples.translation: 烟火响声震天。

examples.text: The light went out bang in the middle of the performance.
examples.translation: 表演正好进行到一半时停电了。

examples.text: The arrow hit bang on the target.
examples.translation: 箭正中靶心

meanings.meaning: 用横幅装饰；以大标题报道

examples.text: Can you read that banner from this distance?
examples.translation: 从这里你能看清那个横幅标语吗?

examples.text: Do not use excessive banner advertisements.
examples.translation: 不要使用过多的横幅广告。

examples.text: The banner lent color to the streets.
examples.translation: 旗帜给街道增添了色彩。

examples.text: The patriots fought under the banner of freedom.
examples.translation: 爱国者在自由的旗帜下战斗。

examples.text: They headed my report with a banner.
examples.translation: 他们把我的报道加了个通栏大标题。

examples.text: This year is a banner year for crops.
examples.translation: 今年是个丰年。

examples.text: This is a banner year for the sales department.
examples.translation: 这对销售部门而言是极好的一年。

examples.text: The report was bannered by the People's Daily.
examples.translation: 《人民日报》用横贯全页的大标题形式进行了报道。

meanings.meaning: 禁止；阻挠；闩上；在 ... 设栅栏

examples.text: There are several bars in the hotel.
examples.translation: 这家旅馆里有好几个酒吧。

examples.text: A bar of chocolate is enough to stop his crying.
examples.translation: 一条巧克力就可以让他不哭了。

examples.text: There's a strong bar on the door.
examples.translation: 门上有一个很坚固的闩。

examples.text: There is a burning man hovering in the air over a grille in the Smoldering Corpse Bar.
examples.translation: 有一个焚烧中的人，飘浮在冒烟尸体酒吧的铁栅上方。

examples.text: After the bombing, the whole area was barred to the public.
examples.translation: 轰炸后，整个地区禁止公众通行。

examples.text: The members voted to bar women from the club.
examples.translation: 会员表决不让妇女加入该俱乐部。

examples.text: I will bar no honest man to my house.
examples.translation: 我不会阻止任何诚实的人到我家里来。

examples.text: The barber thinned out my thick hair.
examples.translation: 理发师把我浓密的头发削薄了一些。

examples.text: His father apprenticed him to a barber.
examples.translation: 他父亲送他去当理发师的徒弟。

examples.text: The barber bought one of his brooms, and, when he had shaved him, asked for the price of it.
examples.translation: 当理发师给他修完面后，问了一下扫帚的价钱。

examples.text: They sat in twos and threes on the trim barbered lawn.
examples.translation: 他们三三两两地坐在修剪平整的草坪上。

meanings.meaning: 赤裸的；空的；仅有的；贫瘠的，荒芜的

examples.text: The fierce sun parched the bare earth.
examples.translation: 灼热的阳光炙烤着光秃秃的大地。

examples.text: The boy likes to walk on the sand with bare feet.
examples.translation: 这男孩喜欢赤脚在沙滩上走。

examples.text: The little room was almost bare of furniture.
examples.translation: 这个小房间几乎没有什么家俱。

examples.text: A bare word would be enough for me.
examples.translation: 对我来说一句话就够了。

examples.text: He bared his head.
examples.translation: 他脱掉了帽子。

examples.text: The dog bared its teeth.
examples.translation: 狗露出了牙齿。

examples.text: He bared his heart to the girl.
examples.translation: 他向这个女孩吐露自己的真情。

meanings.meaning: 讨价还价；议价；(谈价钱后)卖

examples.text: He made a satisfactory bargain with them.
examples.translation: 他和他们做了一笔满意的交易。

examples.text: If you promote our goods, we will give you a good discount as our part of the bargain.
examples.translation: 若你方经销我们的货物，我方愿给予你相当大的优惠作为回报。

examples.text: She knows a bargain when she sees one.
examples.translation: 她有辨别便宜货的能力。

examples.text: There never was a better bargain driver.
examples.translation: 再没有比这更美好的契约。

examples.text: They sealed their bargain by shaking hands.
examples.translation: 他们握手表示确认交易契约。

examples.text: The salesman refused to bargain over the price.
examples.translation: 推销员拒绝讨价还价。

examples.text: Bargain like a gypsy,but pay like a gentleman.
examples.translation: 议价时斤斤计较，付帐时爽快利落。

examples.text: The leaders bargained away the freedom of their people.
examples.translation: 领导人拿人民的自由来做交易。

examples.text: The dog barked when the stranger came near.
examples.translation: 当陌生人走近时，狗叫了起来。

examples.text: An old dog does not bark for nothing.
examples.translation: 老狗不会无事而吠。

examples.text: When you speak to people, don't bark at them.
examples.translation: 当你和人说话时不要咆哮。

examples.text: Some officers bark out their orders.
examples.translation: 有些军官以粗暴的声音发布命令。

examples.text: He barked his elbow on the wall.
examples.translation: 他碰到墙上，肘部擦破了皮。

examples.text: Those trees have very beautiful white bark.
examples.translation: 那些树长着非常漂亮的白色树皮。

examples.text: The bark of plane trees peels off regularly.
examples.translation: 悬铃木的树皮到时候就脱落。

examples.text: We found that birch bark could serve as paper.
examples.translation: 我们发现桦树皮可以作纸用。

meanings.meaning: 谷仓；牲口棚；车库；大而空荡的农屋

examples.text: The barn will store five tons of grain.
examples.translation: 这个谷仓能放五吨粮食。

examples.text: We took shelter from the storm in a barn.
examples.translation: 我们在一个谷仓里躲避暴风雨。

examples.text: The cows were feeding on hay in the barn.
examples.translation: 母牛正在牲口棚里吃乾草呢。

examples.text: Another barn has been built there.
examples.translation: 另一个牲口棚建在那儿。

examples.text: They adapted the barn for use as a garage.
examples.translation: 他们改建谷仓供做车库之用。

meanings.meaning: 桶；枪管；一桶的量；炮管；大量；笔管；汽油桶

examples.text: Beer swilled around the bottom of the barrel.
examples.translation: 啤酒在桶底晃荡。

examples.text: The beer comes out of the barrel under pressure.
examples.translation: 啤酒受到压力从桶中流出。

examples.text: This barrel contains 50 litres.
examples.translation: 这个桶容量为50升。

examples.text: He made a barrel with staves by himself.
examples.translation: 他自己用桶板做了一只桶。

examples.text: He emptied out the water barrel to clear it of sediment.
examples.translation: 他把水桶倒空以清掉桶底的沉淀物。

examples.text: It will be adaptable to three separate barrel lengths for varying mission requirements.
examples.translation: 它将能够适用三种各自独立的枪管长度来应对不同的任务需求。

examples.text: He bought twenty five barrel of wine.
examples.translation: 他买了25桶葡萄酒。

examples.text: It boasts plenty of brightly coloured sea fans, soft corals and barrel sponges.
examples.translation: 它拥有大量的色彩鲜艳的海上球迷，软珊瑚和海绵桶。

examples.text: They planned to barrel the beer next Monday.
examples.translation: 他们打算下星期一把啤酒装桶。

examples.text: The ice skater rammed into the barrier.
examples.translation: 溜冰者撞到护栏上了。

examples.text: Heavy duties on imports and exports are a barrier to international trade.
examples.translation: 进出口的高关税是国际贸易的障碍。

examples.text: The Sahara Desert is a natural barrier between north and central Africa.
examples.translation: 撒哈拉沙漠是北非与中非之间的天然屏障。

meanings.meaning: 底部；基地；基础；基数；基线；(棒球)垒；[化]碱

examples.text: I found a small leaf at the base of the flower.
examples.translation: 我在那朵花的底部发现一片小叶。

examples.text: Our mission was over, and went back to our base.
examples.translation: 我们的任务结束了,我们返回了基地。

examples.text: Many languages have Latin as their base.
examples.translation: 许多语言都以拉丁语为基础。

examples.text: One billion new consumers will double the existing consumer base within the next decade.
examples.translation: 未来10年内全球将新增10亿消费者,消费者基数将较现在增加一倍。

examples.text: The base line can be set out as a single or double chain.
examples.translation: 基线可作为一条单链系或双链系。

examples.text: The line spacing is the vertical distance between the base lines of two consecutive lines of text.
examples.translation: 行距是两个连续文本行的基线之间的垂直距离。

examples.text: I got two on the first base foul line.
examples.translation: 我有两张垒界外线旁的座位票。

examples.text: He didn't make it past first base.
examples.translation: 他未能跑过一垒。

examples.text: A base is the hydroxide of a metal.
examples.translation: 碱是金属的氢氧化物。

examples.text: This novel is based on historical facts.
examples.translation: 这部小说是以历史事实为根据的。

examples.text: To betray a friend is a base action.
examples.translation: 背叛朋友是卑劣的行为。

meanings.meaning: 基本的；基础的；初级的；含硅少的

examples.text: The family is the basic unit of society.
examples.translation: 家庭是社会的基本单位。

examples.text: The right to work is a basic right of the citizens.
examples.translation: 劳动权是公民的一项基本权利。

examples.text: Food, clothing and shelter are all basic necessities of life.
examples.translation: 衣、 食、 住所是生活的基本必需品。

examples.text: Basic research is of great importance in all scientific fields.
examples.translation: 在各个科学领域里,基础研究是非常重要的。

examples.text: We should give priority to the development of the basic industries.
examples.translation: 我们要优先发展基础工业。

examples.text: All the people can be accessible to basic health care services in the future.
examples.translation: 在将来能实现人人享有初级卫生保健服务。

examples.text: His research formed the basic of his new book.
examples.translation: 他的研究成果构成了这本新书的基础。

examples.text: BASIC is the language most programmers learn first.
examples.translation: BASIC是大多数程序编制者首先学习的语言。

examples.text: So we are basically, in agreement on that agenda.
examples.translation: 那么在日程问题上，我们基本上意见一致了。

examples.text: It's basically a slugfest with his units.
examples.translation: 基本上说这将会是一场激斗。

examples.text: There are many techniques but basically you use your heart and your solar plexus chakra for this.
examples.translation: 有许多技术，但是主要地为这个你们使用你们的心和你们的太阳丛脉轮。

examples.text: This basin is made of iron.
examples.translation: 这个盆子是铁做的。

examples.text: He washed his hands in a basin.
examples.translation: 他在盆里洗了手。

examples.text: He first poured some water in the basin.
examples.translation: 他先在脸盆里倒了一些水。

examples.text: Wenshui lies in the west of Taiyuan Basin.
examples.translation: 文水位于太原盆地以西。

examples.text: The whole river basin is covered with tropical forest.
examples.translation: 热带森林覆盖了整个河流流域。

examples.text: If Iris is right, I just need to dip the necklace in the basin.
examples.translation: 假如伊莉丝是对的，我需要将项链浸在水池里。

examples.text: His research formed the basis of his new book.
examples.translation: 他的研究成果是他这本新书的基础。

examples.text: We drew this conclusion on the basis of experiments.
examples.translation: 我们是在试验的基础上得出这个结论的。

examples.text: What basis do you have for saying that?
examples.translation: 你那样说有什么根据啊?

examples.text: Rates of work are calculated on a weekly basis.
examples.translation: 工资是以周为计算基准的.

examples.text: This country's heavy industry rests on a broad and firm base.
examples.translation: 这个国家的重工业有广泛坚实的底子。

meanings.meaning: 篮；篓；筐；[篮]球篮；投篮得分

examples.text: Several baskets of fruit were eaten at the party.
examples.translation: 宴会上，大家吃掉了好几篮水果。

examples.text: The little girl stared at the little cats tumbling over each other in their basket.
examples.translation: 小女孩凝视着在篮子里互相翻来滚去的小猫。

examples.text: Put the scraps of paper in the wastepaper basket.
examples.translation: 把纸屑丢进废纸篓。

examples.text: There are just a few apples in the basket.
examples.translation: 筐里只剩下有数几个苹果了。

examples.text: He had put up a basket on a pole in the back yard.
examples.translation: 他在后院一根柱子上安一个球篮。

examples.text: He made 48 baskets in the game last night.
examples.translation: 他在昨晚的比赛中独得了48分。

examples.text: We will play basketball tomorrow.
examples.translation: 我们明天打篮球。

examples.text: The basketball players are working out at the gym.
examples.translation: 篮球运动员们正在体育馆进行训练。

examples.text: We are going to play neither basketball nor volleyball.
examples.translation: 我们既不将打篮球也不将打排球。

examples.text: He just tipped the ball with his bat.
examples.translation: 他只是用球棒擦击来球。

examples.text: The other boys coveted his new bat.
examples.translation: 其他的男孩都想得到他的新球棒。

examples.text: I want to buy a new tennis bat.
examples.translation: 我想要买一个新网球拍。

examples.text: The bat together with the balls was stolen.
examples.translation: 球拍和球全被偷了。

examples.text: Bats fly at night and feed on insects.
examples.translation: 蝙蝠在夜间飞行，以昆虫为食。

examples.text: Green batted for two hours on the playground.
examples.translation: 格林在赛场上执棒两小时。

examples.text: The cat batted the balloon with its paws.
examples.translation: 猫用爪子击打气球。

examples.text: He was trying to bat the flies away with his newspaper.
examples.translation: 他想用报纸把苍蝇打跑。

examples.text: I'll be a big farmer before you can bat an eye!
examples.translation: 他说你只要眨眨眼，我就马上变成一个富裕的庄稼人！

examples.text: He heard the bad news without batting an eyelid.
examples.translation: 他听到这个坏的消息丝毫没动声色(没贬眼睛)。

examples.text: He takes a cold bath every day.
examples.translation: 他每天洗一个冷水澡。

examples.text: The idea came to him in his bath.
examples.translation: 他洗澡时想出了这个主意。

examples.text: I want a double room with a bath.
examples.translation: 我要一间有浴室的双人房。

examples.text: After the bath, he took a walk in the yard.
examples.translation: 沐浴后，他在院子里散步。

examples.text: The children like to have bubbles in their bath.
examples.translation: 孩子们喜欢浴盆里有肥皂泡。

examples.text: He was decorated with the Order of the Bath.
examples.translation: 他被授以巴斯勋章。

examples.text: That sick personhas got a bath chair.
examples.translation: 那个病人有一部巴斯轮椅。

examples.text: He will bath only after we fill the tub with toys.
examples.translation: 他只有在我们在浴盆中装满玩具后才洗澡。

examples.text: And when Sparta burns, you shall bathe in gold.
examples.translation: 当斯巴达被火烧的时候，你们讲沐浴在黄金里。

examples.text: The doctor advised him to bathe in the sun.s rays.
examples.translation: 医生劝他沐浴阳光。

examples.text: He took some time to bathe in short stories.
examples.translation: 他花了些时间沉浸在短篇小说里。

examples.text: He weighed himself on the bathroom scales.
examples.translation: 他在浴室的磅秤上称体重。

examples.text: Steam has fogged the bathroom mirror.
examples.translation: 水蒸气把浴室里的镜子遮住了。

examples.text: There are two bathrooms in my house.
examples.translation: 我们家有两个浴室。

examples.text: Every room in the hotel has a private bathroom.
examples.translation: 旅馆中的每个房间都有一个单独浴室。

examples.text: We'll have one room with a bathroom and one room without.
examples.translation: 我们要有一间带浴室的屋子，还要有一间不带浴室的。

meanings.meaning: 电池；一系列；炮兵连；排炮；[律]殴打

examples.text: They are electrifying the battery.
examples.translation: 他们正给电池充电。

examples.translation: 我的汽车电池没电了，需要充电。

examples.text: We would undergo a battery of tests.
examples.translation: 我们要进行一系列试验。

examples.text: A captain commands a company or battery.
examples.translation: 一个上尉指挥一个连队或炮兵连。

examples.text: An enemy battery zeroed in on the crossroad.
examples.translation: 敌人炮兵集中炮火于那个十字路口。

examples.text: He was guilty of assault and battery.
examples.translation: 他犯了殴打罪。

examples.text: A battery is any act done intentionally.
examples.translation: 殴打是故意行为。

meanings.meaning: 与 ... 作战；与 ... 竞争

examples.text: His brave deeds in the battle earned him everlasting glory.
examples.translation: 他在那场战斗中的英勇事迹为他赢得了永恒的荣誉。

examples.text: He has proved his wit in the battle.
examples.translation: 他已在这场争斗中证明了自己的睿智。

examples.text: They battled with the wind and the waves.
examples.translation: 他们与风浪搏斗。

examples.text: Progress is slow but we keep battling on.

examples.translation: 有人认为贫困生罪恶。

examples.text: They believe it is essential to defy convention.
examples.translation: 他们认为反抗流俗是绝对必要的。

examples.text: The church bell tolled the hour.
examples.translation: 教堂的鸣钟报时。

examples.text: I was roused by the sound of the bell this morning.
examples.translation: 今天早晨，我被铃声唤醒。

examples.text: I was too preoccupied to hear the bell.
examples.translation: 当时我出神地想着心事，没有听见门铃响。

examples.text: The church bell calls up my wedding day.
examples.translation: 教堂的钟声使我想起了我结婚的那天。

examples.text: The young monk clangs the bell every morning.
examples.translation: 年幼的和尚每天早晨当当地敲钟。

examples.text: Lots of bell ringers were killed by lightning.
examples.translation: 许多敲钟人被闪电击毙。

examples.text: The thief got flurried,thinking that it was too bad to have produced the crashiing sound which would himself on the bell,trying to muffle the crashing sound with his arms.
examples.translation: 他心里一急，身子一下子扑到了钟上，张开双臂想捂住钟声，可钟声又怎么捂得住呢！

examples.text: Her beloved broach was nowhere to be found.
examples.translation: 她心爱的饰针找不到了。

examples.text: She refused to be parted from her beloved cat.
examples.translation: 她拒绝和她心爱的猫分开。

examples.text: She is bewailing the loss of her beloved husband.
examples.translation: 她在为失去心爱的丈夫而痛哭。

examples.text: Wherefore are you, my beloved?
examples.translation: 你怎么啦，我的宝贝？

examples.text: His income is well below the average.
examples.translation: 他的收入大大低于平均水平。

examples.text: The class has dropped below ten students this year.
examples.translation: 今年这个班的学生降到了10人以下。

examples.text: Please do not write below this line.
examples.translation: 请不要写到这条线下面。

examples.text: The information below was compiled by our correspondent.
examples.translation: 以下资料是我们的记者收集整理的。

examples.text: The captain told the sailors to go below.
examples.translation: 船长叫水手们下到舱里去。

meanings.meaning: 用皮带抽打；用带系上；用带标示

examples.text: He has a brown belt in karate.
examples.translation: 他有一条空手道的棕腰带。（他是空手道茶带）

examples.text: A belt of trees grew between the two fields.
examples.translation: 两块田之间有一条树木带。

examples.text: As Indonesia lies in the volcanic belt, earthquakes can occur.
examples.translation: 由于印尼位于火山地带,因此有发生地震的可能。

examples.text: My trousers only stay up if I wear a belt.
examples.translation: 我这条裤子要是不系皮带就往下掉。

examples.text: He strapped the driver with a leather belt.
examples.translation: 他用皮带抽打司机。

examples.text: The air hostess asked everyone to belt himself in.
examples.translation: 空中小姐要求大家扣好安全带。

examples.text: They went belting along the road.
examples.translation: 他们沿着马路疾驰而去。

examples.text: This bench is made of elm.
examples.translation: 这条长凳是榆木制的。

examples.text: An old man sat on the park bench and fed the pigeon.
examples.translation: 一位老人坐在公园的长凳上喂鸽子。

examples.text: A young woman, of sullen aspect, was sitting alone on the bench.
examples.translation: 一个面色忧郁的年轻女人独自坐在长凳上。

examples.text: I'm glad the new trainee is keen but I wish he'd stop hanging around my bench and getting in my hair.
examples.translation: 新来的受训者很敏捷，我很满意，不过我希望他别再我工作台周围闲荡，使我觉得烦恼。

examples.text: The bench read the sentence to the criminal.
examples.translation: 法官向罪犯宣读了判决。

examples.text: She has recently been appointed to the bench.
examples.translation: 她最近当上了法官。

meanings.meaning: 弯曲；使弯曲；屈服；屈从；集中于

examples.text: The branches bent in the wind.
examples.translation: 树枝被风吹弯了。

examples.text: The branch bent but didn't break when the boy climbed along it.
examples.translation: 那男孩爬上树枝时，树枝弯曲了，但是没有折断。

examples.text: They refused to bend to the hijackers' demands.
examples.translation: 他们拒绝屈从于劫机者的要求。

examples.text: She can't bend him to her will.
examples.translation: 她无法使他服从自己的意志。

examples.text: He could not bend his mind to his studies .
examples.translation: 他不能专心于他的功课。

examples.text: The stream takes a sudden bend to the east.
examples.translation: 小溪突然转向东流。

examples.text: There is a sharp bend in the road here.
examples.translation: 这段路上有一处急转弯。

meanings.meaning: 在 ... 之下；被...覆盖；低于...；不值得

examples.text: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.
examples.translation: 他们在一堆树叶下面发现了那具尸体。

examples.text: The earth lay beneath a blanket of snow.
examples.translation: 大地被厚厚的白雪覆盖。

examples.text: He is beneath his brother intellectually.
examples.translation: 他在智力方面不如他兄弟。

examples.text: Such behaviour is beneath contempt.
examples.translation: 这种行为令人不齿。

examples.text: He shrugged off my criticism as though it was beneath his notice.
examples.translation: 他不理睬我的批评,好像我的批评不值得他一顾似的。

examples.text: Her careful make-up hid the signs of age beneath.
examples.translation: 她的精心化妆掩饰了脂粉下面岁月刻下的痕迹。

examples.text: We looked down from the plane at the fields spread out beneath.
examples.translation: 我们从飞机上俯瞰下面一片片的土地。

meanings.meaning: 利益；津贴；义演；保险金；借助

examples.text: It was for the benefit of your company that we did that.
examples.translation: 我们这样做都是为了你们公司的利益。

examples.text: Applications for unemployment benefits dropped last month.
examples.translation: 上个月申请失业津贴的人数下降了。

examples.text: A benefit performance will be held tonight.
examples.translation: 今晚有义演。

examples.text: The unemployed are entitled to receive other unemployment insurance benefits during the period of receiving unemployment insurance compensation.
examples.translation: 失业人员在领取失业保险金期间,按照规定同时享受其他失业保险待遇。

examples.text: It was achieved with the benefit of modern technology.
examples.translation: 借助现代技术,这个目标已经达到。

examples.text: The new hospital will benefit the entire community.
examples.translation: 新医院将有益于整个社区。

examples.text: A large number of students will benefit from the new teaching method.
examples.translation: 多数学生将从这个新的教学方法中得益。

examples.text: Tomorrow we'll go to pick berries.
examples.translation: 明天我们去采浆果。

examples.text: This kind of jam is made of berry.
examples.translation: 这种果酱是由浆果做的。

examples.text: The berry is nutritious and has a sweetish taste.
examples.translation: 浆果有营养并且有一种带甜味的口味。

examples.text: Let's go berrying.
examples.translation: 咱们去采浆果吧。

meanings.meaning: 在 ... 旁边；与 ... 相比；和... 无关

examples.text: I set a chair beside him and sat down.
examples.translation: 我在他旁边放了一把椅子然后坐下了。

examples.text: The little girl is sitting beside her mother.
examples.translation: 小女孩正坐在她妈妈旁边。

examples.text: Our achievements seem small beside his.
examples.translation: 与他的成就相比我们的就显得微不足道了。

examples.text: Money seems unimportant when setting beside the joys of family life.
examples.translation: 与天伦之乐相比,金钱显得微不足道。

examples.text: The discussion is beside the matter at hand.
examples.translation: 这种讨论与本题无关。

examples.text: No one writes to me besides you.
examples.translation: 除你以外，没有人给我写信。

examples.text: There will be five of us for dinner, besides John.
examples.translation: 除约翰外，还有我们五个人要一起吃饭。

examples.text: He has been to Mexico but nowhere besides.
examples.translation: 他曾去过墨西哥但没去过别的地方。

examples.text: He gave me a book,a pen and some money besides.
examples.translation: 他给我一本书，一支钢笔，此外还给一些钱。

examples.text: I haven't time to see the film besides, it had dreadful reviews.
examples.translation: 我没有时间去看这部影片--再说，影评也诸多贬斥。

examples.text: The facilities were not ideal but we managed as best we could.
examples.translation: 设备不理想，但我们已经尽了最大的努力。

examples.text: He's difficult at the best of times usually he's impossible.
examples.translation: 他即使在情绪最好的时候，都很难相处－－平常就更令人受不了了。

examples.text: You had best not accept the offer.
examples.translation: 你最好是不要接纳这要求。

examples.text: Take whatsoever measures you consider best.
examples.translation: 采取任何你认为最好的措施。

examples.text: He would try to best his previous time.
examples.translation: 他竭尽全力去打破自己以前的纪录。

examples.text: Any stigma will do to best a dogma.
examples.translation: 一点漏洞，足可打破教条。

examples.text: He bet $50 that his horse would win.
examples.translation: 他拿50美元打赌，说他的马将会赢。

examples.text: I bet they are making a pile out of the deal.
examples.translation: 我肯定他们这笔生意一定赚大钱。

examples.text: I bet that he's lost all his money in the gamble.
examples.translation: 我肯定他在赌博中输掉了所有的钱。

examples.text: I ventured a small bet on the horse.
examples.translation: 我在那匹马上下了一小笔赌注。

examples.text: My bet is they've got held up in the traffic.
examples.translation: 我想他们一定是在路上因交通拥挤而受阻了。

examples.text: I'll lay you a bet that it will be fine tomorrow.
examples.translation: 我和你打赌,明天天一定会放晴。

examples.text: He betrayed his country.
examples.translation: 他背叛了他的国家。

examples.text: He promised never to betray the organization.
examples.translation: 他发誓永不背叛组织。

examples.text: He was seduced to betray his friend.
examples.translation: 他受唆使而出卖朋友。

examples.text: As long as you don't betray me, I'll do whatever you ask me to.
examples.translation: 只要你不出卖我,要我做什么我都愿意。

examples.text: A friend does not betray confidences.
examples.translation: 朋友是不会泄露秘密的

examples.text: His accent betrayed the fact that he was foreign.
examples.translation: 他的口音显露出他是外国人。

examples.text: The smoke from cooking betrayed the presence of the enemy.
examples.translation: 炊烟暴露了敌人的存在。

examples.text: Children must attend school between 5 and 16.
examples.translation: 5至16岁的孩子必须上学。

examples.text: There is a generation gap between my parents and I.
examples.translation: 我父母和我之间有代沟。

examples.text: She tried to intervene between her husband and son.
examples.translation: 她想调解丈夫和儿子之间的争吵。

examples.text: One town ends where the next begins and there's a road that runs between.
examples.translation: 一个城镇连接着另一个城镇,两者之间有一条路。

meanings.meaning: 超出；远于；除 ... 之外；超出…之外

examples.text: The level of inflation has gone beyond 8%.
examples.translation: 通货膨胀率已经超过了8%。

examples.text: Such philosophical subtleties are beyond my reach.
examples.translation: 这种深奥的哲理我可无法理解。

examples.text: The scenery there was beautiful beyond expression.
examples.translation: 那儿的风景美丽得无法形容。

examples.text: He's got nothing beyond his state pension.
examples.translation: 除了国家发的养老金，他一无所有。

examples.text: I don't notice anything beyond his rather strange accent.
examples.translation: 除了他那颇为古怪的口音以外,我没注意到别的。

examples.text: They crossed the mountains and travelled to the valleys beyond.
examples.translation: 他们越过群山，到了那边的山谷。

examples.text: The immediate future is clear, but it's hard to tell what lies beyond.
examples.translation: 近期内的情况很清楚,但很难说以后如何。

examples.text: Another unidentified source, seen below the galactic plane, is likely beyond the boundaries of the Milky Way.
examples.translation: 另外一个处在银河盘面下方的未被命名的伽马源，大概在银河系的边界之外。

examples.text: The localisation extends beyond a Swedish language poker client, with Party Poker additionally offering full Swedish-speaking support.
examples.translation: 本地化延伸超越瑞典语扑克客户端，与党扑克另外提供充分讲瑞典语的支持。

examples.text: In future, men can travel to the moon and beyond.
examples.translation: 未来人们能到月球或更远处去旅行。

examples.text: What can we know of the beyond?
examples.translation: 我们对来世能知道些什么呢？

examples.text: You can find this sentence in the Holy Bible.
examples.translation: 你可以在圣经上找到这句话。

examples.text: He quotes the Bible to support his belief.
examples.translation: 他引述圣经以支持自己的信条。

examples.text: Can you ride a bicycle?
examples.translation: 你会骑自行车吗？

examples.text: He beguiled me into lending him my bicycle.
examples.translation: 他骗我把自行车借给了他。

examples.text: Every day he rode his old bicycle to his office.
examples.translation: 每天他骑着他那辆旧自行车去上班。

examples.text: You can coast downhill on a bicycle.
examples.translation: 你可以骑自行车滑下坡。

examples.text: I saw him make by the gate on his bicycle.
examples.translation: 我看见他骑自行车从大门旁边过去了。

meanings.meaning: 大的；重要的；有雄心的；受欢迎的

examples.text: New York is a big commercial city.
examples.translation: 纽约是一座大的商业城市。

examples.text: His business yields big profits.
examples.translation: 他的生意带来巨大的利润。

examples.text: Don't cry, you are a big boy now.
examples.translation: 别哭，你现在已经是大男孩了。

examples.text: The big moment has come at last!
examples.translation: 重要的时刻终于到来了！

examples.text: The big thing is that you know what you want.
examples.translation: 重要的是你必须知道自己想要什么。

examples.text: He's got a lot of big ideas about how to change the system.
examples.translation: 就如何改变体制，他有一些远大的想法。

examples.text: That rock and roll band is very big in Chicago.
examples.translation: 那个摇滚乐团在芝加哥很受欢迎。

examples.text: You need to think big(= aim to achieve a lot).
examples.translation: 你要敢想。

examples.text: The band comes over big with pop fans.
examples.translation: 该乐队受流行音乐歌迷欢迎大为成功。

examples.text: With that new promotion he's now one of the bigs in the company.
examples.translation: 通过那次得晋升，他现在是公司的杰出员工之一。

examples.text: It took them more than one billion dollars to complete the project.
examples.translation: 完成这个工程花费了他们十亿多美元。

examples.text: Some computers can perform over a billion computation a second.
examples.translation: 有些计算机一秒钟能完成超过十亿次运算。

examples.text: The human brain contains several billion nerve cells, which are connected with one another by fine nerves.
examples.translation: 人类的大脑含有几十亿个神经细胞，这些细胞由纤细的神经将彼此连接起来。

meanings.meaning: 捆绑；装订；约束；强迫；团结

examples.text: She bound her hair with a handkerchief.
examples.translation: 她用手绢把头发扎了起来。

examples.text: This hint was hard enough to bind my hands.
examples.translation: 这个暗示已经够使我束手无策了。

examples.text: The publishing house decided to bind the new book in leather.
examples.translation: 这家出版社决定用皮面装帧新书。

examples.text: The treaty binds each country to reduce pollution levels.
examples.translation: 该条约迫使各国减少污染排放。

examples.text: It is the common interest that binds us together.
examples.translation: 共同的利益使我们结合在一起。

examples.text: Their refusal to sign the contract has put us in a bit of a bind.
examples.translation: 他们拒绝签约，从而使我们的处境有些困难。

meanings.meaning: 生物学；(一个地区的全部)生物；生物群落

examples.text: He specializes biology.
examples.translation: 他主修生物学。

examples.text: We have a biology lesson tomorrow.
examples.translation: 明天我们有堂生物学课。

examples.text: He is an environmentalist with a passion of the biology and geography of the region.
examples.translation: 他是一个环保人士，对这个地区的生物和地理很有热情。

examples.text: He is knowledgeable about the biology of the honeybee.
examples.translation: 他对蜜蜂的生活规律知之甚多。

examples.text: That bird tried to peck me.
examples.translation: 那只鸟想啄我。

examples.text: The penguin is a flightless bird.
examples.translation: 企鹅是一种不会飞的鸟。

examples.text: Better be a bird in the wood than one in the cage.
examples.translation: 宁为林中鸟,不作笼中禽。

examples.text: The thrush is a kind of small singing bird.
examples.translation: 画眉是一种小鸣禽。

examples.text: Gestation extends from fertilization to birth.
examples.translation: 妊娠期系指从配种到分娩之间的时间。

examples.text: Many of the women died in child birth in the past.
examples.translation: 在过去，许多妇女死于分娩。

examples.text: My daughter's birth was ecstatic.
examples.translation: 我女儿的出生令人欣喜。

examples.text: By accident of birth she was rich.
examples.translation: 她有幸出生于富裕人家。

examples.text: This painting depicts the birth of Venus.
examples.translation: 这幅画描绘的是维纳斯的诞生。

examples.text: There is a mystique about the birth of a new star.
examples.translation: 一个新明星的诞生总是显得神秘。

examples.text: She is English by birth but French by marriage.
examples.translation: 她是英国血统，但嫁给法国人而入了法国籍。

examples.text: Gestation extends from fertilization to birth.
examples.translation: 妊娠期系指从配种到分娩之间的时间。

examples.text: During the birth she was given gas and air.
examples.translation: 她分娩时用了麻醉混合气体。

examples.text: The era also gave birth to a whole array of new social problems.
examples.translation: 那个时代还产生了一系列新的社会问题。

examples.text: Every dragon gives birth to a St. George who slays it.
examples.translation: 每一条龙都会产生出一个屠龙的圣乔治。

examples.text: I received a set of gardening tools on my birthday.
examples.translation: 生日那天，我收到一套园艺工具。

examples.text: He gave her an expensive fur for her birthday.
examples.translation: 他送给她一件昂贵的毛皮衣服作为生日礼物。

examples.text: Tom's birthday is this week.
examples.translation: 汤姆的生日就在这个星期。

examples.text: Next Monday will be my 21st birthday.
examples.translation: 下星期一是我二十一岁的生日。

examples.text: I was eighteen on my last birthday.
examples.translation: 我已经过了18周岁了。

examples.text: He had some biscuits before the dinner.
examples.translation: 晚饭前，他吃了一些饼干。

examples.text: I caught her with her fingers in the biscuit tin.
examples.translation: 我看见她手指还在饼干盒里呢。

examples.text: Children like to eat the biscuit.
examples.translation: 孩子们喜欢吃饼干。

meanings.meaning: 少量；小块；片刻；马嚼子；（烟头等的）咬嘴；钻头；钥匙齿；一角二分半钱；[计]比特
给（马等）上嚼口；约束 动词bite的过去式和过去分词

examples.text: He only put a bit on his plate to make fashion.
examples.translation: 他只是拨了一点食物到盘子里做做样子。

examples.text: He assembled the model aircraft bit by bit.
examples.translation: 他一块一块地装配飞机模型。

examples.text: Let the broth simmer down a bit more.
examples.translation: 让肉汤炖得再久一些吧。

examples.text: The horse was champing the bit .
examples.translation: 这匹马格格地咬着马嚼子。

examples.text: A power drill will chatter if the bit is loose.
examples.translation: 如果钻头松动，电钻会嘎嘎作响

examples.text: Their dog bit a hole in my trousers.
examples.translation: 他们的狗把我的裤子咬了个窟窿。

examples.text: He was taken to the hospital to be treated for snake bite.
examples.translation: 他因遭蛇咬而被送到医院治疗。

examples.text: I'm stuffed, and I can't eat another bite.
examples.translation: 我很饱了,一口也吃不下了。

meanings.meaning: 苦的；痛苦的；辛酸的；激烈的

examples.text: The medicine has a bitter taste.
examples.translation: 这药有苦味。

examples.text: The defeat was a bitter pill to swallow.
examples.translation: 那次失败是一次难以吞咽的苦果。

examples.text: She wept bitter tears over the loss of her lover.
examples.translation: 她为失去了她的情人而流下痛苦的眼泪。

examples.text: Her voice took on a sudden bitter note.
examples.translation: 她的声音带着一股出意料的辛酸语气。

examples.text: His story brought back our bitter past .
examples.translation: 他的事使我们想起辛酸的往事。

examples.text: The bitter quarrel ended their friendship.
examples.translation: 那场激烈的争吵结束了他的友谊。

examples.text: He is bitter in his condemnation of terrorism.
examples.translation: 他言辞激烈地谴责恐怖主义。

examples.text: It has stopped snowing, but there's a bitter cold wind.
examples.translation: 已经停止下雪啦,不过,还刮着刺骨的寒风。

examples.text: Green tea, unlike black tea, has not been oxidized and can easily turn bitter if not made properly.
examples.translation: 绿茶与红茶不同，没有经过发酵氧化，如果处理不当很容易发涩变苦。

examples.text: The star is called Wormwood, and a third of the waters was turned into wormwood and many people died because of the water which had turned bitter.
examples.translation: 于是水的三分之一变成苦的，许多人因水变苦了而死去。

examples.text: He has tasted the sweets and bitters of life.
examples.translation: 他已尝遍了人生的甜酸苦辣。

examples.text: I like the coffee to taste a little bitter.
examples.translation: 我喜欢喝起来有点苦的咖啡。

examples.text: In the past, however, most medicines were very bitter tasting.
examples.translation: 然而，在过去，大部分的药都是非常苦的。

examples.text: It is bitterly cold today.
examples.translation: 今天冷得很。

examples.text: Five cities in the world fought bitterly over the glory of hosting the2000 Olympic Games.
examples.translation: 世界上有5座城市为申办2000年奥运会展开激烈的角逐。

examples.text: At the end of the film, the hero wept bitterly.
examples.translation: 在影片的结尾，主人公伤心地哭了。

meanings.meaning: 黑的；不加牛奶的；很脏的；愤怒的；令人沮丧的；邪恶的；阴沉的；机密的；黑色幽默的

examples.text: Do you have a black jacket?
examples.translation: 你有一件黑夹克吗？

examples.text: His hands were black from working on the car all afternoon.
examples.translation: 他的双手因为整个下午都在修车而变得脏黑黑的。

examples.text: His father looked as black as thunder.
examples.translation: 他的父亲看上去极为愤怒。

examples.text: The future looks pretty black.
examples.translation: 前景看来很暗淡。

examples.text: The black earthly spirit of the priests wounded my life.
examples.translation: 牧师邪恶的世俗灵魂伤害了我的心灵。

examples.text: The sky looks black and threatening.
examples.translation: 天色阴沉可怕.

examples.text: The Pentagon's black budget are very highly classified.
examples.translation: 五角大楼的机密预算是高度机密的。

examples.text: The black shows up against the white.
examples.translation: 在白色的衬托下,黑色很显目。

examples.text: He was the first black to be elected as Mayor.
examples.translation: 他是第一位被选为市长的黑人。

examples.text: After her husband died, she dressed in deep black for the rest of her life.
examples.translation: 她丈夫去世后，她终生都穿着黑色丧服。

examples.text: The unions have blacked all inports from country.
examples.translation: 工会拒绝处理从这个国家进口的一切货物。

examples.text: He blacked his shoes before visiting his father-in-law.
examples.translation: 在拜访岳父之前，他把鞋子擦黑。

examples.text: During the war we had to black out all our windows.
examples.translation: 战时我们必须用黑布遮着窗口以免透光。

examples.text: Who's rubbed my figures off the blackboard?
examples.translation: 谁把我写在黑板上的数字擦掉了?

examples.text: The blackboard is in the front of the classroom.
examples.translation: 黑板在教室的前面。

examples.text: Please raise your head and look at the blackboard.
examples.translation: 请抬起头来，看黑板。

examples.text: The teacher wrote on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
examples.translation: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写字。

examples.text: The teacher wrote down the new words on the blackboard.
examples.translation: 老师在黑板上写出新单词。

examples.text: The blade needs sharpening.
examples.translation: 这刀刃需要磨一磨。

examples.text: The blade slashed his leg open.
examples.translation: 刀刃把他的腿划破了。

examples.text: The blade is chipped in a few places.
examples.translation: 刀锋有几个地方缺口。

examples.text: The propellar blade is powered by a diesel engine.
examples.translation: 螺旋桨叶由柴油发动机驱动。

examples.text: The blade of the electric fan is covered with dust.
examples.translation: 电扇的叶片上全是灰尘。

examples.text: The driver was not to blame for the accident.
examples.translation: 这次事故怪不着司机。

examples.text: The bank manager was really to blame, though he tried to pin it on a clerk.
examples.translation: 真正受责备的应该是银行经理，可是他却想把责任推到一个职员身上。

examples.text: She blamed him for the failure of their marriage.
examples.translation: 她把婚姻的触礁归咎於他。

examples.text: We were ready to take the blame for what had happened.
examples.translation: 我们准备对所发生的事承担责任。

examples.text: He incurred much blame for his stubborn attitude.
examples.translation: 他态度顽固而招致许多责难。

examples.text: It was wrong of you to fasten the blame on him.
examples.translation: 你把过错推到他头上是不对的。

examples.text: She tried to shunt the blame onto Miss Williams.
examples.translation: 她试图把责任推至威廉姆斯小姐身上。

meanings.meaning: 空白的；茫然的 空白；空白处

examples.text: Give me a blank sheet of paper, please.
examples.translation: 请给我一张空白的纸。

examples.text: Many blank spaces are still left in the suburbs.
examples.translation: 郊区仍留有许多空地。

examples.text: Her explanations were met with blank incomprehension.
examples.translation: 大家对她的解释茫然不解。

examples.text: His expression remained studiously blank.
examples.translation: 他的表情仍是那种故作茫然状。

examples.text: My life before that is a blank to me.
examples.translation: 那以前的生活对我来说已是一片空白。

examples.text: Write your name in the blank.
examples.translation: 在空白栏中写上你的名字。

meanings.meaning: 覆盖；用毯子裹；扑灭；挡风；使包含
包含所有的；适用于所有情形的

examples.text: He threw a blanket over the injured man.
examples.translation: 他急忙给受伤的人披上条毯子。

examples.text: They cuddled up (together) under the blanket.
examples.translation: 他们盖著毯子(在一起)搂著。

examples.text: The nurse carried in a baby wrapped (up) in a warm blanket.
examples.translation: 保母抱著个孩子进来，孩子身上裹著暖暖的毯子。

examples.text: The ground was covered by a thick blanket of snow.
examples.translation: 地面上覆盖着厚厚的一层雪。

examples.text: Covering much of the earth's surface is a blanket of water.
examples.translation: 覆盖大部分地球表面的是水。

examples.text: The countryside was blanketed with snow/fog.
examples.translation: 乡村被雪[雾]覆盖著。

examples.text: Dark clouds blanketed the summit of the downs.
examples.translation: 乌云盖住了丘陵的顶部。

examples.text: She sat by the fire, swaddled in a blanket.
examples.translation: 她用毯子裹住身子，坐在火炉旁。

examples.text: He blanketed the grease fire with sand.
examples.translation: 他用沙子扑灭了油火。

examples.text: A blanket insurance policy insures a car against all kinds of accidents.
examples.translation: 一张综合保险单担保汽车一切意外事件。

meanings.meaning: 爆炸；巨响；一阵(强风)；严厉的批评；愉快的经历
爆破；摧毁；发出巨响；用力撞击；批评

examples.text: 27 school children were injured in the blast.
examples.translation: 27名学龄儿童在爆炸中受了伤。

examples.text: A blast of the trumpet gave her a start.
examples.translation: 突然发出的喇叭声吓了她一跳。

examples.text: The press responded to his remarks with a blast of criticism.
examples.translation: 新闻界以严厉的批评回应了他的言论。

examples.text: It was a great trip! we had a real blast!
examples.translation: 真是一次很棒的旅行！我们玩得很愉快！

examples.text: A massive car bomb blasted the police headquarters.
examples.translation: 一个巨大的汽车炸弹在警局总部爆炸。

examples.text: Frost blasted the blossoms.
examples.translation: 霜使花凋谢了。

examples.text: Rock music blasted full from the parlor.
examples.translation: 震耳欲聋的摇滚乐从客厅传来。

examples.text: Rain blasted the window of my room.
examples.translation: 雨水猛烈地拍打着我房间的窗户。

examples.text: The proposal is blasted as pathetic and inadequate.
examples.translation: 这个建议被批评为毫无价值、依据不足。

meanings.meaning: 火焰；烈火；光辉；(光或色彩的)展现；(感情的)迸发；(动物面部的)白斑；记号
燃烧；发光；迸发；传播；在(树皮)上刻记号

examples.text: We warmed our hands near the blaze of the campfire.
examples.translation: 我们在篝火的火焰旁暖手。

examples.text: The firemen were unable to control the blaze.
examples.translation: 消防队员无法控制这场大火。

examples.text: Seven people died in the blaze at the nightclub.
examples.translation: 在夜总会的熊熊烈火中有七人丧生。

examples.text: The blaze of your eyes can burn the beaven and earth.
examples.translation: 双瞳的光辉足以灼烧大地。

examples.text: The new building was a blaze of light.
examples.translation: 那幢新大楼一片灯光。

examples.text: The gardens in summer are a blaze of colour.
examples.translation: 夏天的花园色彩斑斓。

examples.text: Their marriage took place amid a blaze of publicity.
examples.translation: 他们举行婚礼轰动一时。

examples.text: In a blaze of anger he shouted at us.
examples.translation: 他盛怒之下，对我们大声叫嚷。

examples.text: The following morning the building was still blazing.
examples.translation: 第二天早上,大楼还在燃烧。

examples.text: Lights were blazing in every room.
examples.translation: 每个房间都灯火通明。

examples.text: The tree will blaze with lights on Christmas.
examples.translation: 圣诞节时，这树将被灯饰缀得闪闪发光。

examples.text: He blazed up without warning.
examples.translation: 他突如其来地勃然大怒。

examples.text: The news was blazed all over the daily papers.
examples.translation: 所有日报都刊登了这条消息。

examples.text: He blazed a path through the forest.
examples.translation: 他沿途在森林里的树上刻记号以标示路径。

meanings.meaning: 流血；渗色；榨取；放掉（水或气体）；给...抽血

examples.text: All the young soldiers are ready to bleed for the country.
examples.translation: 所有的年轻战士都愿意为祖国洒热血。

examples.text: If you cut your finger it will bleed.
examples.translation: 如果你割破手指,那么它会流血的。

examples.text: A page trimmed so as to bleed.
examples.translation: 被剪裁的页次经切裁以印成出血版的纸页

examples.text: The tax man is trying to bleed me white.
examples.translation: 税务员正想榨尽我的血汗。

examples.text: You should bleed your radiator before and after every winter.
examples.translation: 你应该在每个冬季前后排空暖气管里的水。

examples.text: Doctors used to bleed people when they were sick.
examples.translation: 过去人们生病时,医生给他们放血。

examples.text: In the Middle Ages, doctors used to bleed people for medical treatment.
examples.translation: 在中世纪，医生常给病人放血进行治疗。

examples.text: Oil does not blend with water.
examples.translation: 油不溶於水。

examples.text: The sea and the sky seemed to blend into each another.
examples.translation: 大海和蓝天似乎连成了一片。

examples.text: The poem blends the separate ingredients into a unity.
examples.translation: 这首诗把几个分开的部分融合为一体。

examples.text: The curtains blend in perfectly with the furniture.
examples.translation: 窗帘(的颜色)跟家具(的颜色)十分和谐。

examples.text: Which blend of coffee would you like?
examples.translation: 你要哪一种混合咖啡?

examples.text: These cigarettes are a blend of the best tobaccos.
examples.translation: 这些香烟是用最好的烟草混合制成的。

meanings.meaning: 保佑；祝福；赐福；有幸具有

examples.text: God bless you!
examples.translation: 愿上帝保佑你！

examples.text: May the gods bless this grateful heart!
examples.translation: 愿神祗保佑这深明大义的孩子。

examples.text: May Lord bless all of us who are in misfortune!
examples.translation: 愿天主保佑我们这些苦难的人吧！

examples.text: The priest blessed the ship before it left port.
examples.translation: 牧师在船离港之前为其祝福。

examples.text: To give me your heart, and bless me with your love!
examples.translation: 给我你的心,用你的爱来祝福我吧!

examples.text: I will bless her and give you a son by her.
examples.translation: 我要赐福给她，让她为你生一个儿子。

examples.text: But God wants to bless you today.
examples.translation: 然而，神是要在今天赐福予你。

examples.text: Love is blind and sometimes deaf.
examples.translation: 爱情是盲目的,有时甚至是聋的。

examples.text: She wants it so much that she became so stupid and blind.
examples.translation: 她那么渴望,以致到了又笨又盲目的地步。

examples.text: There's none so blind as those who won't see.
examples.translation: 瞎子不算瞎,有眼不看才是瞎。

examples.text: Without his spectacles, he is as blind as a bat.
examples.translation: 没有眼镜,他是几乎全盲的。

examples.text: She was blind to the silent worship in his eyes.
examples.translation: 她没有发觉他眼里流露出的无声的敬慕之情。

examples.text: The soldier was blinded in battle.
examples.translation: 那个士兵在战斗中双目失明。

examples.text: Staring at an eclipse can blind you.
examples.translation: 盯着日蚀看会致盲。

examples.text: Your pride cannot blind God!
examples.translation: 你的骄傲蒙蔽不了上帝。

examples.text: By this time Felice's tears began to blind her.
examples.translation: 这时候泪水开始蒙住了佛艾丽丝的眼睛。

examples.text: Falling in love can blind us to an extent.
examples.translation: 爱情会让人盲目。

examples.text: Most parents have a blind spot for their children.
examples.translation: 大多数父母盲目地疼爱他们的孩子。

examples.text: Something,such as a window shade or a Venetian blind,that hinders vision or shuts out light.
examples.translation: 遮光物如窗帘或软百叶窗等能遮挡视线或挡住阳光的物体。

examples.text: The extract takes room air through the light shelf and lower window venetian blind cavity via the clerestory glazing plenum.
examples.translation: 这些汲取设备通过遮阳构架和较低的活动百叶窗间隙再经由天窗双层玻璃或的室内通风。

meanings.meaning: 街区；木块；石块；大楼；一组；阻塞(物)；障碍(物)

examples.text: Walk two blocks down the street and go past the city hall.
examples.translation: 顺这条街走两个街区，过市政厅。

examples.text: The doctors succeeded in confining the contagious disease within the block.
examples.translation: 医生们成功地将这个传染病控制在这一街区的范围内。

examples.text: The floor was made of wooden blocks.
examples.translation: 地板是用木块拼成的。

examples.text: The blocks should be laid on a bed of concrete.
examples.translation: 石块应该固定在混凝土基座上。

examples.text: The chief stumbling block to his promotion is his lack of qualifications.
examples.translation: 他晋升的主要障碍是他的资格不够。

examples.text: The dog's fur was matted with blood.
examples.translation: 那只狗的毛皮上沾有血迹。

examples.text: She was sick at the sight of the blood.
examples.translation: 她一见到血就感到恶心。

examples.text: A drop of blood slid down his leg.
examples.translation: 他的腿上流着一点儿血。

examples.text: The wounded man was covered with blood.
examples.translation: 这个受伤的人身上全是血。

examples.text: He has oriental blood in his veins.
examples.translation: 他是东方血统。

examples.text: They are not of the same blood.
examples.translation: 他们并非同宗。

examples.text: Someone told me that she has royal blood.
examples.translation: 有人告诉我她有贵族血统。

examples.text: There is a lot of bad blood between those two families.
examples.translation: 这两家人积怨太深。

examples.text: He did not want to see any American blood spilt.
examples.translation: 他不想看到任何美国人流血牺牲。

examples.text: The apple-trees are out of bloom.
examples.translation: 苹果树已经落了花。

examples.text: Most roses will begin to bloom from late May.
examples.translation: 大多数玫瑰从五月末开始开花。

examples.text: The roses are in full bloom.
examples.translation: 玫瑰花盛开了。

examples.text: The apple trees are in full bloom at the moment.
examples.translation: 目前苹果树开满了花。

examples.text: He is still in the bloom of youth.
examples.translation: 他仍在青年时期。

examples.text: Judy is now in the bloom of youth.
examples.translation: 朱迪现在正当青春年少。

examples.text: She is able to date the bloom of this kind of flower.
examples.translation: 她能算出这种花的花期。

examples.text: Daffodils and crocuses bloom in the spring.
examples.translation: 水仙花和番红花在春天开放。

examples.text: The roses are blooming!
examples.translation: 玫瑰花正在盛开。

examples.text: The chrysanthemums bloom luxuriantly.
examples.translation: 菊花盛开。

examples.text: Poetry was blooming in China in the Tang dynasty.
examples.translation: 中国的诗歌在唐代十分盛行。

examples.text: The sunshine will bring out the blossom.
examples.translation: 阳光将使花朵开放。

examples.text: The tree was covered with beautiful pink blossom.
examples.translation: 这树开满了美丽的粉红色的花。

examples.text: The apple trees are in blossom.
examples.translation: 苹果树正在开花。

examples.text: There are many pear trees covered in blossom.
examples.translation: 那里有许多开满花的梨树。

examples.text: My grandfather bought some classical sculptures in its blossom.
examples.translation: 我爷爷买了些全盛时期的古典主义雕塑作品。

examples.text: The apple trees are blossoming.
examples.translation: 苹果树正在开花。

examples.text: The apple trees will blossom soon.
examples.translation: 苹果树很快就要开花。

examples.text: The plum trees began to blossom.
examples.translation: 梅树开始开花。

examples.text: Her daughter is blossoming into a beautiful girl.
examples.translation: 她的女儿出落成一个漂亮的女孩。

examples.text: She might blossom out into the world one day.
examples.translation: 有一天她可能长大，融入社会。

meanings.meaning: 吹；风吹；擤(鼻子)；(保险丝)熔断；浪费(机会)

examples.text: The death of their daughter was a cruel blow.
examples.translation: 女儿的死对他们是一个残酷的打击。

examples.text: I was dazed by the blow on my head.
examples.translation: 我的头挨了一击而觉得晕眩。

examples.text: Bill knocked him down with one blow.
examples.translation: 比尔一拳把他打倒在地。

examples.text: Now, Peter, make a wish and blow out the candles.
examples.translation: 彼得,现在你许个愿,然后吹蜡烛。

examples.text: It's blowing hard tonight.
examples.translation: 今晚风大得很。

examples.text: It is bad manners to blow your nose at table.
examples.translation: 吃饭时擤鼻子是不礼貌的行为。

examples.text: A short circuit will blow the fuse.
examples.translation: 短路会烧断保险丝的。

examples.text: If you put on the iron, the fuse will blow out .
examples.translation: 如果你插上电熨斗，则保险丝会断的。

meanings.meaning: 木板；布告板；董事会；船舷或机舱；伙食；舞台
登(飞机、车、船等)；接受乘客；有偿提供食宿；搭伙；用木板覆盖

examples.text: Will you draw the nails from this board?
examples.translation: 请你把钉子从这块木板上拔出来好吗?

examples.text: Paste down the map on the board.
examples.translation: 把这张地图用浆糊贴在布告板上。

examples.text: Her election to the board of directors caused great surprise.
examples.translation: 她被选进董事会,令人大为吃惊。

examples.text: Please get on board at once; the plane is taking off very soon.
examples.translation: 请即刻登机；飞机马上就要起飞了。

examples.text: She pays $100 a week plus room and board.
examples.translation: 她每星期付100美元,另加食宿。

examples.text: For ambitious actors, playing on the boards is the greatest happiness in their life.
examples.translation: 对怀着雄心壮志的演员来说,在舞台上表演是他们生命中最大的快乐。

examples.text: Passengers must board the ship by 6 p.m.
examples.translation: 旅客必须在下午六点钟以前上船。

examples.text: The passenger walk up the ramp to board the airplane.
examples.translation: 旅客们走上活动舷梯登上飞机。

examples.text: Flight 757 is now boarding.
examples.translation: 757航班的乘客请现在登机。

examples.text: We will be very glad to board and lodge you.
examples.translation: 我们很高兴为您提供食宿。

examples.text: I'd board up the windows if I were you.
examples.translation: 如果我要是你的话,我就用木板把窗户钉上。

examples.text: Don't boast and don't be modest.
examples.translation: 不要自夸,也不要太谦虚。

examples.text: That's nothing to boast about.
examples.translation: 那没有什麽值得自吹的。

examples.text: Nobody should boast of his learning.
examples.translation: 谁也不应当夸耀自己的学识。

examples.text: He never boasted of his cleverness.
examples.translation: 他未曾夸耀过自己的聪明。

examples.text: Don't believe him; he is just boasting.
examples.translation: 别相信他，他只是在吹嘘罢了。

examples.text: He boasted that he could run very fast.
examples.translation: 他吹牛说他可以跑得很快。

examples.text: Our school can boast of a fine swimming pool.
examples.translation: 本校以拥有一座设备完善的游泳池而自豪。

examples.text: Our school library boasts quite a few rare books.
examples.translation: 我们学校图书馆以藏有好多珍本书而自豪。

examples.text: The town boasts a world-famous art gallery.
examples.translation: 这个镇子引以为荣的是有个闻名於世的美术馆。

examples.text: That brother of yours is full of boasts.
examples.translation: 你那个宝贝兄弟满口大话。

examples.text: His boast is that he is the best.
examples.translation: 他自吹他是最好的。

examples.text: It was his proud boast that he had never missed a day's work because of illness.
examples.translation: 他从未请过一天病假，这是他引以自豪的事。

examples.translation: 他为自己上班从未迟到感到自豪。

examples.translation: 他们把小船又往水里推了推。

examples.translation: 你到美国是坐船还是坐飞机？

examples.translation: 他们正在为划船比赛接受训练。

examples.translation: 西蒙参加了划船比赛并赢得了冠军。

examples.translation: 这样的新型电磁炉煮沸一锅水只用3分钟。

examples.translation: 把被单好好煮一煮，好让它们白一些。

examples.translation: 他大胆的绘画和所有的暖色调表现了他独有的绘画特色。

examples.translation: 在蓝天的映衬下,山峰的轮廓极为明显。

examples.translation: 在头版上出现了一条令人触目惊心的粗黑体大字标题。

examples.translation: 可否冒昧问一下您多大年纪？

examples.translation: 别这么狼吞虎咽,不然你会消化不良的！

examples.text: An industrial firm issues bond to collect money and will pay back with interest.
examples.translation: 工厂发行债券集资并偿还利息。

examples.translation: 婚姻应该是永恒的结合。

examples.translation: 我们缔结了一项正式协定。

examples.translation: 共同的利益把我们联系在一起。

examples.translation: 在她卧床不起的日子里，她和小猫建立起来的情谊依然存在。

examples.translation: 可应用于酚醛树脂绝缘板的黏合剂生产。

examples.translation: 这家公司拒绝为一个前科罪犯作保。

examples.translation: 我使用防水粘合剂，以获得最佳连结性。

examples.translation: 这两种不同材料粘合不起来。

meanings.meaning: 除去骨头；往衣服里加撑条；磨光表面

examples.translation: 科学家根据那些化石的骨骼结构确定其年代。

examples.translation: 他摔断了一根腿骨。

examples.translation: 她喉咙中的鱼骨使她哽噎。

examples.translation: 我的英语老师是我们学校的骨干教师。

examples.translation: 下次让卖肉的把肉里的骨头剔出来。

examples.translation: 你能帮我把这块肉的骨头剔掉吗?

examples.translation: 把这些外套用东西撑起了。

examples.translation: 在我们去巴黎之前，我必须刻苦学习法语－。

examples.translation: 他不得不死记硬背法文。

examples.text: I need to bone up on my English.
examples.translation: 我得好好学英语。

examples.text: He is bone idle.
examples.translation: 他非常懒惰。

examples.text: I am bone tired.
examples.translation: 我累死了。

examples.translation: 那个学生昨天丢了书。

examples.translation: 把文章写在练习簿里，不要写在草稿纸上。

examples.translation: 我将为你预订直飞伦敦的航班。

meanings.meaning: 靴子；猛踢；解雇；[英]汽车行李箱

examples.translation: 小偷朝我腹部踢了一脚。

examples.translation: 你再迟到一次,就要把你解雇了。

examples.translation: 他工作了14年后竟然被解雇了，只好另谋职业。

examples.translation: 我去把行李放进行李箱里。

examples.translation: 他把六个大提包硬塞进了我车子的行李箱。

examples.translation: 他总把球往人群中踢。

examples.translation: 他父亲把他从家里赶了出去。

examples.translation: 我电脑重启需要几分钟的时间。

examples.text: Would you please watch over my booth?
examples.translation: 请您照料一下我的摊位好吗?

examples.translation: 我到街角的电话亭给他打个电话。

examples.translation: 碰巧在附近有个公用电话亭。

examples.translation: 他们坐在餐厅角落的小隔间里，与别的就餐者分开。

meanings.meaning: 使厌烦；开凿；钻孔；挖掘；盯着看

examples.text: He bored us all by talking for hours about his new house.
examples.translation: 他连续几个小时大谈他的新房子，使我们大家都厌烦透了。

examples.translation: 他们打算开凿一条穿越此山的隧道。

examples.translation: 这台钻机能钻透岩石。

examples.translation: 虫子已经蛀穿了木料。

examples.translation: 他用钻在门上钻孔。

examples.translation: 鼹鼠在地下挖掘(路)。

examples.translation: 他的一双蓝眼睛似乎要穿透她。

meanings.meaning: 出生的；与生俱来的 动词bear的过去分词.

examples.text: The youngest is a born rider of the rails.
examples.translation: 小儿子是天生的流浪儿。

examples.translation: 梅格出生在一个大家庭。

examples.translation: 她把孩子紧紧抱在怀里。

examples.translation: 他向众人袒示胸怀。

examples.translation: 那男孩问地球内部是什么。

examples.translation: 他内心生出一阵恶毒的嫉妒。

examples.translation: 死亡的威胁使我们都成了亲密的伙伴。

examples.translation: 这个女孩非常幸运，她的妈妈是她的知心朋友。

examples.translation: 因为神也是在期待所有的人类能效法耶稣，把他当成模范，并且通过耶稣而拥抱神的爱，因为神在整个慢长的历史里，也是非常地劳苦。

examples.translation: 他的两眼都受伤了。

examples.translation: 她吻了他的双颊。

examples.translation: 两者都好。

examples.translation: 我们两个都知道这件事。

examples.text: He is both a soldier and a poet.
examples.translation: 他既是个战士，又是个诗人。

examples.translation: 好的经理应当是称职而且有效。

meanings.meaning: 烦扰；使恼怒；使不安；费心

examples.text: Don't write anything that will bother the censor.
examples.translation: 你可别写什么给检查员找麻烦的话。

examples.translation: 他这样麻木不仁，我心里很不痛快。

examples.translation: 那问题已经困扰了我几个星期。

examples.translation: 这丁点儿事不必放在心上。

examples.translation: 他其实可以把工作做好，可他往往嫌费事而不干。

examples.translation: 别为我操心,我一切都好。

examples.translation: 他甚至连说一声谢谢都不肯。

examples.translation: 哦，你不介意吗?我不愿麻烦别人。

examples.translation: 我们的新机器有一点小毛病。

examples.translation: 恐怕做这件事太麻烦你了。

examples.translation: 我喜欢做饭，一点儿也不嫌麻烦。

examples.translation: 一点儿也不麻烦,我很乐意做的。

examples.translation: 我们何不开瓶香槟酒庆祝一下呢？

examples.translation: 尽量不要压抑自己的情感。

examples.translation: 把心中的烦恼告诉我们,不要把它闷在心里！

examples.translation: 你是把水果装在罐里保存呢，还是冷冻起来保存？

examples.text: There are tea leaves in the bottom of my cup.
examples.translation: 我的杯底有茶叶。

examples.text: They sent the enemy ship to the bottom of the sea.
examples.translation: 他们把敌舰击沉。

examples.text: He was always bottom of the class in maths.
examples.translation: 他的数学成绩在班上总是垫底。

examples.text: Put your books on the bottom shelf.
examples.translation: 把你的书放在最下层的架子上.

examples.translation: 没有迹象表明萧条已经到了极点。

examples.translation: 我们想把我们的计划建立在牢固的基础上。

examples.translation: (1) 在昨晚的风暴中她的车窗被一根大树枝打破了。

examples.translation: 球打在墙上又反弹回来。

examples.translation: 她一生中经历过许多挫折，然而总是能重新振作起来。

examples.translation: 他很年轻，能够从这次挫折中恢复过来。

examples.translation: 我希望这张支票别遭退票

examples.translation: 我把婴儿放在膝上上下颠着。

examples.translation: 在打架闹事後,他被酒廊逐出来。

examples.translation: 排球高高地弹起来。

examples.translation: 这些球已没有多少弹性了。

examples.translation: 她回来了,充满了自信和活力。

meanings.meaning: 必定的；有义务的；受约束的；装订的

examples.translation: 过一会儿肯定会下雨。

examples.translation: 在法律上，你没有义务非回答这些问题不可。

examples.translation: 他买了一本该杂志的合订本。

examples.translation: 她有一条饰有蝴蝶结的连衣裙。

examples.translation: 游艇碰上了礁石，撞坏了船头。

examples.translation: 演员们向鼓掌的观众鞠躬。
