meanings.meaning: 宽广的；清楚无误的；明显的；胸怀开阔的；粗俗的

examples.text: The broad steps in front of the mansion made it look very dignified.
examples.translation: 宽阔的台阶使大厦的正面显得很气派。

examples.text: The Minister gave a broad hint that she intends to raise taxes.
examples.translation: 首相明白地暗示她打算提高税额.

examples.text: The kidnapping occurred in broad daylight.
examples.translation: 在光天化日之下竟发生绑架事件。

examples.text: He is broad-minded.
examples.translation: 他是一个心胸宽阔的人。

examples.text: The chairman's speech will be broadcast nationwide.
examples.translation: 主席的讲话将向全国广播。

examples.text: She broadcasts on current affairs.
examples.translation: 她发表时事广播演说。

examples.text: The BBC broadcasts all over the world.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司向全世界播送节目。

examples.text: Before this play is broadcast several cuts must be made.
examples.translation: 这个剧目播出前必须经过数次剪辑。

examples.text: You don't have to broadcast my news to the whole world!
examples.translation: 你不能把我的事告知全天下。

examples.text: Broadcast of seeds is done by hand.
examples.translation: 用手撒播种子。

examples.text: The broadcast was recorded, not live.
examples.translation: 这次广播是事先录音的，不是现场直播。

examples.text: Here is a political party broadcast before an election.
examples.translation: 这是某党派选举前的政治广播节目。

meanings.meaning: 弄坏的；破碎的 动词break的过去分词.

examples.text: He likes to tinker at broken gadgets.
examples.translation: 他喜欢摸弄坏掉的小器具。

examples.text: Can you glue the broken vase together?
examples.translation: 你能把破碎的花瓶黏合起来吗?

examples.text: The broken windows have been boarded up.
examples.translation: 破碎的窗户已被木板封住。

meanings.meaning: 青铜；青铜色；青铜制品；铜牌

examples.text: The statue is made of bronze.
examples.translation: 这座雕像是青铜铸成。

examples.text: We fuse copper and tin to make bronze.
examples.translation: 我们把铜和锡熔制成青铜。

examples.text: The woods today are burnished bronze.
examples.translation: 今天的树林是一片发亮的青铜色。

examples.text: The sanctuary lamp and the metal furniture were bronze.
examples.translation: 圣灯和一切金属器物都是青铜制品。

examples.text: The sculpture was a bronze cast.
examples.translation: 这个雕塑是青铜铸成的

examples.text: There will be a display of bronze statuary in this museum next week.
examples.translation: 下星期这个博物馆将举办一个青铜雕塑作品展览。

examples.text: Remaining bits of bronze sank away from sight.
examples.translation: 青铜色的余辉也不见了踪影。

examples.text: Bronze hyperpigmentation is seen in hemochromatosis and arsenic intoxication.
examples.translation: 青铜色的色素沉着见于血色素沉着症和砷中毒。

examples.text: His face had been bronzed by the sun.
examples.translation: 他的脸被太阳晒成古铜色。

meanings.meaning: 一窝；一伙；一家孩子；一组事物

examples.text: The bird was trying to find food for its brood.
examples.translation: 鸟儿在为它的一窝小鸟觅食。

examples.text: She grew up amidst a lively brood of brothers and sisters.
examples.translation: 她是在一群活泼的兄弟姐妹中间长大的。

examples.text: A brood of modern paintings will be exhibited at the museum.
examples.translation: 一批现代画将在博物馆展览。

examples.text: She brooded over her failure.
examples.translation: 她为失败而郁郁沉思。

examples.text: She brooded the problem all night.
examples.translation: 她一整夜都在思考那个问题。

examples.text: A cloud is brooding over the hills.
examples.translation: 一片乌云笼罩着山岗。

meanings.meaning: (常用于否定句或疑问句)容忍；忍受

examples.text: He jumped his pony across the brook.
examples.translation: 他使小马驹跳过了小河。

examples.text: Before we drink much at a brook,it is well to know its source.
examples.translation: 溪畔畅饮前，最好知其源。

examples.text: By the brook, the cook looked through a cookbook before making hooked cookies.
examples.translation: 在溪边，厨子在做钩形饼干之前查阅了一本食谱。

examples.text: He will not brook any interference.
examples.translation: 他不会容忍他人的任何干涉。

examples.text: Top students brook no intrusions on study time.
examples.translation: 尖子学生不能容忍学习时间受到侵占。

examples.text: We use broom to sweep the floor.
examples.translation: 我们用扫帚扫地。

examples.text: He picked up the broom to help me sweep the floor.
examples.translation: 他拿起扫帚帮我扫地。

examples.text: He stopped sweeping and rested on the broom.
examples.translation: 他停止扫地，倚着扫帚休息。

examples.text: The broom blooms when the bluebells bloom.
examples.translation: 野风信子开花时金雀花也开花了。

examples.text: The broom grows down the arid sand hill.
examples.translation: 金雀草蔓延在干燥的沙丘下。

examples.text: He always had to broom the floor.
examples.translation: 他总是不得不打扫地板。

examples.text: She broomed up the scraps of paper.
examples.translation: 她把纸屑扫在一起。

examples.text: John and Peter are brothers.
examples.translation: 约翰和彼得是兄弟。

examples.text: The man who captained the home team is my brother.
examples.translation: 率领主队的是我的兄弟。

examples.text: Don't be so unkind to your brother.
examples.translation: 别对你兄弟这么刻薄。

examples.text: I always confounded him with his twin brother.
examples.translation: 我总分不清他和他的孪生兄弟。

examples.text: The Brethren hold a prayer meeting every Thursday.
examples.translation: 教友每周四举行一次祷告会。

examples.text: Moses was met on his arrival in Egypt by his elder brother, Aaron, and gained a hearing with his oppressed brethren.
examples.translation: 摩西在回到埃及的途中遇见了他的哥哥亚伦，也听到他受压迫的同胞们的诉求。

examples.text: Deep furrows lined his brow.
examples.translation: 深深的皱纹布上他的额头。

examples.text: His brows went up in surprise.
examples.translation: 他惊讶地竖起了眉毛。

examples.text: His brow corrugated with the effort of thinking.
examples.translation: 他皱着眉头用心地思考。

examples.text: We reached the brow of the hill.
examples.translation: 我们到达了山脊上。

examples.text: Her brow was sad.
examples.translation: 她面露忧伤的神色。

examples.text: He had brown skin.
examples.translation: 他的皮肤是棕色的

examples.text: He bought a pair of dark brown shoes.
examples.translation: 他买了一双深褐色的皮鞋。

examples.text: The leaves of various shades of brown are falling down.
examples.translation: 各种深浅不同的棕色树叶正纷纷下落。

examples.text: Heat the butter until it browns.
examples.translation: 把黄油加热，直到变成褐色为止。

examples.text: This meat takes some time to brown properly when cooking.
examples.translation: 这种肉要花点时间才能煮成恰到好处的褐色。

examples.text: His face is a mass of bruise after the fight.
examples.translation: 他打完架后脸上青一块紫一块的。

examples.text: She is lucky to get off with just a few bruise.
examples.translation: 她幸免于难,只是有几处擦伤。

examples.text: She had a dilly of a bruise on her arm.
examples.translation: 她手臂上有一块显眼的伤痕。

examples.text: It can range from a minor Bruise or sprain to a skull fracture with Brain damage or a spinal-cord injury with paralysis.
examples.translation: 其范围从小型挫伤或扭伤到大脑受损的头颅裂开或麻痹性脊椎伤害。

examples.text: Roberto Carlos and Diarra took the pitch after recovering from tendinitis and a contusion, respectively, while Helguera is still suffering from a bruise.
examples.translation: 卡洛斯和迪亚拉分别从肌腱炎和挫伤中恢复回来，而埃尔格拉仍然还在伤痛中。

examples.text: Soft fruit bruises easily.
examples.translation: 细嫩的水果容易碰损。

examples.text: I have a big bruise on my tibia now.
examples.translation: 我的胫骨有很大一块被擦伤。

examples.text: Lose my balance, bruise my knee, bruise my heart?
examples.translation: 以至于失去平衡，擦伤了膝盖，内心也伤痕累累？

examples.text: She fell and bruised her knee.
examples.translation: 她摔倒在地，膝盖上起了紫血块。

examples.text: He painted the wall with a brush.
examples.translation: 他用刷子涂墙。

examples.text: The painter swept a brush over his canvas.
examples.translation: 画家的画笔在画布上飞掠。

examples.text: I'll give my coat a good brush.
examples.translation: 我要把我的衣服好好刷一下。

examples.text: Let's burn off the rest of the brush.
examples.translation: 让我们把剩下的灌木丛清除掉。

examples.text: He had a brush with his neighbour.
examples.translation: 他和邻居发生了一点摩擦。

examples.text: She has a nasty brush with her boss this morning.
examples.translation: 今天早晨她跟老板大吵了一顿。

examples.text: We should brush our teeth at least twice a day.
examples.translation: 我们每天应该至少刷两次牙。

examples.text: The light wind gently brushed her cheek.
examples.translation: 微风轻拂着她的脸颊。

examples.text: She is scouring the floor with a brush.
examples.translation: 她正在用刷子擦地板。

examples.text: I'll have to give my shoes a brush.
examples.translation: 我必须把我的鞋擦一下。

examples.text: He brushed the dust off his clothes.
examples.translation: 他掸掉衣服上的灰尘。

examples.text: Don't bother to move.I think I can just brush past.
examples.translation: 不必麻烦动了,我想我能擦身挤过去。

examples.text: A cat brushed against her leg in the darkness.
examples.translation: 黑暗中,一只猫蹭着了她的腿。

meanings.meaning: 残忍的；无理性的；粗暴的

examples.text: Eichmann is not a low police brute.
examples.translation: 艾克曼不是一个低三下四的警察畜生。

examples.text: That's your fault for foisting the brute on us.
examples.translation: 你真不该把那个畜生带到咱们这个圈子里来！

examples.text: We all wait to punish the brute.
examples.translation: 我们都想惩罚那个残忍的人。

examples.text: Brute force was used to put down the revolt.
examples.translation: 使用残忍的武力平息反叛。

examples.text: Carole, could it be that Dog is more of a brute than a bigot?
examples.translation: 卡洛尔，会不会是狗更多地是一种简单粗暴的比比戈？

examples.text: A bubble will burst at the slighsett touch.
examples.translation: 气泡稍微一碰就破。

examples.text: His hope vanished like a bubble.
examples.translation: 他的希望化作泡影。

examples.text: He didn't want to burst the newcomer's bubble.
examples.translation: 他不想打破这个新来者的不切实际的美梦。

examples.text: The water in the pan was beginning to bubble.
examples.translation: 锅里的水开始起泡。

examples.text: The gas bubbled to the surface of the water.
examples.translation: 气体变成气泡升上水面。

examples.text: The water began to bubble in the teapot.
examples.translation: 水在茶壶里开始沸腾。

examples.text: On hearing the news, he was bubbling over with excitement.
examples.translation: 听到那个消息,他激动万分。

examples.text: Go and fill this bucket with water for me.
examples.translation: 去替我装满一桶水来。

examples.text: He came down the hill carrying a bucket of water.
examples.translation: 他提著一桶水下山来了。

examples.text: I knocked over the bucket and the water poured (out) all over the floor.
examples.translation: 我打翻了水桶，水流了一地。

examples.text: They buy tickets by the bucket and sell them at a profit.
examples.translation: 他们买了很多票,并且再卖掉以获取利润。

examples.text: The old car bucketed along at about thirty.
examples.translation: 那辆旧车以30公里左右的时速行驶。

examples.text: The rain bucketed down.
examples.translation: 大雨倾盆。

examples.text: The girl was bucketing water from the well.
examples.translation: 那姑娘在用桶从井里打水。

examples.text: The roses are in bud.
examples.translation: 玫瑰花正含苞待放。

examples.text: Summertime bud grafting can be cut take shoot piece, or take xylem shoot less piece, in stock bine dry place decorticates.
examples.translation: 夏季芽接可削取芽片,或少带木质部芽片,在砧木茎干处剥皮。

examples.text: The bud developed into a blossom.
examples.translation: 花蕾开出了鲜花。

examples.text: The magnolia tree is in bud already.
examples.translation: 木兰树已经长出花蕾了。

examples.text: Trees begin to bud in the spring.
examples.translation: 树在春天开始发芽。

examples.text: The plants began to bud in early April.
examples.translation: 植物在4月初开始发芽。

examples.text: They will bud and blossom and bear fruit.
examples.translation: 它们将萌芽,开花和结果。

examples.text: Some flowers bud their leaves very early in spring.
examples.translation: 有些花在春季里很早发出叶来。

meanings.meaning: 建造；开发；创建；逐渐增强

examples.text: That house is built of bricks.
examples.translation: 那座房子是砖造的。

examples.text: It is not an easy task to build a business.
examples.translation: 创业并不是一件容易的事情。

examples.text: We should study hard to build a better future for ourselves.
examples.translation: 我们应该努力学习,为自己创造更美好的未来。

examples.text: His analysis build up their confidence.
examples.translation: 他的分析增强了他们的信心。

examples.text: We must build up a reserve fund to meet emergencies.
examples.translation: 我们必须逐渐积累一笔储蓄以备急需。

examples.text: She really did not have the build for a ballerina.
examples.translation: 她实际上并没有一个芭蕾舞女演员的体格。

examples.text: That girl is of proportional build and is beautiful.
examples.translation: 那少女身材匀称，长相漂亮。

examples.text: The heat had blistered the paint of the building.
examples.translation: 酷热使建筑物上的油漆起了浮泡。

examples.text: The building faces north.
examples.translation: 这栋建筑物朝北。

examples.text: The building does not conform to safety regulations.
examples.translation: 这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

examples.text: Houses and churches are buildings.
examples.translation: 房子和教堂是建筑物。

examples.text: The erection of the building took several months.
examples.translation: 建造这座建筑物花了好几个月时间。

examples.text: The force of the explosion broke all the windows in the building.
examples.translation: 爆炸的力量震碎了这座建筑上的所有窗户。

examples.text: Onions and lilies grow from bulbs.
examples.translation: 洋葱和百合是从球茎中长出的。

examples.text: This light bulb has gone.
examples.translation: 这灯泡不亮了。

examples.text: The light bulb imploded.
examples.translation: 这灯泡是向内侧爆裂的。

examples.text: I can see clearly that the filament in the bulb is broken.
examples.translation: 我可以很清楚地看到灯泡里的细丝断了。

meanings.meaning: 体积；容积；大块；大部分；大批

examples.text: It's not their weight that makes these sacks hard to carry, it's their bulk.
examples.translation: 这些袋子难以搬运,倒不是因为重而是体积太大。

examples.text: He heaved his huge bulk out of the chair.
examples.translation: 他挺起巨大的身躯，从椅子上站了起来。

examples.text: The bulk of the work has already been done.
examples.translation: 大部分工作已经完成。

examples.text: The great bulk of necessary work can never be anything but painful.
examples.translation: 大量必须做的工作真令人痛苦。

examples.text: We can manage some bulk carrier within two week.
examples.translation: 我们可在两周内安排一些散装船去。

examples.text: I recommend you a bulk buy.
examples.translation: 我建议你大量购买。

examples.text: A dozen petticoats bulked out her figure.
examples.translation: 十几条衬裙把她的身体撑得圆鼓鼓的。

examples.text: The cake bulked up.
examples.translation: 蛋糕发起来了。

examples.text: The war still bulks large in the memories of those who fought in it.
examples.translation: 对于那些曾参战的人来说,那场战争仍记忆犹新。

examples.text: He grunted as the bullet hit him.
examples.translation: 子弹击中他时他疼得哼了出来。

examples.text: A bullet whizzed past my ear.
examples.translation: 一颗子弹嗖的一声从我耳边飞过。

examples.text: The bullet went clean through his arm.
examples.translation: 子弹穿过他的手臂。

examples.text: The bullet hit him in the chest.
examples.translation: 子弹击中了他的胸膛。

examples.text: The bullet was expelled from the gun.
examples.translation: 子弹从枪中射出。

examples.text: So far there is no magic bullet for economic woes.
examples.translation: 到目前为止还没有解决经济困难的妙法。

examples.text: I bought a bunch of grapes.
examples.translation: 我买了一串葡萄。

examples.text: He gave a bunch of flowers to his girlfriend.
examples.translation: 他送给女友一束花。

examples.text: He goes round with a bunch of thugs.
examples.translation: 他经常和一帮流氓厮混。

examples.text: Be sure not to bunch the flowers up tightly.
examples.translation: 务必不要把花束捆得太紧。

examples.text: Don't bunch up all the candlesticks in one corner of the shelf.
examples.translation: 不要把蜡烛台全部捆在一起放在架子的一个角上。

examples.text: His arm muscles bunch out when he lift the stone lion.
examples.translation: 他举起石狮时臂上的肌肉一块一块隆起。

examples.text: Spread out more. Don't bunch up on the centre.
examples.translation: 再散开一点，不要都挤在中间。

meanings.meaning: 捆；把 ... 扎成一捆；匆忙地走

examples.text: He collected a bundle of sticks.
examples.translation: 他收集了一捆树枝。

examples.text: I see a bundle of firewood on the floor.
examples.translation: 我看见了一捆劈柴在地板上。

examples.text: On the table there is a bundle of flower.
examples.translation: 桌子上有一束花。

examples.text: My uncle sent me a large bundle on my birthday.
examples.translation: 我生日时叔父给我寄来一个大包裹。

examples.text: The heavy bundle bore him down.
examples.translation: 那包东西很重，压得他直不起腰。

examples.text: That car must have cost a bundle.
examples.translation: 这辆汽车一定值很多钱。

examples.text: Can you bundle up the sheets for me?
examples.translation: 你能替我将这些单子捆起来吗?

examples.text: She bundled her son off to school.
examples.translation: 她匆匆忙忙把儿子打发到学校去了。

meanings.meaning: 负担；责任；装载量；主题；[音乐]副歌

examples.text: The burden on his back seemed to be crushing him to the earth.
examples.translation: 他背上的重负似乎要把他压倒在地。

examples.text: People on high incomes face a huge tax burden.
examples.translation: 高收入的人面临着沉重的纳税负担。

examples.text: The burden of organizing the campaign fell to me.
examples.translation: 组织这次活动的责任落到了我头上。

examples.text: I don't want to lay a burden on you.
examples.translation: 我不想让你承担责任。

examples.text: The burden of his argument was that life is precious.
examples.translation: 他论证的要点是生命是宝贵的。

examples.text: I don't want to burden you with my problem.
examples.translation: 我不想让我的问题给你添麻烦。

meanings.meaning: 局；办事处；(带抽屉的）写字台

examples.text: He works in this bureau.
examples.translation: 他在这个局工作过。

examples.text: The travel bureau is not so far from here.
examples.translation: 旅游局离这里不远。

examples.text: He worked in a travel bureau.
examples.translation: 他在一家旅行社工作。

examples.text: He picked up that bureau at a second-hand store.
examples.translation: 这个柜子是他在一家旧货店买的。

meanings.meaning: 燃烧；烧着；烧毁；灼伤；急于

examples.text: Half the candle had burnt away.
examples.translation: 蜡烛已烧去一半。

examples.text: It's better to burn out than to fade away!
examples.translation: 与其慢慢凋谢,不如灿烂燃烧!

examples.text: Paper burns easily.
examples.translation: 纸容易着火。

examples.text: If the satellite returns to earth too fast, it will burn up on the way.
examples.translation: 如果人造卫星返回地球太快,它在归途中就会烧毁了。

examples.text: He is going to scalp me or burn me at the stake.
examples.translation: 他要剥掉我的头皮或是在火刑柱上烧我。

examples.text: She is burning to tell you the news.
examples.translation: 她急于要告诉你这消息。

examples.text: Tell him to put cold water on the burn.
examples.translation: 告诉他,在烧伤处敷凉水。

examples.text: He died of the burns he received in the fire.
examples.translation: 他因在火灾中受烧伤而死。

examples.text: It seems that matter is lost when fuels burn.
examples.translation: 似乎燃料燃烧时物质就消失了。

examples.text: Coal of this quality doesn't burn very easily.
examples.translation: 这种品质的煤不容易燃烧。

examples.text: There was a burst of laughter in the next room.
examples.translation: 隔壁房间里突然爆发出一阵笑声。

examples.text: The pipe burst and a spout of water shoot out.
examples.translation: 水管破裂了，一股水喷了出来。

examples.text: Prices went up and up in recent years, before the housing bubble burst.
examples.translation: 最近几年价格持续上涨，直到房价泡沫的破裂。

examples.text: I've eaten so much I'm bursting at the seams.
examples.translation: 我吃得太多了，肚子都要撑破了。

examples.text: The boy blew the paper bag out and burst it.
examples.translation: 那男孩把纸袋吹胀后又把它弄破了。

examples.translation: 我觉得自己高兴得心花怒放。

examples.text: And then in one climactic burst of sound they surged forward.
examples.translation: 突然间纵声大呼，疾冲而出。

examples.translation: 警察破门而入。

meanings.meaning: 埋葬；隐匿；专心致志；抛弃

examples.text: Even if you kill me, even if you bury me, I should rise again.
examples.translation: 即使你杀了我

examples.text: The funeral is tomorrow and they will bury the body after the church service.
examples.translation: 葬礼明天举行，他们会在教堂仪式后埋葬遗体。

examples.text: He likes to bury himself in the country.
examples.translation: 他喜欢隐居乡间。

examples.text: She had learnt to bury her feelings.
examples.translation: 她已经学会了感情不外露。

examples.text: You will have to bury yourself in your studies if you want to pass the exam.
examples.translation: 如果你想通过考试，就得专心致志地学习。

examples.text: He was sitting with his head buried in a book.
examples.translation: 他坐着埋头看书。

examples.text: Just bury the hatchet and go have a drink together!
examples.translation: 别吵了，一起去喝一杯吧！

examples.text: He scrabbled about in the bush for the ball.
examples.translation: 他在灌木丛中爬着到处找球。

examples.translation: 野兔从灌木丛中突然窜了出来。

examples.text: There is some ice in the bush.
examples.translation: 树丛里有些冰。

examples.translation: 他用大剪刀几下子就把灌木给修剪好了。

examples.text: The soldier saw a gun jutting out from a bush.
examples.translation: 那士兵看见一支枪从矮树丛伸出来。

examples.text: I can't pull this bush up, it's firmly rooted in the ground.
examples.translation: 这棵矮树我拔不起来。它的根在地里生得很牢。

examples.translation: 有很多关于布什的有趣的故事。

examples.text: If you cut off some of the branches,the tree would not bush out.
examples.translation: 如果你砍掉一些树枝的话，这棵树就不会枝杈丛生。

examples.text: They have gone ahead to bush out a safe way across the frozen lake.
examples.translation: 他们已到前面去了，在冰封的湖面上用树枝标出一条安全通道。

examples.text: He had no head for business.
examples.translation: 他毫无商业头脑。

examples.text: He was inexperienced in business.
examples.translation: 他在商业方面缺乏经验。

examples.text: I don't understand this business.
examples.translation: 我不了解这件事。

examples.text: They've done some business together.
examples.translation: 他们一起做过生意。

examples.text: Business is always brisk before Christmas.
examples.translation: 圣诞节前生意总是很兴隆。

examples.text: Our world is but a small part of the cosmos.
examples.translation: 我们的世界仅仅是宇宙的一小部分而已。

examples.text: He's still but a child.
examples.translation: 他仅仅是个小孩子。

examples.text: I want to say nothing but sorry.
examples.translation: 我只想说对不起。

examples.text: He can but admit that it was his fault.
examples.translation: 他只得承认这是他的错误。

examples.translation: 屠夫砍下一块冻肉的肋条。

examples.translation: 希特勒是有史以来最大的侩子手。

examples.translation: 肉商将为你准备加工好的鸡。

examples.translation: 肉铺热天散发出腥臭味。

examples.text: Many western countries raise and butcher a large number of beef cattle.
examples.translation: 许多西方国家饲养并屠宰大量的肉牛。

examples.text: They butchered the war prisoners.
examples.translation: 他们残杀战俘。

examples.text: Don't butcher that song by singing off key.
examples.translation: 别唱走调而糟蹋了那首歌。

examples.translation: 她用奶油做法国式的蛋卷。

examples.translation: 我会给面包涂上黄油。

A butterfly must not be confused with a moth.
examples.translation: 不得将蝴蝶和飞蛾混同起来。

examples.translation: 毛虫是蝴蝶的幼体。

examples.text: A butterfly is flying up and down among the flowers.
examples.translation: 有一只蝴蝶正在花丛里忽上忽下地飞着。

examples.translation: 蝶泳的泳姿动作要领是什么?

examples.translation: 把鱼翻过来，切开、摊平，然后放到炉子上。

examples.translation: 我上衣上的一颗扣子掉了。

examples.text: You may stop the machine by pushing this button.
examples.translation: 按下这个按钮你就可以关掉这个机器。

examples.text: It's very warm, he didn't even button his coat.
examples.translation: 天气很暖和,他甚至都没扣他外衣的钮扣。

examples.text: Money can't buy happiness.
examples.translation: 金钱买不来幸福。

examples.text: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.translation: 我请他喝酒以酬谢他的帮助。

examples.text: I'd like to buy a strong household bleach.
examples.translation: 我想买强力家用漂白剂。

examples.text: Don't buy a used car from that rogue.
examples.translation: 别从那无赖手里买旧车。

examples.text: They bought peace with their freedom.
examples.translation: 他们牺牲自由换取和平。

examples.text: She tried to buy time by doing a lot of talk.
examples.translation: 她企图以滔滔不绝的谈话来拖延时间。

examples.text: It's nice to know that some people can't be bought.
examples.translation: 值得高兴的是有些人并不接受贿赂。

examples.text: A lot of people just come into the shop without buying.
examples.translation: 有很多人进店但却不购物。

examples.text: That shirt was a really great buy.
examples.translation: 这个衬衫真是便宜货。

examples.text: He is busy pricking out some cabbage seedlings.
examples.translation: 他正忙于移植一些卷心菜秧。

examples.text: Cabbage could be eaten raw in salads.
examples.translation: 卷心菜可以做成沙拉生吃。

examples.text: I like to cook dishes with cabbage.
examples.translation: 我喜欢用洋白菜做菜。

examples.text: The cabbage germinated within a week.
examples.translation: 白菜一星期内就发芽了。

examples.text: Best buy of the week are carrot and cabbage, which are plentiful and cheap.
examples.translation: 本星期买胡萝卜和洋白菜最合算，因货源充足，价格低廉。

examples.text: He made out of the cabin on hearing the siren.
examples.translation: 他一听到汽笛声就立即走出船舱。

examples.text: Fine. Can you let me have a cabin for two?
examples.translation: 好的，能给我订一间二人船舱吗?

examples.text: My cabin is on E deck.
examples.translation: 我的舱位在E层甲板。

examples.text: Cabin light will be dim for takeoff.
examples.translation: 机舱灯将会因飞机起飞而变暗。

examples.text: As the plane taxies, the cabin is silent.
examples.translation: 当飞机降落滑行时，机舱内一片寂静。

examples.text: There is a bush of bramble in front of the cabin.
examples.translation: 小木屋前有一丛黑莓。

examples.text: The hunter hid in a log cabin.
examples.translation: 猎人藏在小木屋里。

examples.text: They lived in a little log cabin in the mountains.
examples.translation: 他们住在山里的一间小木屋里。

examples.text: The criminal was cabined all the day.
examples.translation: 这个犯人整天受到限制。

examples.text: The old man cabined in the forest.
examples.translation: 这位老人住在森林的小屋里。

examples.text: She needs a cherry cabinet in her room.
examples.translation: 她需要在她房里添一个樱桃木的柜子。

examples.text: I put my collection of old glasses in the cabinet.
examples.translation: 我把收集的古玻璃器皿放在橱里。

examples.text: The question was discussed in cabinet.
examples.translation: 在内阁会议上讨论了这个问题。

examples.text: They have found out the mole in the cabinet.
examples.translation: 他们已经发现了内阁中的间谍。

examples.text: The Prime Minister's cabinet colleague refused to accept the proposal.
examples.translation: 首相的内阁同僚拒绝接受这个建议。

examples.text: He was elevated to cabinet rank.
examples.translation: 他被提升到内阁部长级。

meanings.meaning: 发电报；(通过电缆)交流；(用缆绳)固定

examples.text: Cable television has been around for some time now.
examples.translation: 有线电视面世已有些时日了。

examples.text: They are building a submarine cable tunnel.
examples.translation: 他们正在建设一条海底电缆隧道。

examples.text: A number of cables are needed in this project.
examples.translation: 这项工程需要大量电缆。

examples.text: Try replacing the cable with a known working cable.
examples.translation: 试著以确定是工作良好的缆线替换缆线。

examples.text: The new ship cut her cable and slipped into the water.
examples.translation: 新船砍缆下水。

examples.text: The steel cable is an important strained component.
examples.translation: 钢缆索是一种重要的承力构件。

examples.text: The cable stays converge to a single point on the apex of the tower.
examples.translation: 纲索在塔架顶部集中在一点。

examples.translation: 我要拍一封电报,帮我拿电报表格来好吗?

examples.text: News of his death was cabled to his family.
examples.translation: 他的死讯已电告其家属。

examples.text: She cabled the good news about her arrival in Chicago.
examples.translation: 她打电报说她已顺利到达芝加哥。

examples.translation: 一个连续性测试器给电缆导线注入交流信号，从而找到电路故障。

examples.text: The cable line had brought the two continents so near that people could begin to talk to each other across the Atlantic in a fraction of a second.
examples.translation: 电缆线缩短了两大洲之间的距离，从而使人们开始能够在瞬间隔着大西洋相互交流。

examples.text: A lot of bows have set screws that hold the cable guards into the risers.
examples.translation: 很多弓有拿着缆绳卫兵入造反者的固定螺钉。

examples.text: Use the built-in cable channels to secure both your oscilloscope and extension module to your location.
examples.translation: 使用内置电缆通道来固定示波器和扩展模块到您的位置上。

examples.text: This cafe keeps late into the night.
examples.translation: 这家咖啡馆一直开到深夜。

examples.text: The uproar in the cafe lasted long after midnight.
examples.translation: 咖啡馆的喧闹一直持续到午夜之后很久。

examples.text: The police came and ejected the noisy youths from the cafe room.
examples.translation: 警察来了,把那些吵吵嚷嚷的青年人从咖啡馆里撵了出去。

examples.text: This cafe is a rendezvous for writers and artists.
examples.translation: 这家小餐馆是作家和艺术家经常聚会的地方。

examples.text: We had our lunch in a cafe and hurried back to the car.
examples.translation: 我们在一家小餐馆里吃了午饭，就又匆匆回到车上。

examples.text: They had their lunch in a cafeteria.
examples.translation: 他们在一家自助餐厅吃了午饭。

examples.text: The cafeteria is on the basement level.
examples.translation: 自助餐厅在地下一层。

examples.text: I found him work in a cafeteria by chance.
examples.translation: 我偶然发现他在一家自助餐厅工作。

examples.text: The old man wants to buy a cage for birds.
examples.translation: 老人想买一个鸟笼。

examples.text: Is it cruel to confine a bird in a cage?
examples.translation: 把鸟关在笼子里残忍不残忍?

examples.text: The hamster had got through the wire at the front of its cage.
examples.translation: 仓鼠从其笼子前部的栅栏处钻出去了。

examples.text: The canary was trilling away in its cage.
examples.translation: 那只金丝雀在笼中鸣啾。

examples.text: The lion paced the floor of his cage restlessly.
examples.translation: 狮子烦躁地在兽笼里走来走去。

examples.text: Criminals are kept in the cages on this island.
examples.translation: 刑事犯被关在岛上的牢房里。

examples.text: They placed a protective cage over the sapling.
examples.translation: 他们在树苗上罩上一个保护栏。

examples.text: You can cage a bird, but you cannot make him sing.
examples.translation: 你可以关住一只鸟，但你不能使它唱歌。

meanings.meaning: 计算；估计；考虑；推测；计划；指望

examples.text: Can you calculate the content of the tube?
examples.translation: 你能计算出试管的容量吗?

examples.text: Scientists have calculated that the world's population will double by the end of the century.
examples.translation: 科学家已推算出世界人口在本世纪末将要增加一倍。

examples.text: I calculate it's a waste of time to do that.
examples.translation: 我想做那件事简直是在浪费时间。

examples.text: The economist calculated that prices may go up again.
examples.translation: 那位经济学家推测,物价或许会再次上涨。

examples.text: This advertisement is calculated to appeal to children.
examples.translation: 这个广告是针对儿童设计的。

examples.text: We cannot calculate on his help.
examples.translation: 我们不能指望他的帮助。

examples.text: Your calculation is way off beam.
examples.translation: 你的计算大错特错。

examples.text: The calculation was difficult, but we finally cracked it.
examples.translation: 计算起来很费劲，然而我们终於解决了。

examples.text: My calculation is based on notional figures, since the actual figures are not yet available.
examples.translation: 因尚无实际数字，我是根据估计的数字计算的。

examples.text: By his calculation, we will be there in an hour.
examples.translation: 据他估计，我们一小时后到那儿。

examples.text: They made the wrong calculation of their situation.
examples.translation: 他们错误地估计了形势。

examples.text: She did a swift mental calculation.
examples.translation: 她头脑里敏捷地盘算了一下。

examples.text: After much calculation, they offered him the job.
examples.translation: 经过慎重考虑，他们把这项工作交给他了。

meanings.meaning: 日历；历法；日程表；一览表

examples.translation: 他从日历上撕下一页。

examples.translation: 另外一个称为哈伯历，或者是历法圆周。

examples.translation: 我不明白我们要怎样把这件事挤进市长满满的日程表中。

examples.translation: 世界杯足球总决赛在运动日程表中是个重要日子。

examples.translation: 助手会把下一个会面排进我的日程表。

meanings.meaning: 打电话；访问；召唤；呼叫；把 ... 看作

examples.text: The shouting boy did not hear his mother call him.
examples.translation: 大声叫嚷的孩子听不到妈妈的叫唤。

examples.text: I'll call you if you give me a name card.
examples.translation: 给我一张名片吧,我会打电话给你。

examples.text: Most people call me Bob. How do I address you?
examples.translation: 大家叫我鲍勃,我怎么称呼你?

examples.translation: 我们到达旅馆不久,就马上打电话回家。

examples.text: Tomorrow I'll pay a call on him.
examples.translation: 明天我将要去拜访他。

examples.text: The President made a call for national unity.
examples.translation: 总统号召全国人民团结起来。

examples.text: The call of this bird is very loud.
examples.translation: 这只鸟的叫声很响亮。

examples.text: But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
examples.translation: 但神已经指示我，无论什么人，都不可看作俗而不洁净的。

examples.text: She called to her father for help.
examples.translation: 她向她父亲喊叫求救。

examples.text: I'll certainly call on you if I come again.
examples.translation: 再来的话,一定去拜访你。

examples.text: The calm sea gave no hint of the storm that was coming.
examples.translation: 平静的海上没有一点迹象显示暴风雨即将来临。

examples.text: She always remains cool, calm and collected in a crisis.
examples.translation: 她在危难中总能保持冷静、 平静和镇静。

examples.translation: 即使面临危险，你也应当保持镇静。

examples.translation: 由于被她那些话所感动,他很难平静下来。

examples.translation: 上台表演前,每个人都,让自己平静下来。

examples.translation: 在精神病院里,医生也常常让病患听一些很柔和的音乐,使他们的情绪稳定下来。

examples.text: Under his apparent calm lay real anxiety.
examples.translation: 他表面镇静,内心焦虑。

examples.text: The sea had continued calm until a hurricane rose.
examples.translation: 飓风来临之前,海面一直平静。

examples.text: The hall was very quiet, but it was the calm before the storm.
examples.translation: 大厅里一片安静,但这是暴风雨前的平静。

examples.text: Instantly the baby girl responds.The pulse rate becomes calm and steady.
examples.translation: 小女孩立刻有了反应，她的脉搏开始变地平稳。

examples.text: You can be called into action with the knowledge that can bring calm to a changing planet.
examples.translation: 你能够以知识发动进入行动那将能带著平稳去一个改变中的行星。

examples.translation: 骆驼是一种食草动物。

examples.translation: 商人决定用骆驼载运货物穿过沙漠。

examples.translation: 最受欢迎的自然是驼色。

examples.translation: 他们在山中野营度过夏天。

examples.translation: 他们正在策划一个新的反贪污运动。

examples.translation: 攻占这个城市的战役失败了。

examples.translation: 我们在整个冬季战役中始终不如对手。

examples.translation: 我希望你们都为新的销售活动做好准备。

examples.translation: 他在商务活动中惨遭挫折。

examples.translation: 总统竞选运动正在全力进行中。

examples.translation: 我们最近15年一直参加反对捕鲸的运动。

examples.translation: 我们在政府中正开展反贪污运动。

examples.translation: 他们正开展一场反对在这个地区进行房地产开发的运动。

examples.translation: 那道清炖牛肉胡萝卜的菜味道不错。

examples.text: You should eat such vegetables as carrot, celery and spinach.
examples.translation: 你应该吃胡萝卜、芹菜和菠菜这类的蔬菜。

examples.text: The myth that eating carrot improved your eyesight was exploded years ago.
examples.translation: 认为吃胡萝卜可以改善视力的海外奇谈，多年前已祛除殆尽。

meanings.meaning: 携带；运送；搬运；带有；传播；承载

examples.text: She came in carrying an important-looking piece of paper.
examples.translation: 她进来时,拿着一份看来很重要的文件。

examples.text: This is a dangerous area, so don't carry too much cash on you.
examples.translation: 这个地区很危险，所以你身上不要带太多现金。

examples.text: Pipes carry oil across the desert to the east.
examples.translation: 输油管把石油经过沙漠运送到东部。

examples.text: His voice carries the ring of authority.
examples.translation: 他的声音中带有权威的口气。

examples.text: Many dangerous diseases are carried by insects.
examples.translation: 许多危险的疾病是由昆虫传播的。

examples.text: This radio station does not carry any advertising.
examples.translation: 这家广播电台不播送任何广告。

examples.text: Crimes of violence carry heavy penalties.
examples.translation: 暴力罪行要承受严厉的惩罚。

meanings.meaning: 【C】(二轮或四轮)运货马车；手推车
(用手推车)运送；(用力；粗鲁地)拖

examples.text: Don't put the cart before the horse.
examples.translation: [谚]勿本末倒置。

examples.text: The heavy cart rumbled down the street.
examples.translation: 笨重的马车辘辘地在街上走过。

examples.text: The cart is piled high with fruit and vegetables.
examples.translation: 马车上堆满了水果和蔬菜。

examples.text: They were shoveling coal into a cart.
examples.translation: 他们在把煤铲进手推车。

examples.text: The cart rattled over the cobbled street.
examples.translation: 手推车吱嘎吱嘎地走在圆石路上。

examples.text: We had to cart our luggage up six flights of stairs.
examples.translation: 我们得把行李提着上六段楼梯。

examples.text: The statue was carved out of marble.
examples.translation: 这座雕像是用大理石雕刻的。

examples.text: We will look for a pumpkin, to carve into a jack-o-lantern.
examples.translation: 我们将要找一颗南瓜来雕刻成南瓜灯。

examples.text: He carved me some very nice pieces of chicken.
examples.translation: 他为我切了几块很好的鸡肉。

examples.text: It's your turn to carve the meat.
examples.translation: 该你来把肉切开了。

meanings.meaning: 例子；情况；案例；（辩论或诉讼）论据；箱

examples.text: Talk of wasting money, my buying this car is a case in point.
examples.translation: 谈到浪费钱财,我买这台车就是个恰当的例子。

examples.text: But that is not always the case, sometimes the table can turn.
examples.translation: 但事情并不一定都是这样,有时情况会发生改变。

examples.text: The case involved charges of police corruption.
examples.translation: 这个案子涉及对警方腐败的控诉。

examples.text: The judge quotes various cases in support of his opinion.
examples.translation: 法官引证了各种案例来支持他的判决理由。

examples.text: I think you can win because you have a very strong case.
examples.translation: 我认为你能赢,因为你的论据很有力。

examples.text: We ordered 3 cases of beer for the party.
examples.translation: 我们为晚会定购了三箱啤酒。

examples.text: The goods have been cased up for transport.
examples.translation: 货物已装箱待运。

examples.text: The thieves cased Wilson's house before the robbery.
examples.translation: 那些盗贼在抢劫前窥探了威尔逊的住宅。

examples.text: He felt he had the situation cased well enough.
examples.translation: 他感觉到他已经对局面作了相当详尽的估计。

examples.text: Case it around before you leave.
examples.translation: 离开这里之前，转转察看一下。

examples.text: He paid the cash into his bank account.
examples.translation: 他把现金存入银行帐户。

examples.text: I have no cash on me. Can I pay you later?
examples.translation: 我没带现金,我能否以后付给你?

examples.text: Sorry, you can't sign the bill here, cash only, please.
examples.translation: 对不起,我们这里不可以签单,请付现款吧。

examples.text: The bank has to verify your identity before you cash your check.
examples.translation: 银行必须要先核实您的身份然后再为您兑现支票。

examples.text: The merchant's cash sales each day were $300.
examples.translation: 那店主一天有300美元的现金售货收入。

examples.text: The shop has a cash flow of$30,000 a month.
examples.translation: 这家商店的流动现金为每月三万美元。

examples.text: Cassette tape recorders are gradually out of date now.
examples.translation: 现在,盒式磁带录音机渐渐过时了。

examples.text: He bought a new cassette recorder.
examples.translation: 他买了一台新的盒式录音机。

examples.text: There is a little window in the cassette case so that you can see the tape.
examples.translation: 盒式音像带上有个小窗，能看见里面的磁带。

examples.text: I rewound the cassette and played her voice back to her.
examples.translation: 我把录音带转回去，把她的声音放给她听。

meanings.meaning: 掷；抛；投；铸造；指定演员；加起来；投射(目光)；投(票)；预测
演员阵容；投掷；[医]固定用敷料

examples.text: The angler cast her line into the stream.
examples.translation: 那个垂钓者把鱼线掷进了小溪里。

examples.text: The storm cast the little rowboat onto the rocks.
examples.translation: 风暴把这条小划艇抛到岩石上。

examples.text: The two world wars cast a shadow over the people all over the world.
examples.translation: 两次世界大战在全世界人民中投下了阴影。

examples.text: The metals most frequently cast are iron, steal, aluminum and so on.
examples.translation: 最常用来铸造的金属是铁、钢、铝等。

examples.text: The director began to cast actors for the movie.
examples.translation: 导演开始给演员分配这部电影中的角色。

examples.text: I'll cast up these figures and tell you the total.
examples.translation: 我要把这些数字加起来把总数告诉你。

examples.text: All eyes were cast upon the speaker.
examples.translation: 所有的目光投射在说话者身上。

examples.text: The sales department have forecasted the expenditure in an approximate way.
examples.translation: 销售部门针对经费开支进行了粗略的预测。

examples.text: The play succeeded thanks to the wonderful performance of all the cast.
examples.translation: 由于演员们的精彩表演,这部戏获得了成功。

examples.text: The cast of the line is crucial to fly fishing.
examples.translation: 如何投掷鱼线对飞钓来说很关键。

examples.text: The doctor had to hold his broken arm with a plaster cast.
examples.translation: 医生不得不用石膏绷带来固定他断了的胳膊。

meanings.meaning: 置于城堡中；(棋)移动王车易位

examples.text: A spirit haunts the castle.
examples.translation: 幽灵常出没于古堡。

examples.text: The mist eddied round the old castle.
examples.translation: 薄雾在那座古老的城堡的周围打转转。

examples.text: The castle has fallen into decay in the last100 years.
examples.translation: 这座古堡在近100年里渐渐荒废了。

examples.text: The prince lived in a large and beautiful castle.
examples.translation: 王子住在一个美丽的大城堡里。

examples.text: A thick forest girdled the castle about.
examples.translation: 一片浓密的森林包围着城堡。

meanings.meaning: 非正式的；漫不经心的；偶然的；临时的；休闲的

examples.text: The plan grew out of a casual conversation.
examples.translation: 这个计划出自于一次非正式的谈话。

examples.text: He sidled past, trying to seem casual.
examples.translation: 他悄悄地溜了过去,竭力装作漫不经心的样子。

examples.text: She is casual about winning the prize.
examples.translation: 她对获奖漫不经心。

examples.text: A casual newspaper reader wouldn't like articles on politics everyday.
examples.translation: 不经心的报纸读者不会喜欢每天都有政论文章。

examples.text: He described himself as a casual acquaintance of the Kennedys'.
examples.translation: 他称自己是肯尼迪夫妇的泛泛之交。

examples.text: He took casual job to support the family.
examples.translation: 他做些临时性的工作来养家。

examples.text: They earn their livings by casual labour.
examples.translation: 他们靠做短工为生。

meanings.meaning: 猫；猫科动物；狠毒的女人；吊锚机；独桅船；九尾鞭

examples.text: A cat mews.
examples.translation: 猫喵喵叫。

examples.text: The cat lapped up the milk.
examples.translation: 猫舔食牛奶。

examples.text: The cat is playing with a live mouse.
examples.translation: 猫在戏弄那只活老鼠。

examples.text: Don't listen to her gossip; she is a cat.
examples.translation: 别听她搬弄是非，她是个心地恶毒的女人。

examples.text: He supported a flogging with the cat as punishment.
examples.translation: 他忍受了一场九尾鞭的狠狠鞭打，以示惩戒。

meanings.meaning: 目录；大学概况手册；商品型录
做目录；分类说明；名入列表

examples.text: You can look for the book in the library catalog.
examples.translation: 你可以在图书馆的图书目录上查找这本书。

examples.text: These names are to be listed in the catalog.
examples.translation: 这些名字将列入目录。

examples.text: Please show me a catalog of your books.
examples.translation: 请拿一本图书目录给我看看。

examples.text: Has the Harvard catalog come yet?
examples.translation: 哈佛大学简介来了吗？

examples.text: The store send us a new catalog of its merchandise.
examples.translation: 商店寄给我们一份新的商品目录。

examples.text: All the prices in the catalog are subject to our final confirmation.
examples.translation: 刘:商品目录上的所有价格以我方最后确认为准。

examples.text: Can you catalog all these books?
examples.translation: 你能给所有这些书编目录吗？

examples.text: This stamp catalogues at two dollars.
examples.translation: 这张邮票的目录价格为2美元。

examples.text: Photography is strictly forbidden in the cathedral.
examples.translation: 教堂内严禁摄影。

examples.text: This street offers a fine vista of the cathedral.
examples.translation: 这条街的尽头是个大教堂，远远望去非常好看。

examples.text: The dome of St. Paul Cathedral is well known in the world.
examples.translation: 圣保罗教堂的圆顶闻名于世。

examples.text: This cathedral was regarded as a miracle in architectural history.
examples.translation: 这座大教堂被认为是建筑史上的奇迹。

examples.text: There is much forage for the cattle.
examples.translation: 那儿有很多喂牛的饲料。

examples.text: There are many herds of cattle in the meadow.
examples.translation: 牧场上有许多牛群。

examples.text: Clover can be grown as food for cattle.
examples.translation: 苜蓿可以用作牛饲料。

examples.text: He lives on a farm, so he knows a lot about cattle.
examples.translation: 他住在农场，所以对家畜知之甚多。

examples.text: We wintered our cattle in the warm valley.
examples.translation: 冬天我们在温暖的山谷中饲养家畜。

examples.text: Those poor soldiers died like cattle, without a struggle.
examples.translation: 那些可怜的士兵未经抵抗，就象畜生一般死了。

examples.text: Smoking can cause lung cancer.
examples.translation: 吸烟可致肺癌。

examples.text: She is always causing trouble for people.
examples.translation: 她总是给人添麻烦。

examples.text: Police are investigating the causes of the explosion.
examples.translation: 警方正在调查爆炸的原因。

examples.text: You have no cause for complaint.
examples.translation: 你没有理由抱怨。

examples.text: World peace is a cause we should all work for.
examples.translation: 争取世界和平是一项我们都应该为之而努力的事业。

examples.text: She is willing to donate money to a worthy cause.
examples.translation: 她愿为高尚的事业捐款。

examples.text: This cave was used by smugglersin the eighteenth century.
examples.translation: 这个洞穴是十八世纪走私的人使用的。

examples.text: The cliffs are riddled with caves.
examples.translation: 岩壁上布满洞穴。

examples.text: We kindled a firebrand in the cave.
examples.translation: 我们在山洞里点燃火把。

examples.text: The boys huddled together in the cave to keep warm.
examples.translation: 男孩子们在山洞里挤成一团取暖。

examples.text: The roof of the old house caved in.
examples.translation: 那栋旧房子的屋顶塌下了。

examples.text: The enemy had to cave in and surrender.
examples.translation: 敌人只好屈服投降。

examples.text: They refused to cave in to the terrorists'demands.
examples.translation: 他们拒绝向恐怖分子的要求屈服。

examples.text: He was going to cease working for them.
examples.translation: 他将不再为他们干活。

examples.text: When can we cease from our labours?
examples.translation: 我们什么时候才能免除劳役之苦?

examples.text: The old man ceased breathing the night before.
examples.translation: 老人前一天晚上停止了呼吸。

examples.text: The newspaper had ceased publication.
examples.translation: 报纸已停刊。

examples.text: As suddenly as it began, the rain ceased.
examples.translation: 雨突然而来，骤然而止。

examples.text: When you cease to dream you cease to live.
examples.translation: 如果你停止了梦想,生命也就停止了。

examples.text: We worked without cease to get the project finished on time.
examples.translation: 我们不停地生产以便按时完成计划

examples.text: He cracked his nut on the ceiling.
examples.translation: 他的头让天花板碰破了。

examples.text: The low ceiling of the room gave me a feeling of oppression.
examples.translation: 低矮的屋顶给我一种压抑的感觉。

examples.text: It took more or less a whole day to paint the ceiling.
examples.translation: 粉刷天花板用了将近一整天的时间。

examples.text: This ceiling has a carved panel.
examples.translation: 这块天花板带有刻花镶板。

examples.text: My bedroom is a large room with a high ceiling.
examples.translation: 我的卧室是一个天花板很高的大房间。

examples.text: We need to set a ceiling on the price of corn.
examples.translation: 我们得给玉米价格设个上限。

examples.text: The management had set a ceiling for the rate of payrises that year.
examples.translation: 那一年，管理层对工资的增长率设定了一个上限。

examples.text: The government has set a wages and prices ceiling of 10%.
examples.translation: 政府规定工资和物价提高的最高限度为10%25.

examples.text: Let's celebrate!
examples.translation: 让我们好好庆祝一下吧！

examples.text: People in the city held a great party to celebrate their victory.
examples.translation: 本市的市民举行了盛大的晚会庆祝他们的胜利。

examples.text: They had a family feast to celebrate it.
examples.translation: 他们举办家宴以示庆贺。

examples.text: He read us a sonnet that celebrates love.
examples.translation: 他给我们读了一首歌颂爱情的十四行诗。

examples.text: Odysseus's heroic exploits are celebrated in The Odyssey'.
examples.translation: 《奥德赛》史诗中歌颂了奥德修斯的丰功伟绩。

meanings.meaning: 单人牢房；小房间；细胞；蜂房的巢室；电池；政治小组；(计算机电子表格的)单元格；手机

examples.text: The prisoner was locked in a cell.
examples.translation: 那囚犯被关在单人牢房内。

examples.text: She was found prostrate on the floor of the cell.
examples.translation: 有人发现她趴在小屋的地板上。

examples.text: The cancer cell may invade other parts of the body.
examples.translation: 癌细胞可能侵袭身体的其他部分。

examples.text: There is a queen bee in the cell.
examples.translation: 蜂房里有一只蜂王。

examples.text: I have to buy a new dry cell.
examples.translation: 我必须买一节新的干电池了。

examples.text: An al-qaeda sleeper cell may have used Arizona as its base.
examples.translation: 基地组织的一个潜伏小组可能将亚利桑那州作为其基地。

examples.text: The cell is running out of juice.
examples.translation: 手机要没电了。

examples.text: This wine cellar stays at an even temperature all year round.
examples.translation: 这个酒窖常年保持恒温。

examples.text: The cellar floods whenever it rains heavily.
examples.translation: 一下大雨地窖里就灌满了水。

examples.text: The cheese molded in the damp cellar.
examples.translation: 乳酪在潮湿的地下室中长了霉。

examples.text: They were ensconced in the cellar.
examples.translation: 他们躲在地下室里。

examples.text: The plumber went down to the cellar to fix the leaky pipe.
examples.translation: 管道工到地下室去修漏水的管子。

examples.text: The wine has been cellared for ten years.
examples.translation: 酒在地窖里存了十年。

meanings.meaning: 水泥；纽带；接合剂；牙骨质；补牙物；基石

examples.text: The sack of cement hit the ground with a thump.
examples.translation: 水泥袋砰的一声落在地上。

examples.text: Custom was in early days the cement of society.
examples.translation: 习俗是早期社会维系的纽带。

examples.text: The floor has been cemented over.
examples.translation: 地板上铺了一层水泥。

examples.text: They decided to cement the pavement.
examples.translation: 他们决定在人行道上铺上水泥。

examples.text: The arrangement will contribute to cement our pleasant relationship.
examples.translation: 此项安排将有助于巩固我们良好的关系。

examples.text: Our object is to further cement trade relations.
examples.translation: 我们的目标是进一步加强贸易关系。

examples.text: Snow is cementing.
examples.translation: 雪正在凝结。

examples.text: I'm a hundred per cent certain.
examples.translation: 我百分之百地肯定。

examples.text: I don't have a cent with me.
examples.translation: 我身上一分钱也没有。

examples.text: The coins of the lowest denomination is the cent.
examples.translation: 钱币的最低单位是分。

examples.text: This thermometer is calibrated by centigrade.
examples.translation: 这种温度计是用摄氏百分度标定的。

examples.text: It is therefore usually expressed in percentage terms rather than in engineering units such as degrees centigrade.
examples.translation: 因此它往往用一个百分比来表示而不是机械单位如百分度表示。

examples.text: (1) Round each measurement to the nearest whole inch or centimetre.
examples.translation: (1) 将每个测量数目四舍五入到最近的英寸或厘米整数。

meanings.meaning: 中心的；中央的；主要的；起支配作用的；有控制力的；[语]中央元音的
中心枢纽；中央办公室；电话交换机

examples.text: My house is very central.
examples.translation: 我的家非常靠近市中心。

examples.text: What's the central thought of this article?
examples.translation: 这篇文章的中心思想是什么？

examples.text: She stays in a small hotel near central park.
examples.translation: 她住在中央公园附近的一家小旅馆。

examples.text: She has been a central figure in the campaign.
examples.translation: 她一直是这场运动的主要人物。

examples.text: The organization has a central office in York.
examples.translation: 该组织在约克设有总部。

examples.text: That new shopping centre is a real eyesore.
examples.translation: 那个新的购物中心真是难看极了。

examples.text: The new library was built in the centre of the campus.
examples.translation: 新图书馆建在校园的中心。

examples.text: Children like to be the centre of attention.
examples.translation: 儿童喜欢引人注意.

examples.text: Please centre the subheads.
examples.translation: 小标题一律居中。

examples.text: Our thoughts centre upon one idea.
examples.translation: 我们的思想集中在一个主意上。

examples.text: Our thoughts centre upon this important problem.
examples.translation: 我们的思想集中在这个重要问题上。

examples.text: Pupils are the centre parts of one's eyes.
examples.translation: 瞳孔是人眼的中心部位。

examples.text: The building stands cheek by jowl with the centre square.
examples.translation: 这幢建筑坐落在紧紧靠着中心广场的地方。

examples.text: Only centre government has the power to mobilize the country's economic resources.
examples.translation: 只有中央政府才有权力调动国家的经济资源。

examples.text: This book was written centuries ago.
examples.translation: 这本书是几百年前写的。

examples.text: Many centuries have passed since that time.
examples.translation: 从那时起，几百年过去了。

examples.text: The palace was built in the fifteenth century.
examples.translation: 这宫殿建于十五世纪。

examples.text: It was considered as the best novel of the century.
examples.translation: 这本书是那个世纪最好的一部小说。

examples.text: The marriage ceremony took place in the church.
examples.translation: 婚礼在教堂举行。

examples.text: They hold a mystic religious ceremony.
examples.translation: 他们举行了一个神秘的宗教仪式。

examples.text: There's no need for ceremony between friends.
examples.translation: 朋友之间不必拘礼.

examples.text: What the old headmaster said at the graduation ceremony dwells in my mind.
examples.translation: 老校长在毕业典礼上讲的话一直留在我的脑海里。

examples.text: The ceremony went off without a hitch.
examples.translation: 典礼进行得很顺利。

meanings.meaning: 确定的；肯定的；某事；某人；某种；（与人名连用；表示不认识此人）一位叫...；特定的；轻微的；微小的

examples.text: It's certain that every effect must have a cause.
examples.translation: 无疑，每个结果必定有其原因。

examples.text: I can tell you for certain that I am always honest.
examples.translation: 我可以肯定地告诉你, 我一向是老实的。

examples.text: Certain things are still open to discussion.
examples.translation: 有些事还需要商量。

examples.text: For certain reasons I will be unable to attend the meeting.
examples.translation: 因为某种原因，我不能出席这次会议。

examples.text: A certain Mr Brown telephoned while you were out.
examples.translation: 你出去的时候

examples.text: To a certain extent, I'm in favor of your project.
examples.translation: 从某种程度上说,我赞成你的方案。

examples.text: There was a certain coldness in her attitude towards me.
examples.translation: 她对我的态度有点儿冷淡。

examples.text: Certain of those present had had too much to drink.
examples.translation: 有些出席的人喝得太多了。

examples.text: You are certainly a talented artist.
examples.translation: 你当然是位有天赋的艺术家。

examples.text: He will certainly come.
examples.translation: 他一定会来的。

examples.text: He'll certainly die if you do not send for a doctor right now.
examples.translation: 如果你不马上请医生,他一定会死的。

examples.text: I can say with certainty that this is true.
examples.translation: 我可以很确定地说这是真实的。

examples.text: Too great certainty destroys certainty itself.
examples.translation: 过于确定就会破坏确定本身。

examples.text: The driver's certificate was suspended by the police.
examples.translation: 这个司机的驾驶执照被警察吊销了。

examples.text: He was afforded a certificate upon completion of his course of study.
examples.translation: 他结业时被授予证书。

examples.text: This is an accredited course and participants will receive 4.5 college credits and a world recognized Certificate of Nutrition upon completion.
examples.translation: 本课程设学分制，完成课程的直销商可获国际认可大学学分，结业时将获颁发盖有美国大溪谷州立大学盖印的营养证书。

examples.text: Bocog originally promised to issue a certificate of recognition to the participant in its global campaign whose slogan was adopted.
examples.translation: 北京奥组委最初承诺，在全球征集活动中，一旦某一口号获选，将向口号的提出者颁发认可证书。

examples.text: After approval, a certificate of approval shall be issued by MOFTEC.
examples.translation: 批准后，由对外贸易经济合作部发给批准证书。

examples.text: If you are successful, the official will confirm the record and you will get a certificate from the Guinness Book of World Records stating that you are a world record holder!
examples.translation: 假如你成功了，官员就会批准你的记录，你就会得到一个吉尼斯世界纪录的证书，表明你是世界纪录的保持者。

meanings.meaning: 束缚；链条；链；(一)连串；连锁店（常用复数）

examples.text: Though you seek in garments the freedom of privacy you may find in them a harness and a chain.
examples.translation: 你们想借着衣服得到隐私的自由,反而却因此为之羁绊和束缚。

examples.text: She wore a silver chain around her neck.
examples.translation: 她脖子上戴着一条银项链。

examples.text: He detached a link from a chain.
examples.translation: 他从链子上拆下一个链环。

examples.text: The Government fear the strike may produce a chain reaction in other industries.
examples.translation: 政府害怕罢工可能在其他行业产生连锁反应。

examples.text: The chairman exhorted the party workers to take action.
examples.translation: 主席敦促党的工作人员采取行动。

examples.text: In the absence of the chairman of the council,the vice chairman does duty for him.
examples.translation: 委员会会长缺任时，便由副会长代理职务。

meanings.meaning: 用粉笔写；记录；使变白；归咎

examples.text: The teacher wrote on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
examples.translation: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写字。

examples.text: The teacher's chalk grated on the blackboard.
examples.translation: 老师的粉笔在黑板上发出刺耳的摩擦声。

examples.text: My father said cement couldn't be made from chalk.
examples.translation: 我父亲说水泥不能用白垩来制作。

examples.text: The boys chalked out goalposts on the playground wall.
examples.translation: 男孩子们在运动场的墙上用粉笔画上了球门柱。

examples.text: He chalked out a simple plan of the new building.
examples.translation: 他用粉笔勾画了新大楼的简图。

examples.text: Our team has chalked up a record score for the season.
examples.translation: 我们队已取得该季度最佳得分记录。

examples.text: The team has chalked up its fifth win in a row.
examples.translation: 这队一连五次取得胜利。

examples.text: You shouldn't chalk that up to experience.
examples.translation: 你不应将此归咎为经验问题。

meanings.meaning: 挑战；邀请比赛；盘问；质疑

examples.text: The crossing of this dangerous river was a challenge to most of us.
examples.translation: 对我们大多数人来说,横渡这条充满危险的大河确实是个挑战。

examples.text: He accepted his friend's challenge to swim across the river.
examples.translation: 他接受朋友提出的挑战，游过这条河。

examples.text: We accepted their challenge to a baseball game.
examples.translation: 我们接受了他们棒球邀请的挑战。

examples.text: He ignored the sentry's challenge to halt.
examples.translation: 他不理睬哨兵喝令止步的盘问。

examples.text: Their legal challenge was unsuccessful.
examples.translation: 他们的法律质疑未获成功。

examples.text: Nowadays no one will challenge the fact that the earth is round.
examples.translation: 现在没有人会对地球是圆的这一事实提出异议。

examples.text: New competitors are emerging to challenge the old economic arrangements.
examples.translation: 新的竞争对手正在崛起，向旧的经济布局挑战。

examples.text: The sentry challenged the stranger at the gates.
examples.translation: 哨兵查问在门口的陌生人。

examples.text: I did not think he was right, so I challenged him.
examples.translation: 我认为他是不对的，因此向他提出质询。

meanings.meaning: 【音】室内的，小型的；私人的，秘密的

examples.text: The heart has four chambers.
examples.translation: 心脏有两房两室。

examples.text: Most of the meetings are held in the council chamber of city hall.
examples.translation: 大多数的会议都在市政大厅的理事会议室举行。

meanings.meaning: 拥护者；冠军；优胜者；勇士
拥护；保卫；为 ... 而斗争

examples.text: He is a champion of women's rights.
examples.translation: 他是妇女权利的卫士.

examples.text: He is the undisputed champion.
examples.translation: 他是无可争辩的冠军。

examples.text: He is a champion at writing familiar essays.
examples.translation: 他是写小品文的好手。

examples.text: Every absurdity have a champion to defend it.
examples.translation: 任何谬论都拥有拥护它的斗士。

examples.text: He is forced to champion unpopular causes.
examples.translation: 他被迫去支持一些不得人心的事业。

examples.text: He has always championed the cause of gay rights.
examples.translation: 他一直在为争取同性恋者的权利而斗争。

examples.text: That would be a daunting task with little chance of success.
examples.translation: 那样做的话任务过于艰巨,且成功的可能性微乎其微。

examples.text: Is there any chance of getting tickets for tonight's performance?
examples.translation: 有可能得到今晚演出的票吗?

examples.text: Please give me a chance to explain.
examples.translation: 请给我个机会让我解释一下。

examples.text: I never miss a chance of playing football.
examples.translation: 我从不错过踢足球的机会。

examples.text: We may lose a lot of support, but that's a chance we'll have to take.
examples.translation: 我们或许会失去很多支持，但这个风险我们必须冒一冒。

examples.text: I met her quite by chance.
examples.translation: 我遇见她完全是偶然的。

examples.text: A chance meeting brought the two old friends together again.
examples.translation: 偶然的相遇使两位老朋友重新聚首。

examples.text: If it should chance to rain we'll take a taxi home.
examples.translation: 万一要下雨的话，我们就乘出租车回家。

examples.text: Perhaps you might chance on the dictionary at some old bookstall.
examples.translation: 或许你会碰巧在旧书摊上买到这本辞典。

examples.text: It may be risky but we will chance it anyhow.
examples.translation: 这可能有危险, 但我们无论如何要冒一冒险。

examples.text: We'll have to chance meeting an enemy patrol.
examples.translation: 我们不得不冒著可能遇上敌人巡逻兵的危险。

examples.text: One of the funniest episodes in the book occurs in chapter 6.
examples.translation: 书中最有趣的情节是在第6章。

examples.text: He has got prepared to write a new chapter.
examples.translation: 他已经准备动手写新的一章。

examples.text: Let us revert to the earlier part of the chapter.
examples.translation: 让我们回到本章的前面部分。

examples.text: Chapter IV is about anaphora of third person pronouns.
examples.translation: 第四章，第三人称代词回指研究。

examples.text: He could recite the prose chapter and verse.
examples.translation: 他能一字不漏地背诵那篇散文。

meanings.meaning: 个性；品质；字符；人物；名誉；地位

examples.text: The boy has a strong character.
examples.translation: 这孩子个性很强。

examples.text: He is remembered for the nobility of his character.
examples.translation: 他因品质高尚而被人怀念。

examples.text: We need only keep track of the last marked character.
examples.translation: 我们只要记住最后标记的字符。

examples.text: I never saw a character so thoroughly hit off .
examples.translation: 我从没看见过一个人物被描写得如此淋漓尽致。

examples.text: His character is without a blemish.
examples.translation: 他在名誉上毫无瑕疵。

examples.text: She is responsible for the character part of the hero's devoted mother.
examples.translation: 她负责这个主人公的忠诚的母亲的角色部分。

examples.text: Ambition is a characteristic of all successful businessmen.
examples.translation: 雄心勃勃是所有成功生意人的共同特点。

examples.text: A characteristic of the camel is its ability to live for a long time without water.
examples.translation: 骆驼的特点是不喝水也能活很长时间。

examples.text: They have been affected by trends in Italy too much to keep their own characteristics.
examples.translation: 他们受意大利潮流的影响太大了,以致无法保持自己的特色。

examples.text: It is the characteristic attitude of people towards life in those post-war years.
examples.translation: 这是战后人们典型的处世态度。

examples.text: Sympathy is the feeling characteristic of mankind.
examples.translation: 同情心是人类特有的感情。

meanings.meaning: 责任；电荷；指控；费用；照顾
要价；充电；向前冲，冲锋；记在账上
控诉；赊帐；给…充电；委以重任；归罪于；装填（炸药等）

examples.text: As group leader, you should take charge.
examples.translation: 你身为组长, 应当负起责任来。

examples.text: He was arrested on a charge of armed robbery.
examples.translation: 他被指控犯武装抢劫罪而遭逮捕。

examples.text: Rub the leather and the rubber will produce the charge.
examples.translation: 摩擦皮毛和橡胶会产生电荷。

examples.text: He was arrested on a charge of armed robbery.
examples.translation: 他被指控犯武装抢劫罪而遭逮捕。

examples.text: The extra charge is for the water bed.
examples.translation: 超额费用是因为有水床。

examples.text: How much do you charge per unit?
examples.translation: 你们每件要价多少呢？

examples.text: The suspect was charged with murdering his wife.
examples.translation: 嫌疑犯被控诉为谋杀他的妻子。

examples.text: Please charge these bills to my account.
examples.translation: 请把这些帐单记在我的账上。

examples.text: He forgot to charge the battery.
examples.translation: 他忘记给电池充电了。

examples.text: She was charged with an important mission.
examples.translation: 她被委以重任。

meanings.meaning: 慈善；宽厚；慈善机关(团体)；仁慈

examples.text: They did so under the mask of charity.
examples.translation: 他们是打着慈善的幌子这么做的。

examples.text: True charity doesn't consist in almsgiving.
examples.translation: 真正的慈善不在于施舍。

examples.text: She was always very generous in her charity.
examples.translation: 她行善时总是很慷慨。

examples.text: She regards his moral faults with charity.
examples.translation: 她宽恕他的品行不端。

examples.text: This charity is a nonprofit organization.
examples.translation: 这个慈善团体是个非盈利性组织。

examples.text: The priest preached a sermon on the need of charity.
examples.translation: 牧师在布道会上宣讲慈爱的必要。

examples.text: Her colorful character makes her very charming.
examples.translation: 她生动活泼的性格使她非常富有魅力。

examples.text: My husband was handsome, spontaneous and charming in his youth.
examples.translation: 我丈夫年轻时英俊、诚挚、富有魅力。

examples.text: We didn't trust him at first, but his charming manner completely disarmed us.
examples.translation: 我们开始时并不信任他，但他令人愉快的举止完全消除了我们的疑虑。

meanings.meaning: 制成图表；绘制地图；规划

examples.text: Can you read the weather chart?
examples.translation: 你能看懂气象图吗？

examples.text: They laid out the chart of their destiny to come.
examples.translation: 他们展开了他们未来命运的蓝图。

examples.text: Joyride topped the US chart in spring 1991.
examples.translation: 专辑《逍遥游》于1991年春荣登美国排行榜榜首。

examples.text: On the map we chart the course of the river.
examples.translation: 我们在地图上标出了该河的流向。

examples.text: They tried to chart the sea area between Norway and Denmark.
examples.translation: 他们企图绘制挪威与丹麦之间的海域图。

examples.text: They have already begun charting the course for next campaign.
examples.translation: 他们已经开始为下次活动规划进程了。

meanings.meaning: 追捕；追求；镂刻，雕刻；试图赢得

examples.text: He chased (after) the burglar but couldn't catch him.
examples.translation: 他追赶窃贼却未捉住。

examples.text: Why do modern people chase material possessions?
examples.translation: 为什么现在的人们追求物质财富？

examples.text: The criminal was caught after a car chase.
examples.translation: 开着汽车追来追去才把罪犯捉住。

examples.text: The chase is often more exciting than the kill.
examples.translation: 追捕常常比猎杀更令人兴奋。

examples.text: A chase might be in the hands of the crown.
examples.translation: 狩猎地可能掌握在王室手中。

examples.text: The whole activity is akin to the way dogs would chase rabbits in the manors of the English countryside in the hunt.
examples.translation: 整个活动就类似于英国乡村传统的狩猎的方式，由猎狗追踪兔子。

examples.text: Her shoes look cheap.
examples.translation: 她的那双鞋看上去很便宜。

examples.text: A flood of cheap imports has come into the shops.
examples.translation: 大量廉价进口商品涌入商店。

examples.text: These are cheap and gaudy clothes.
examples.translation: 这是些廉价而花哨的衣服。

examples.text: This photograph is taken with a cheap camera.
examples.translation: 这张照片是用一架廉价照相机拍摄的。

examples.text: We were on our honor not to cheat the customers.
examples.translation: 我们以名誉担保不欺骗顾客。

examples.text: It is contemptible to cheat friends.
examples.translation: 欺骗朋友是卑劣的。

examples.text: They cheat the old woman of her house and money.
examples.translation: 他们骗取了老妇人的房屋和钱财。

examples.text: I would rather fail than cheat in the examination.
examples.translation: 我宁愿考不及格，也不愿意考试作弊。

examples.text: He never cheats to pass examination.
examples.translation: 他考试从不作弊。

examples.text: It is just not credible that she would cheat.
examples.translation: 她会行骗简直难以置信。

examples.text: He is a shameless cheat.
examples.translation: 他是个无耻的骗子。

examples.text: Your cheat will sooner or later find you out.
examples.translation: 你的欺骗行为迟早会暴露的。

meanings.meaning: 检查；阻碍；支票；账单；方格图案；(国际象棋)将军

examples.text: Do look out for spelling mistakes when you check your homework.
examples.translation: 你检查作业时要当心拼写错误。

examples.text: We had to check this tendency for administrative reasons.
examples.translation: 由于市政管理的原因，我们不得不阻止这种趋势。

examples.text: Please check the date.
examples.translation: 请核实一下日期。

examples.text: We conduct regular check on the quality of our products.
examples.translation: 我们对产品做例行质量检查。

examples.text: Heavy rains were a check on the army's advance.
examples.translation: 大雨阻挡了军队的前进

examples.text: Can you cash me the check?
examples.translation: 你能把这张支票给我兑换成现金吗?

examples.text: She is wearing a check skirt.
examples.translation: 她穿着一条格子短裙。

examples.text: The young Muscovite must have overlooked this intermediate check.
examples.translation: 年轻的莫斯科人一定没注意到这步将军。

examples.text: The king does not move to a square that is attacked by an enemy piece during the castling move, i.e., you may not castle and end the move with the king in check.
examples.translation: 国王在王车易位中移动到一个被敌方的棋子攻击的方块，例如在王车易位时，你不能移动使得国王处于被将军地位。

examples.text: The audience greet his speech with loud cheer.
examples.translation: 听众对他的演讲报以高声欢呼。

examples.text: The audience gave a great cheer when he scored.
examples.translation: 当他得分的时候，观众们爆发出热烈的欢呼。

examples.text: Your words of cheer disposed me for the task.
examples.translation: 你的一番鼓励的话使我乐意接受这项任务了。

examples.text: He's always full of cheer in summer.
examples.translation: 夏天他总是高高兴兴的。

examples.text: The crowd cheered the runners on as they started the last lap.
examples.translation: 赛跑进入最後一圈时，观众为运动员加油鼓劲。

examples.text: They beat drums to cheer up the players.
examples.translation: 他们擂鼓给运动员加油。

examples.text: I will be there to cheer for you.
examples.translation: 我会在赛场边为你加油的。

examples.text: His high spirits flood her and cheer her.
examples.translation: 他兴高采烈的神情感染了她，使她也快活起来。

examples.text: The crowd cheered loudly as the Queen appeared.
examples.translation: 女王出现时群众高声欢呼。

examples.text: His cheerful manner belied his real feelings.
examples.translation: 他那快活的样子掩饰了他真实的感情。

examples.text: There is hardly any cheerful news in the papers.
examples.translation: 报上没有什么叫人高兴的消息。

examples.text: A cheerful wife is the joy of life.
examples.translation: 快乐的妻子是生活的乐事。

examples.text: Her cheerful spirits and bubble laughter infect the whole class.
examples.translation: 她那快乐的情绪和爽朗的笑声感染了全班。

examples.text: These detail represented cheerful woman savour.
examples.translation: 这些细节都代表了快乐女人的品味。

examples.text: This cheese is rather bland.
examples.translation: 这干酪没什么味道。

examples.text: The cheese was emitting a strong smell.
examples.translation: 干酪散发出强烈的气味。

examples.text: Just have a taste of this cheese!
examples.translation: 尝一点儿这种乳酪吧！

examples.text: Cheese often upsets her stomach.
examples.translation: 她吃乳酪後常常感到肠胃不适。

examples.text: There are many kinds of cheese.
examples.translation: 奶酪有许多种。

examples.text: We had a homely meal of bread and cheese.
examples.translation: 我们吃了一顿面包加乳酪的家常便餐。

examples.text: I had a frugal meal of bread and cheese last night.
examples.translation: 我昨晚吃了只有面包和奶酪的便餐。

examples.text: The government has banned the use of chemical weapons.
examples.translation: 政府已经禁止使用化学武器。

examples.text: A reactor is a container for chemical reaction.
examples.translation: 反应器是进行化学反应的容器。

examples.text: We are doing a chemical experiment.
examples.translation: 我们正在做化学实验。

examples.text: The industry produces agricultural chemicals.
examples.translation: 这个工厂生产农药。

examples.text: The fine chemicals become more and more important.
examples.translation: 精致药品变得越来越重要了。

examples.text: The chemical can behave as an acid.
examples.translation: 这种化学制品能起酸的作用。

examples.text: Do you want anything from the chemist?
examples.translation: 你想向化学家要些什么吗？

examples.text: The famous chemist won the Nobel Prize.
examples.translation: 那个著名的化学家赢得了诺贝尔奖。

examples.text: The chemist is preparing a medicine.
examples.translation: 药剂师正在配药。

examples.text: The woman went to the chemist's shop and showed the docter's note to the chemist.
examples.translation: 这女人去了药师房，把医生写的那张纸条递给药剂师看。

examples.text: I prefer chemistry to physics.
examples.translation: 我喜欢化学甚于物理。

examples.text: We have three periods of chemistry a week.
examples.translation: 我们一星期三节化学课。

examples.text: No one can cope with him in Chemistry.
examples.translation: 在化学方面，谁也比不上他。

examples.text: We will do a Chemistry experiment this Friday.
examples.translation: 这个周五我们要做化学试验。

examples.text: I am not good at organic chemistry.
examples.translation: 我的有机化学学得不好。

examples.text: Don't forget to date your cheque.
examples.translation: 不要忘记在支票上写上日期。

examples.text: I hope this cheque doesn't bounce.
examples.translation: 我希望这张支票别遭退票

examples.text: He drew a cheque to her.
examples.translation: 他开了张支票给她。

examples.text: Payments by cheque easily outnumbered cash transactions.
examples.translation: 用支票付款在数量上大大超过现金交易。

examples.text: Will you lend me some money to tide me over until I get my pay cheque?
examples.translation: 你能否借给我点儿钱，帮我维持到发薪时?

meanings.meaning: 樱桃；樱桃树；樱桃色；处女膜

examples.text: He went to the cherry orchard to see flowers.
examples.translation: 他去樱桃园看花。
