examples.translation: 预料今天下午有零星阵雨。

examples.text: The neighbors held a bridal shower for the girl.
examples.translation: 邻居为姑娘举行了一个准新娘送礼会。

examples.text: The policemen were assailed by a shower of stones.
examples.translation: 警察遭到一阵石块的袭击。

examples.text: I have received a shower of letters recently.
examples.translation: 最近我收到了一大批信件。

examples.text: The firework exploded in a shower of sparks.
examples.translation: 烟火炸开放出一阵火花。

examples.text: I always shower after getting up.
examples.translation: 起床后我总是洗个淋浴。

examples.text: It suddenly started to shower.
examples.translation: 突然下起阵雨。

examples.text: The dancer was showered with praise.
examples.translation: 那个跳舞的人备受称赞。

examples.text: People shower the newly-weds with confetti .
examples.translation: 人们向新婚夫妇撒彩色纸屑。

examples.text: The best way to help a troubled child is to shower him with love.
examples.translation: 帮助失足少年的最好方法是施之以爱。

examples.text: Good wishes showered (down) on the bride and bridegroom.
examples.translation: 大家纷纷向新娘新郎祝福。

examples.text: Honours were showered upon the hero.
examples.translation: 人们纷纷向那位英雄致敬。

examples.text: The shriek sent shivers down my spine.
examples.translation: 那尖叫声使我的背脊起了一阵寒颤。

examples.text: Her shriek was dulled by the loud crash of thunder.
examples.translation: 她的尖叫声在震耳的雷声中变得低沉了。

examples.text: Suddenly a new sound, a shrill, feminine shriek, was heard from the porch, and the cook ran into the vestibule.
examples.translation: 突然，另一声刺耳的女人的叫喊，从门廊传了过来，接着，厨娘跑进了客厅。

examples.text: Suddenly he began to shriek loudly.
examples.translation: 突然他开始大声尖叫起来。

examples.text: The shriek sent shivers down my spine.
examples.translation: 那尖叫声使我的背脊起了一阵寒颤。

meanings.meaning: 收缩；退缩；萎缩；畏惧，害怕

examples.text: Will this woolen sweater shrink when washed?
examples.translation: 这件羊毛衫洗后会缩水吗？

examples.text: The company's profit margins shrank from 32.5% to 17%.
examples.translation: 该公司的边际利润率从32.5%降到了17%。

examples.text: The economy is shrinking instead of growing.
examples.translation: 经济正在萎缩而不是在增长中。

examples.text: The hot water shrank my pullover.
examples.translation: 我的套头毛衣遇热水后收缩了。

examples.text: You can expect some shrink when the jeans are washed.
examples.translation: 这种牛仔裤洗后要缩些水。

examples.text: There has been some shrink in our export trade.
examples.translation: 我们的出口贸易已有些萎缩。

examples.text: My aunt saw this shrink after her divorce.
examples.translation: 我阿姨在离婚后去见过这位心理医生。

examples.text: Please shut the door behind you.
examples.translation: 请关上你身后的门。

examples.text: The office will shut down for christmas.
examples.translation: 圣诞节办公室将关闭。

examples.text: He shut himself away for a month to catch up on his academic work.
examples.translation: 他与世隔绝一个月，力图把功课赶上去。

examples.text: Her mouth opened and shut, but no sound came out.
examples.translation: 她的嘴张开又闭上了，没有发出声音。

examples.text: He shut his eyes to her faults.
examples.translation: 他对她的缺点视而不见。

examples.text: Some coal-mines had to shut down.
examples.translation: 有些煤矿不得不关闭。

examples.text: Business is not good. He'll have to shut the shop.
examples.translation: 生意不好,他只得打算停业。

examples.text: She heard the bedroom window blow shut.
examples.translation: 她听见卧室的窗户被风刮关了。

examples.text: With the door shut, rhe room was hot and humid.
examples.translation: 门是关闭的,所以房间里又热又潮。

examples.text: Keep your mouth shut.
examples.translation: 闭上你的嘴。

examples.text: Are all the bars shut in this town?
examples.translation: 这个城镇里所有的酒吧都停止营业了吗？

examples.text: The jaws snap shut to take a sample.
examples.translation: 铁爪急速关闭以抓取样品。

examples.text: Some coal-mines had to shut down.
examples.translation: 有些煤矿不得不关闭。

examples.text: He was too shy to talk to anyone at the party.
examples.translation: 在晚会上他很腼腆，没有和任何人讲话。

examples.text: He only saw her sweet, shy face.
examples.translation: 他只注意到她的甜甜的、腼腆的脸。

examples.text: We must not fight shy of hard work.
examples.translation: 我们不应回避艰苦的工作。

examples.text: The shy girl was afraid to contradict.
examples.translation: 这个害羞的女孩不敢提出反驳意见。

meanings.meaning: 有病的；恶心的；腻烦的；晕的；令人毛骨悚然的

examples.text: He fell sick with malaria on a trip to Africa.
examples.translation: 他在去非洲时患了疟疾。

examples.text: He put a maid in to look after his sick wife.
examples.translation: 他雇了1名女仆来照顾她的病妻。

examples.text: You'll be sick if you eat any more of that candy.
examples.translation: 如果你再吃那种糖果,就会感到恶心的。

examples.text: I'm sick of waiting around like this.
examples.translation: 我讨厌透了像这样在一旁等著。

examples.text: I was sick in the car yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天我晕车了。

examples.text: The sick need special care.
examples.translation: 病人需要特别护理。

examples.text: The basin was full of sick.
examples.translation: 盆里全是吐的东西.

examples.text: Sick'em!
examples.translation: 咬他们!

examples.text: He sicked a dog on the thief.
examples.translation: 他纵狗去咬小偷。

examples.text: If you need something done, I'll sick him on it.
examples.translation: 如果你需要办什么事,我叫他去干。

examples.text: Chicken pox is a common childhood sickness.
examples.translation: 水痘是一种常见的儿童期疾病。

examples.text: The holy man healed them of their sickness.
examples.translation: 那位神职人员治好了他们的疾病。

examples.text: The boy didn't take the exam under the pretence of sickness.
examples.translation: 那个男孩借口生病没有参加考试。

examples.text: Sickness often results from eating too much.
examples.translation: 呕吐常因饮食过量所致。

examples.text: The symptoms of this disease are fever and sickness.
examples.translation: 这种病的症状是发烧与呕吐。

meanings.meaning: 边；侧；边缘；侧面；(多边形的)边；(立体的)面；一方；方面；旁边；家族

examples.text: My house is the ninth on the right side.
examples.translation: 我的房子是右边第九幢。

examples.text: The park is just on the left side of this street.
examples.translation: 公园就在马路的左侧。

examples.text: We planted tulips along the side of the lawn.
examples.translation: 我们沿草坪的边缘种上了郁金香

examples.text: The side of the boat had been staved in.
examples.translation: 那艘船的侧面已过凿穿了。

examples.text: A square has four sides but a circle has no sides.
examples.translation: 正方形有四条边，而圆形没有边。

examples.text: A cube has six sides.
examples.translation: 立方体有六面。

examples.text: I am always the winning side.
examples.translation: 我一直是获胜方。

examples.text: He took neither side in the dispute.
examples.translation: 在争论中他任何一方都不参加。

examples.text: She argued her side of the case well.
examples.translation: 她有理有据地陈述了自己的意见。

examples.text: The grandfather on his mother's side is still living.
examples.translation: 他外祖父还健在。

examples.text: He came in through a side door to avoid the crowds.
examples.translation: 为了避开人群他从旁边的门进来。

examples.text: The teacher would like to discuss this side issue later.
examples.translation: 老师想晚点谈论这个并不重要的问题。

examples.text: She always sided with my brother.
examples.translation: 她总是带在我哥哥那边。

examples.text: Why do you always side against me ?
examples.translation: 你为什么总站在我的对立面?

meanings.meaning: 向旁边；斜着地；向侧面地

examples.text: The trees are bushing out sideways.
examples.translation: 这些树正往四周长杈。

examples.text: He dropped the box sideways, so it hit me.
examples.translation: 他把箱子向旁边一扔

examples.text: He looked sideways at me in the meeting.
examples.translation: 他在会议上斜着眼看我。

examples.text: They stepped sideways down the stairs.
examples.translation: 他们侧身一步步走下楼梯。

examples.text: She had to turn sideways to get through the door.
examples.translation: 她只能侧身过门。

examples.text: Her new job is just a sideways move.
examples.translation: 她的新工作只是平级调动。

examples.text: This sideways motion often causes an imbalance of the body, too.
examples.translation: 这个横向动作经常引起身体的不平衡。

examples.text: When he heard the news, he uttered a sigh.
examples.translation: 听到这消息时，他叹了口气。

examples.text: She heaved a sigh and became lost in thought.
examples.translation: 她叹了口气，随即陷入了沉思。

examples.text: The old man uttered a sigh and went out.
examples.translation: 那位老人叹息了一声,走了出去。

examples.text: I bury my face in my hands and heave a sigh.
examples.translation: 我掩着面叹息。

examples.text: He sighed with despair.
examples.translation: 他绝望地叹了口气。

examples.text: ‘I wish I didn't have so much to do,’she sighed.
examples.translation: ｀我但愿没有这么多事情要做,＇她叹著气说。

examples.text: She looked out of the window, sighing for her lost youth.
examples.translation: 她看着窗外，为她失去的青春而惋惜。

examples.text: I'm having laser treatment to improve my sight.
examples.translation: 我正在接受激光治疗来提高我的视力。

examples.text: The captain ordered us to shoot any strangers on sight.
examples.translation: 船长命令我们凡是看见的陌生人都要将其枪毙。

examples.text: The train is still in sight.
examples.translation: 火车仍在视线内。

examples.text: He saw some amazing sights at the zoo.
examples.translation: 他在动物园里看到一些珍禽异兽。

examples.text: The ghastly sight gave him the shudders.
examples.translation: 那恐怖的景象使他感到恐惧。

examples.text: The hunter sighted carefully before firing his gun.
examples.translation: 猎人射击前仔细瞄准。

examples.text: After three days at sea, we sighted land.
examples.translation: 我们在海上航行三天後见到了陆地。

examples.text: We like to sight stars with the telescope at night.
examples.translation: 我们喜欢在夜晚用望远镜观测星星。

examples.text: I spent most of my time in sightseeing.
examples.translation: 我大部分时间都用在观光游览上了。

examples.text: We spent the remainder of the day sightseeing.
examples.translation: 这天剩下的时间我们到各处观光。

examples.text: They embarked on an orgy of sightseeing.
examples.translation: 他们开始尽情地观光游览。

examples.text: Good morning, Mr.Smith. Sightseeing is our agenda today.
examples.translation: 早上好，史密斯先生。我们今天的日程安排是游览。

meanings.meaning: 手势；招牌；符号；迹象；正负号

examples.text: I talked with him by signs.
examples.translation: 我和他用手势交谈。

examples.text: The sign was no longer legible because much of the lettering had worn away.
examples.translation: 这块招牌已看不清楚，因为大部分字已磨掉了。

examples.text: Make sure that the sign's the right way up.
examples.translation: 一定要把符号的上下弄对。

examples.text: There are signs of political unrest in the country.
examples.translation: 这个国家有政治不安定的迹象。

examples.text: Pay special attention to the sign of the answer.
examples.translation: 特别注意答案的正负号。

examples.text: He signed his name on the cheque.
examples.translation: 他在支票上签了名。

examples.text: The postman asked me to sign for the letter.
examples.translation: 邮差叫我签名收信。

examples.text: She signed to us to stop talking.
examples.translation: 她做手势示意我们不要讲话。

examples.text: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
examples.translation: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

examples.text: I corrected my watch by the time signal.
examples.translation: 我按报时信号校正我的表。

examples.text: I've called several times, but I keep getting a busy signal.
examples.translation: 我打了好几次了,可是一直是忙音。

examples.text: We live too far from the city to get a strong television signal.
examples.translation: 我们住的地方离城里太远, 不能收到清晰的电视图像。

examples.text: Her speech yesterday is a signal that her view has changed.
examples.translation: 她昨天的讲话标志著她的观点已经转变。

examples.text: The police signalled the traffic to move forward slowly.
examples.translation: 警察向来往车辆打信号，示意缓慢前行。

examples.text: People speak of Mark Twain as a signal humourous writer.
examples.translation: 人们称马克·吐温为杰出的幽默作家。

examples.text: This is a signal success.
examples.translation: 这是显著的成功。

meanings.meaning: 签署；书帖；有特征的符号；【计】签名

examples.text: He traced his signature laboriously.
examples.translation: 他吃力地签上自己的名字。

examples.text: Her signature was an illegible scrawl.
examples.translation: 她的签字潦草难辩。

examples.text: Few people realized the significance of the discovery.
examples.translation: 很少有人意识到这一发现的重要性.

examples.text: Our boss urged on us the significance of punctuality.
examples.translation: 老板向我们强调守时的重要性。

examples.text: He puzzled out the significance of the statement.
examples.translation: 他解释了这一论断的意义。

examples.text: Could you explain to me the significance of this part of the contract?
examples.translation: 你能给我解释一下合同这一部分的含义吗？

examples.text: We interpreted his silence as a refusal.
examples.translation: 我们认为他的沉默是拒绝的表示。

examples.text: His forceful arguments reduced his opponents to silence.
examples.translation: 他那有力的论点驳得对手哑口无言。

examples.text: There was nothing but silence in the room.
examples.translation: 这间屋内声息全无，一片寂静。

examples.text: A terrible silence descended upon the whole hall.
examples.translation: 一阵可怕的寂静突然笼罩着整个厅堂。

examples.text: The teacher tried to silence the pupils.
examples.translation: 老师设法让学生们安静下来。

examples.text: The speaker tried to silence the angry crowd .
examples.translation: 讲话者试图使愤怒的人群安静下来。

examples.text: The enemy's guns were silenced by repeated bombings.
examples.translation: 敌人的炮火因遭到轮番轰炸而沉寂了。

meanings.meaning: 安静的；不吵闹的；沉默的；无言的

examples.text: Would you be good enough to keep silent?
examples.translation: 请你保持安静好吗？

examples.text: The old house was quite silent.
examples.translation: 这所旧房子非常寂静。

examples.text: We sailed into a beautiful and silent bay.
examples.translation: 我们驶进一个美丽而安静的海湾。

examples.text: She was a silent girl, cool and remote.
examples.translation: 她是一个沉默寡言的女孩，对人冷漠而孤傲。

examples.text: I represent the silent majority.
examples.translation: 我代表沉默的大多数。

examples.text: If you are arrested you have the right to remain silent.
examples.translation: 如果你被捕，你有权保持沉默。

examples.text: She was blind to the silent worship in his eyes.
examples.translation: 她没有发觉他眼里流露出的无声的敬慕之情。

meanings.meaning: 丝；丝绸；丝织品；丝绸衣服

examples.text: A cocoon is a kind of silk covering made by an insect.
examples.translation: 蚕茧是由昆虫制造的一种由丝组成的外包层。

examples.text: She has a scarf made of a triangular piece of blue silk.
examples.translation: 她有一条用三角形蓝绸子做的围巾。

examples.text: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
examples.translation: 他们的主要出口货物是纺织品，特别是丝绸和棉布。

examples.text: The silk is nice and soft.
examples.translation: 这丝织品很柔软。

examples.text: She wears a translucent silk gown.
examples.translation: 她穿着半透明丝质长袍。

examples.text: Her silk dress rustled as she moved.
examples.translation: 她走起路来丝绸衣裙沙沙作响。

meanings.meaning: 愚蠢的；琐屑的；可笑的；犯晕的
（通常指小孩子）淘气鬼；傻孩子

examples.text: The silly ending robs the plot of any credibility.
examples.translation: 这愚蠢的结尾使得整个情节变得一点都不可信。

examples.text: Don't get upset over silly things that people say.
examples.translation: 不要在意人们的闲言碎语。

examples.text: I look pretty silly in this dress.
examples.translation: 我穿这条裙看上去很可笑。

examples.text: I took a swing at him and knocked him silly.
examples.translation: 我挥拳打了他一下, 把他打得晕头转向。

examples.text: Listen, silly, we have to leave now.
examples.translation: 听着,小淘气鬼,我们现在得走了。

examples.text: He is not a silly boy,not by a jugful.
examples.translation: 他不是一个傻孩子。

examples.text: No, silly, those aren't your shoes!
examples.translation: 不对，傻孩子，那不是你的鞋！

examples.text: He had some silver in his pocket.
examples.translation: 他口袋里有些银币。

examples.text: Acid had pitted the surface of the silver.
examples.translation: 酸把银器的表面腐蚀了。

examples.text: His black hair was threaded with silver.
examples.translation: 他的黑发中夹杂着银发。

examples.text: This board was cast in bronze not in silver.
examples.translation: 这个牌匾是铜铸的,不是银制的。

examples.text: This becomes silver gray, while I remember your handset was black.
examples.translation: 怎么变银灰色了，我记得你的手机是黑色的。

examples.text: You can recognize the genuine tape because of its silver grey color.
examples.translation: 你可以认出这种真正的带子，它是银灰色的。

examples.text: He found the chest to contain silver coins.
examples.translation: 他发现那囗箱子装着银币。

examples.text: She wore a silver chain around her neck.
examples.translation: 她脖子上戴着一条银项链。

examples.text: Every cloud has a silver lining.
examples.translation: 黑暗中总有一丝光明。

examples.text: There is not a silver hair on her head.
examples.translation: 她头上没有一根银发。

examples.text: The years have silvered her hair.
examples.translation: 岁月已使她的青丝似雪。

examples.text: The two buildings are similar on the whole.
examples.translation: 从整体来看，这两幢楼是相似的。

examples.text: I sympathize with you; I've had a similar unhappy experience myself.
examples.translation: 我很同情你，我自己也有过类似的不幸遭遇。

examples.text: He talked about it in a similar way.
examples.translation: 他对此事有相似的说法。

examples.text: Gold is similar in color to brass.
examples.translation: 金和铜颜色相仿。

examples.text: We have similar opinions.
examples.translation: 我们的看法相同。

examples.text: Similarly, the grid pattern in digital calendars is almost always of a fixed size.
examples.translation: 相似地，数字化日历的网格始终有固定的大小。

examples.text: Similarly, the algorithms have a consistent interface.
examples.translation: 类似地，算法具有一致的接口。

examples.text: Similarly all banks are now plugged into government life-support systems.
examples.translation: 类似地所有的银行现在都陷入政府供养系统了。

examples.text: The simplicity of the book makes it suitable for children.
examples.translation: 这本书简单易懂，适合儿童。

examples.text: Modern furniture design tends to simplicity.
examples.translation: 现代家俱设计越来越简单。

examples.text: He believes everything with childlike simplicity.
examples.translation: 他以孩童般的单纯相信一切。

examples.text: The monastic community generally lives a life of simplicity.
examples.translation: 僧侣界通常过着简朴生活。

examples.text: Simplicity is the essence of good taste.
examples.translation: 纯朴是情趣高尚的主要因素。

examples.text: That will simplify my task.
examples.translation: 那可简化了我的工作。

examples.text: She simplified the instructions so that the children could understand them.
examples.translation: 她简化了指令以便于儿童理解。

examples.text: Can you simplify your language a little?
examples.translation: 你能不能把你的语言改得简单一点?

examples.text: Most of these problems won't simply dissolve.
examples.translation: 大多数这些问题不会简单地解决。

examples.text: Put simply, we accept their offer or go bankrupt.
examples.translation: 简单地说吧，我们要么接受他们的条件，要么破产。

examples.text: You may open the tin simply by pulling the puller.
examples.translation: 你只要拉这个拉出器，就可以很容易地把罐头打开。

examples.text: Is success simply a matter of working hard?
examples.translation: 是否只要勤奋就能成功？

examples.text: I bought the house simply because it was large.
examples.translation: 我购买了这房子，只是因为它面积大。

examples.text: The holidays simply sped by.
examples.translation: 假期简直是一晃而过。

examples.text: That meal was simply divine!
examples.translation: 那顿饭简直好极了。

examples.text: He thinks it's a sin to covet other's properties.
examples.translation: 他认为贪图他人的财物是有罪的。

examples.text: I guess ignorance must be a sin.
examples.translation: 我认为无知是一种罪。

examples.text: We've sinned against you, and against our fellow men.
examples.translation: 我们得罪了你，也得罪了我们的邻人。

examples.text: We are ashamed of sin and yet not ashamed to sin.
examples.translation: 我们耻于罪而不耻于犯罪。

examples.text: To abstain from sin when a man cannot sin is to be forsaken by sin,not forsake it.
examples.translation: 当一个人因无力作恶而不犯罪，是为罪所舍弃，并非舍之而不为。

examples.text: He must have taken the book since it isn't here.
examples.translation: 他一定是把书拿走了,因为书已不在这里了。

examples.text: Since you can't answer the question, perhaps we'd better ask someone else.
examples.translation: 既然你无法回答这个问题，我们最好再问问别人。

examples.text: He had spoken to her only once since the party.
examples.translation: 自从那次聚会以来,他只跟她说过一次话。

examples.text: She's so easily fatigued since her illness.
examples.translation: 自从病后，她很容易疲劳。

examples.text: She hasn't been out riding since the accident.
examples.translation: 她自从出了事故以后，一直没有骑马外出过。

examples.text: Bows and arrows have long since been out of use.
examples.translation: 弓箭很早以前就没人使用了。

examples.text: He left home two weeks ago and we haven't heard from him since.
examples.translation: 他两星期以前离开了家，到现在我们一直没有他的消息。

examples.text: How can I persuade you that I am sincere?
examples.translation: 怎样才能使你相信我是真心实意的呢?

examples.text: I will oblige any sincere request.
examples.translation: 我会答应任何诚意的请求。

examples.text: I think he is sincere and quite without affectation.
examples.translation: 我认为他为人诚挚，毫不做作。

examples.text: Sincere congratulations on your son wedding please convey our best wish.
examples.translation: 令郎喜结良缘谨此致以诚挚的祝贺并请转达最美好的祝愿。

examples.text: Please accept my sincere thanks and best wishes.
examples.translation: 请接受我诚挚的感谢和最美好的祝愿。

examples.text: She was singing a lullaby to her child.
examples.translation: 她正在给孩子唱摇篮曲。

examples.text: Let's sing a song during the break.
examples.translation: 我们趁这空当儿唱支歌。

examples.text: She sang the baby to sleep.
examples.translation: 她给孩子唱歌唱到孩子睡着。

examples.text: Birds sing loudest in the early morning.
examples.translation: 鸟儿在清晨高声歌唱。

examples.text: Our films sing the praises of the new society.
examples.translation: 我们的电影歌颂新社会。

examples.text: The critics are singing the praises of her new book.
examples.translation: 评论家高度赞扬她写的新书。

examples.text: Did you join in the community sing?
examples.translation: 你们有没有参加社区的合唱会?

meanings.meaning: 烧毛工；烧毛机 Singer: 辛格(姓氏).

examples.text: The pop singer is the idol of young people.
examples.translation: 这位流行歌手成为年轻人崇拜的偶像。

examples.text: Her success as a popular singer was ephemeral.
examples.translation: 作为流行歌曲歌手她取得的成功只是昙花一现。

meanings.meaning: 单一的；单个的；特指某人或某物；单身的；单人的；单程的
单程票；单曲；单人房间；单身者；一元纸币；(网球)单打比赛；(板球)一分打；(棒球)一垒打

examples.text: The letter was written on a single sheet of paper.
examples.translation: 这封信只用一张纸写成。

examples.text: I'd like to have a single room, preferably, facing south.
examples.translation: 我想要一个套间,最好是朝南的。

examples.text: Every single child will receive a gift.
examples.translation: 每一个孩子都会收到一份礼物

examples.text: Freshwater is the single most precious element for life on earth.
examples.translation: 淡水对地球上的生命来说是最宝贵的一个要素。

examples.text: He can't stay single for a long time.
examples.translation: 他不会长时间保持单身的。

examples.text: A single room with a bath, if possible.
examples.translation: 如果可能，要一间带浴室的单人房。

examples.text: There are two second-class singles to Leeds.
examples.translation: 有两张到利兹的二等的单程票.

examples.text: His first single topped the charts for six weeks.
examples.translation: 他的第一首单曲连续上榜六周并且名列前茅。

examples.text: I'm sorry. Mr. Smith, your request arrived too late to reserve a single.
examples.translation: 对不起，史密斯先生，您的订房要求来得太迟，单人房已经定完了。

examples.text: They organize parties for singles.
examples.translation: 他们为单身者组织聚会。

examples.text: I'd like to break this ten dollar bill into ten singles.
examples.translation: 我要把这张10元钞票换成10张。

examples.text: The teacher was reluctant to single out individual students for praise or blame.
examples.translation: 老师不愿挑出个别学生来给予表扬或者指责。

examples.text: "It" is the third-person singular neuter pronoun.
examples.translation: “it”是第三人称单数的中性代名词。

examples.text: I was struck with the man's singular appearance.
examples.translation: 那个人的奇特外貌给我留下了深刻的印象。

examples.text: Talking to him is a singular experience.
examples.translation: 与他交谈是一种非同平常的体验。

examples.text: She had a singular insight into life.
examples.translation: 她对于人生有一个非凡的了解。

examples.text: But his vision was too singular to be stultified for long.
examples.translation: 但是他的洞察力是如此非凡，不可能长久地被愚弄。

examples.text: Give the singular forms of the following nouns.
examples.translation: 写出下列名词的单数形式。

examples.text: Singular nouns are used only in the singular, always with a determiner.
examples.translation: 单数名词只有单数形式，总是与限定词连用。

meanings.meaning: 下沉；沉没；渗透；低落；变低；衰弱；（太阳）落下
水槽；沟渠；散热器；接收端

examples.text: Wood does not sink in water, it floats.
examples.translation: 木头在水中不沉，而是漂在水面。

examples.text: The boat will sink unless we bail out.
examples.translation: 我们要不把积水清除掉，船就要沉了。

examples.text: The ship was sunk by an enemy torpedo.
examples.translation: 这艘船被敌人的鱼雷击沉了。

examples.text: Rub the cream on your skin and let it sink in.
examples.translation: 把这种软膏搽在皮肤上，让它渗进去。

examples.text: It was several days before the floodwater sank and life returned to normal.
examples.translation: 过了几天洪水才退,生活恢复了正常。

examples.text: They watched the sun sink into the Mediterranean.
examples.translation: 他们注视着太阳沉入地中海。

examples.text: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
examples.translation: 那些脏盘子在洗涤槽内。

examples.text: The housewife always keeps the sink clean.
examples.translation: 主妇总是保持水槽的清洁。

examples.text: Power densities that can be tolerated by a gage are strongly related to the specimen which serves as the heat sink.
examples.translation: 应变片所能允许的电能密度与起着散热器作用的试件密切相关。

examples.text: Due to the general derivation, the longitudinal fin arrays on a heat sink can have either square, rectangular, equilaterally triangular, or cylindrical cross section.
examples.translation: 这个研究是针对纵长型的散热器在已知体积与鳍片数目以及一边的深度，求长方形鳍片的长度与宽度与横截面积。

examples.text: Sir Peter was raised to the peerage.
examples.translation: 彼得先生被封为贵族。

examples.text: Maybe you could take a seat in the lobby,sir.
examples.translation: 或许您可以在大堂休息一下，先生。

examples.text: I am heated and excited, sir, I know I am.
examples.translation: 我真又恼火又生气，阁下，我知道我实在气不过。

examples.text: But Sir Tim remains optimistic.
examples.translation: 但迪姆阁下保持着他的乐观态度。

examples.text: Sir Willoughby restrained a bound of his body.
examples.translation: 威洛比爵士拼命遏制自己身体的跳动。

examples.text: Sir James will be dining with us tonight.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯爵士今晚将与我们共进晚餐。

examples.text: That sale precludes further development on this site.
examples.translation: 卖出以后妨碍了这一地点的进一步发展。

examples.text: The site is being developed by a London property company.
examples.translation: 这块地正在由伦敦的一家地产公司开发利用。

examples.text: Excavation of the site will begin tomorrow.
examples.translation: 明天开始挖掘工作。

examples.text: Rescue workers rushed to the site of the plane crash.
examples.translation: 抢救人员冲向飞机坠毁的现场。

examples.text: Is it safe to site the power station here?
examples.translation: 在这建造发电厂安全吗？

examples.text: They have decided to site the new school in this town.
examples.translation: 他们已经决定把新校设于本镇。

meanings.meaning: 形势；局面；位置；职位；处境；状况

examples.text: The overall situation is worsening.
examples.translation: 整体形势在日益恶化。

examples.text: The economic situation is now different.
examples.translation: 现在经济形势不同了。

examples.text: You dealt with an awkward situation very tactfully.
examples.translation: 你很巧妙地处理了一个困难的局面。

examples.text: The house is in a good situation at the top of the hill.
examples.translation: 这座房子在山上的一个好位置上。

examples.text: He was promoted to a high situation for his outstanding performance in the project.
examples.translation: 因为在项目中的突出表现,他被提升到高职位。

examples.text: He was in a dangerous situation.
examples.translation: 他处境危险。

examples.text: He laughed off an embarrassing situation.
examples.translation: 他以笑来解除这种尴尬的处境。

examples.text: He gave a neat summary of the financial situation.
examples.translation: 他对财务状况做了简要的概括。

examples.text: It is about six o'clock now.
examples.translation: 现在是六点钟左右。

examples.text: The heifer is only six months old.
examples.translation: 这只小母牛只有六个月大。

examples.text: The murder trial lasted six weeks.
examples.translation: 法庭对这一谋杀案的审理为时六周。

examples.text: The tree is said to be six hundred years old.
examples.translation: 这树约莫已有600年树龄了。

examples.text: There are sixteen ounces in one pound.
examples.translation: 一磅有十六盎司。

examples.text: He was scarcely sixteen when he joined the army.
examples.translation: 他参军时刚刚十六岁。

examples.text: I would like a sixth of the cake.
examples.translation: 我要六分之一个蛋糕。

examples.text: My new house is on the sixth floor.
examples.translation: 我的新房子在六楼。

examples.text: He was counted out at the end of the sixth round.
examples.translation: 他在第六轮被宣布为失败。

meanings.meaning: 大小；规模；尺寸；尺码；浆料；胶料
按大小排列(或分类)；给…上胶

examples.text: The size of the apples varied.
examples.translation: 那些苹果大小不同。

examples.text: The company doubled its size in nine years.
examples.translation: 9年来这家公司的规模扩大了一倍。

examples.text: What size of collar is this shirt?
examples.translation: 这衬衣领子的尺寸是多少？

examples.text: Do you have the same size and design in black?
examples.translation: 这种尺码和款式有黑色的吗?

examples.text: A man's shirt is sized by its neck.
examples.translation: 男子的衬衫号码是按领口大小分的。

examples.text: In winter, many people skate on the lake.
examples.translation: 冬天时，许多人在湖上溜冰。

examples.text: The ice is too thin to skate on.
examples.translation: 冰太薄,不能在上面溜冰。

examples.text: The Dutch often skate along the canals in winter.
examples.translation: 冬天荷兰人经常沿着运河滑冰。

examples.text: I can move very fast across the ice on skates.
examples.translation: 我穿着冰鞋在冰上滑得很快。

examples.text: I have bought ice skates to learn to figure skate.
examples.translation: 我买了一双花样刀来学习滑冰。

examples.text: He is working up a sketch into a picture.
examples.translation: 他正在把一幅速写加工成一幅画。

examples.text: He did a sketch of the ballet dancers.
examples.translation: 他为这些芭蕾舞者画了一张素描。

examples.text: He squiggled a sketch on the ground.
examples.translation: 他在地上胡乱地画了个草图。

examples.text: They only gave us a sketch of the whole event.
examples.translation: 他们只向我们简略地介绍了整个事件。

examples.text: I'll give you a sketch of what has happened.
examples.translation: 我给你把发生的情况简单描述一下。

examples.text: Sadly Mr Obama has repeatedly failed to sketch out how he might go about that.
examples.translation: 遗憾的是,奥巴马再一次没能草拟出一份解决这一问题的方案。

examples.text: The little boy can sketch out a horse quickly.
examples.translation: 这小男孩子能迅速成地色画出一匹马。

examples.text: Sketch out what you intend to do.
examples.translation: 把你要做的事概括地叙述一下。

examples.text: They often go skiing in December.
examples.translation: 他们经常在十二月份去滑雪。

examples.text: I am learning to ski.
examples.translation: 我正在学滑雪。

examples.text: The trail can be skied.
examples.translation: 这条小道上可以滑雪。

examples.text: The girl asked her father to buy a pair of skis for her.
examples.translation: 那个女孩请求她的父亲给她买一副滑雪板。

examples.text: I'll have the express delivery service send my ski.
examples.translation: 滑雪板用快递寄过去吧。

examples.text: The skilful miller killed millions of lions with his ski.
examples.translation: 技术娴熟的磨坊主用雪橇杀死了上百万头狮子。

examples.text: The ski hire ranges from fifty to two hundred dollars in this area.
examples.translation: 这个地区的雪橇租金从五十元到二百元不等。

examples.text: The crisis put his courage and skill to the test.
examples.translation: 这次危难是对他的勇气和技能的考验。

examples.text: She dealt with the problem with consummate skill.
examples.translation: 她以巧妙的手腕处理了这个问题。

examples.text: Resources management is an important business skill.
examples.translation: 资源管理是一项重要的经营技能。

examples.text: As a lightweight his skill is of the highest order.
examples.translation: 作为轻量级拳击手，他的技术是第一流的。

examples.text: Match your skill against the experts in this quiz.
examples.translation: 在这一测验中你与专家较量一下技巧吧。

examples.text: His cleverness and skill compel our admiration.
examples.translation: 他的聪明和技巧使我们赞叹不已。

examples.text: The surgeon cut away the tumour with expert skill.
examples.translation: 外科大夫用熟练的技术把肿瘤切去。

examples.text: His hard work atones for his lack of skill.
examples.translation: 他的艰苦努力弥补了技术的不熟练。

examples.text: Unskilled workers usually earn less money than skilled workers.
examples.translation: 无技能的工人通常比有技能的工人挣钱少。

examples.text: The third wave includes Muslim refugees from Iraq, workers from the Indian subcontinent, students from South Korea, skilled Chinese and others.
examples.translation: 第三波文化整合也包括了从伊拉克逃出来的回教难民，从印度来的工人，从南韩来的学生，有技能的华人移民等等。

examples.text: The intricate machine requires a skilled operator.
examples.translation: 这种复杂精细的机器须由技能熟练的人操作。

examples.text: Fluent spoken English and skilled writen English.
examples.translation: 熟练的英语口语及读写能力。

examples.text: His skillful manipulation vivified this puppet.
examples.translation: 他熟练的操作让木偶栩栩如生。

examples.text: He is a skillful English-speaking professor.
examples.translation: 他是位英语讲得很熟练的教授。

examples.text: Her skillful fingers spun the wool out to a fine thread.
examples.translation: 她那灵巧的手指把羊毛纺织成了细线。

examples.text: With a skillful movement he rounded the small fishing-boat.
examples.translation: 他以灵巧的动作使小渔船调过头来。

examples.text: It took me an hour to skim the book.
examples.translation: 我花了一小时把这本书浏览了一遍。

examples.text: A seagull skims the water.
examples.translation: 海鸥掠过水面。

examples.text: The hovercraft is able to skim over the water.
examples.translation: 气垫船能掠过水面飞速行驶。

examples.text: During the cold night, the puddles skimmed over.
examples.translation: 夜间寒冷，水洼面上结了冰。

examples.text: I notice you have two quarts of skim milk.
examples.translation: 我看到你拿了两夸托脱脂牛奶。

meanings.meaning: 剥皮；削皮；贴皮；蹭破皮；击败

examples.text: He had brown skin.
examples.translation: 他的皮肤是棕色的

examples.text: When he fell he just broke the skin.
examples.translation: 当他跌倒时，他只擦破皮肤。

examples.text: She peeled off the skin of a banana for the child.
examples.translation: 她替孩子剥掉香蕉皮。

examples.text: I nearly jumped out of my skin when a hand grabbed me in the dark.
examples.translation: 黑暗中有一只手把我抓住，可真把我吓了一大跳。

examples.text: Don't let him get under your skin.
examples.translation: 别让他惹你生气。

examples.text: It's no skin off my nose if I lose this job, I can always get another one.
examples.translation: 我失掉这份工作也没有关系，我随时都能再找到工作。

examples.text: David is skinning onions in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 大卫在厨房里剥洋葱皮。

examples.text: Firstly, you should pare the skin.
examples.translation: 首先，你得削皮。

examples.text: He skinned his knee when he fell.
examples.translation: 他摔跤时把膝盖擦破了。

meanings.meaning: 裙子；下摆；边缘；郊区；挡板

examples.text: How many skirts do you have?
examples.translation: 你有多条少裙子？

examples.text: She tore her skirt on the nail.
examples.translation: 钉子勾破了她的裙子。

examples.text: Her skirt has very exquisite lace.
examples.translation: 她的裙子有非常精致的花边。

examples.text: She smoothed down the skirt of her dress.
examples.translation: 她把连衣裙的下摆弄平。

examples.text: She made a neat row of stitches along the edge of her skirt.
examples.translation: 在裙子的边缘她缝了一排整齐的缝线。

examples.text: You don't want to walk out with your skirt hem tucked or riding up the pannier.
examples.translation: 相信你也不想当自己走出去是你的裙子边缘折上去或者裙撑缩上去吧。

examples.text: There is a rubber skirt round the bottom of a hovercraft.
examples.translation: 汽垫船底部四周有橡胶护板。

examples.text: The road skirted the woods.
examples.translation: 这条路环绕林子。

examples.text: We decided to skirt round the deep jungle.
examples.translation: 我们决定绕过那片茂密的丛林。

examples.text: The speech was most disappointing; it skirted round all the main questions.
examples.translation: 这篇演讲非常令人失望，它回避了所有主要的问题。

examples.text: He stared up at the stars twinkling in the sky above him.
examples.translation: 他抬眼凝视着头顶上方星光闪烁的天空。

examples.text: The sky slowly changed from blue to red.
examples.translation: 天空慢慢由蓝色变为红色。

examples.text: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
examples.translation: 云是天空中的水汽团。

examples.text: Threatening skies portend a storm.
examples.translation: 诡异的天气预示有暴风雨来临。

examples.text: I hated waking up to gloomy skies.
examples.translation: 我讨厌在阴沉沉的天气里早早起床。

examples.text: It is silly of him to take a wild swipe at the ball and sky it mile over the bar.
examples.translation: 他真傻，猛踢足球，把它高高地踢过了球门。

meanings.meaning: 砰地关上；猛放；猛烈攻击

examples.text: He closed the door with a slam.
examples.translation: 他砰的一声关上门。

examples.text: He slammed the papers down on my desk and angrily walked out.
examples.translation: 他把文件使劲扔在我的桌子上便怒气冲冲地走了出去。

examples.text: He threw his books down with a slam.
examples.translation: 他砰然一声将书摔在桌上。

examples.text: I'm sick of your slams.
examples.translation: 对於你的谩骂我真受够了。

examples.text: I still have two finesses to make a grand slam.
examples.translation: 我还有两张飞牌来完成大满贯。

meanings.meaning: 奴隶；像奴隶般受制的人；【机】从动装置

examples.text: This slave dreamed of becoming a freeman.
examples.translation: 这个奴隶梦想着成为一个自由人。

examples.text: The boy was caught and sold to be a galley slave.
examples.translation: 这个男孩被抓住，并被卖到战舰上做奴隶。

examples.text: He is a slave to drink.
examples.translation: 他是个酒鬼。

examples.text: We are born to slave it for our lord.
examples.translation: 我们是生来为君王效犬马之劳的。

examples.text: They were delivered from slavery.
examples.translation: 他们从奴役中被解放出来。

examples.text: Lincoln was an unbending foe of slavery.
examples.translation: 林肯是奴隶制的死敌。

examples.text: All humanitarians are against slavery.
examples.translation: 所有人道主义者都反对奴隶制。

examples.text: However, the Israelite people, accustomed to slavery and uncertain of freedom, soon rebelled against God.
examples.translation: 然而，以色列人，习惯了奴隶身份和不确定的自由，很快又再反抗神了。

examples.text: After Harriet Tubman escaped from slavery, she returned to slave-holding states many times to help other slaves escape.
examples.translation: 自奴隶身份脱逃后，海丽特塔布曼多次往返于赞成奴隶制度的各州内，帮助其他的奴隶逃亡。

examples.text: He have to sleep by day and work by night.
examples.translation: 他只好白天睡觉，晚上工作。

examples.text: He'd been sleeping rough for a week, in ditches and haystacks.
examples.translation: 他在沟里和草堆里露宿了一个星期。

examples.text: I haven't had enough sleep lately.
examples.translation: 最近我睡眠不足。

examples.text: A growing child needs plenty of sleep.
examples.translation: 正发育的孩子必须睡眠充足。

meanings.meaning: 使浸透；吸入；浸洗；使喝醉；敲竹杠

examples.text: She soaked the shirt in soapy water.
examples.translation: 她把衬衫浸透在肥皂水中。

examples.text: The kind of plant doesn't soak the sewage up.
examples.translation: 这种植物没有吸入污水。

examples.translation: 他喜欢泡洗热水澡。

examples.translation: 把杏子浸泡20分钟。

examples.translation: 倒一些水, 让它自然渗透。

examples.text: The speaker paused to let her words soak in.
examples.translation: 讲话者暂停了一下,以便她的话被人们理解。

examples.text: Give the clothes a long soak before washing.
examples.translation: 洗之前先将衣服多泡一些时间。

examples.translation: 滑雪后泡温泉真棒。

examples.text: The soap slipped out of my hand.
examples.translation: 肥皂从我手上滑落了。

examples.text: Tallow can be used for making soap.
examples.translation: 动物脂可以用来做香皂。

examples.text: I only caught the end of the soap opera.
examples.translation: 我只看到了肥皂剧的结尾。

examples.text: This club was beginning to seem like a soap opera.
examples.translation: 这个社团开始就像一出肥皂剧。

examples.text: Is it good to soap the baby down each time?
examples.translation: 每次都把婴孩身上打上肥皂好吗？

examples.text: Don't touch anything before you soap your hands.
examples.translation: 没用香皂洗手之前，什么都不能碰。

examples.text: It's no good trying to soft soap my father; he's miserable old devil.
examples.translation: 试图恭维我父亲是没有用的，他是一个使人伤心的老家伙。

examples.text: Some children often sob themselves to sleep.
examples.translation: 有些孩子常哭泣着睡着了。

examples.text: The hard sob of anger barred her voice.
examples.translation: 愤怒所产生的痛苦呜咽阻滞着她的语音。

examples.text: It was a long, grieving sound, like a sigh--almost like a sob.
examples.translation: 这一声叫喊又悠长又凄楚，似是长叹，又似是呜咽。

examples.text: She sobbed into her handkerchief.
examples.translation: 她用手绢掩面啜泣。

examples.text: We could hear the child sobbing in the other room.
examples.translation: 我们听到那间屋子里的小孩在抽抽搭搭地哭着。

examples.text: She sobbed out the story of her son's violent death.
examples.translation: 她哭着诉说儿子横死的经过。

examples.text: The child's sobs gradually died down.
examples.translation: 那孩子的啜泣声渐渐静了下来。

meanings.meaning: 清醒的；稳重的；沉着冷静的；颜色暗淡的

examples.text: He was tipsy yesterday , but now is sober.
examples.translation: 他昨天醉醺醺的,但现在是清醒的。

examples.text: We should make a sober estimate of the situation.
examples.translation: 我们对形势要有清醒的估计。

examples.text: He is a very sober and hard-working young man.
examples.translation: 他是一个非常稳重而勤奋的年轻人。

examples.translation: 他以冷静而友好的方式同我们交谈。

examples.text: He wore a sober suit that befitted the occasion.
examples.translation: 他穿著一套与那样的场合相称的素净衣服。

examples.text: He drank a cup of strong tea to sober himself up.
examples.translation: 他喝下一杯浓茶以使自己清醒过来。

examples.translation: 绚丽的日落使他渐渐地平静了下来。

examples.translation: 他听到这个坏消息，马上就清醒过来了。

examples.text: (1) There is no so-called "recipe for success".
examples.translation: (1) 所谓“成功的诀窍”是不存在的。

examples.translation: 政府拟采取措施严禁在足球比赛中闹事。

examples.translation: 老人禁止在他的花园里踢足球。

examples.translation: 城市里各社会阶层有明确的分野。

examples.translation: 布朗太太是有名的趋炎附势的人。

examples.text: Most bees and wasps are social insects.
examples.translation: 大多数蜜蜂和黄蜂都是群居昆虫。

examples.translation: 我们被邀请参加一个小型社交聚会。

examples.text: He's not a very social person.

examples.translation: 从那时起,我们开始建设社会主义。

examples.translation: 谁是科学社会主义的奠基人？

examples.translation: 国家保护社会主义的公共财产。

examples.text: They all support socialist policies.
examples.translation: 他们都拥护社会主义的政策。

examples.text: He is a socialist.
examples.translation: 他是一位社会主义者。

examples.translation: 这件事情对社会造成了有害的影响。

examples.translation: 战争改变了整个社会结构。

examples.translation: 信誉是消费界的生命线。

examples.translation: 英国能否有朝一日成为一个无阶级社会?

examples.translation: 当时他们正在讨论西方社会的问题。

examples.text: She joined the university art society.
examples.translation: 她加入了大学里的艺术协会。

examples.translation: 她捐款给一个动物保护协会。

examples.translation: 他挑选了一双与他衣服相配的短袜。

examples.translation: 他们用吸管喝汽水。

examples.translation: 你光吃苏打饼乾和沙丁鱼不行。

examples.translation: 请在威士忌中加些苏打水。

meanings.meaning: 柔软的；柔和的；温和的；不强烈的；轻的

examples.text: The new leaves in springtime have a soft touch.
examples.translation: 春天的新芽有柔软的触感。

examples.translation: 春天的时候，踩在松软的地面上非常舒服。

examples.translation: 房间里充满了柔和的光。

examples.text: The soft breeze stirs the leaves.
examples.translation: 柔和的微风摇动着树叶。

examples.text: His soft words contained an undertone of warning.
examples.translation: 他温和的话中蕴涵着警告之意。

examples.translation: 他的声音很轻，有些话我没有听到。

examples.translation: 他用柔软的东西使他的背部舒服一点。

examples.text: The new leaves in springtime have a soft touch.
examples.translation: 春天的新芽有柔软的触感。

examples.translation: 屋里点着一盏灯，光线很柔和。

examples.translation: 走廊的某处响起轻柔悦耳的铃声。

examples.translation: 她对着怀里的孩子轻声低语。

examples.translation: 他们互相注视着对方，两人的眼睛都放出温柔的光芒。

examples.translation: 他用手把住他那有花白胡须的下巴，温柔地冲我微笑着。

examples.translation: 因为土地肥沃，那儿很富裕。

examples.translation: 肥沃的土地能种出好庄稼。

examples.translation: 这种土壤含碱丰富。

examples.translation: 他把幼苗移栽到含泥炭的土壤里。

examples.translation: 她中伤性的话损害了他的名誉。

examples.translation: 太阳是太阳系的中心

examples.translation: 太阳辐照率向两极递减。

examples.translation: 太阳能电池能把阳光的能量转化为电能。

examples.translation: 人工心脏是由太阳能电池驱动的。

examples.translation: 他有福特汽车的独家代理权。

examples.translation: 他唯一的动机就是多赚钱。

examples.translation: 他唯一的谋生之道就是务农。

examples.text: He has pain on the sole of his feet.
examples.translation: 他脚底很痛。

examples.translation: 我的鞋底都断了。

examples.text: I'm having my shoes soled and heeled.
examples.translation: 我要叫人给鞋子换鞋底和鞋跟。

examples.text: He often went out solely at night.
examples.translation: 他晚上经常独自外出。

examples.text: You are solely responsible for the job.
examples.translation: 这件工作由你单独负责。

examples.text: I did it solely for his sake.
examples.translation: 我完全为了他才做那件事。

examples.text: He was actuated solely by greed.
examples.translation: 他完全是受了贪欲的驱使。

examples.text: Our quality is based solely on our sales samples.
examples.translation: 我们的质量完全以货样为准。

examples.translation: 调查这些事情使我大吃一惊，我发现原来这完全是我的错。

examples.translation: 仪式在庄严的气氛中进行。

examples.translation: 他表情严肃地望着她。

examples.text: Her solemn face told them that the news was bad.
examples.translation: 她严肃的表情告诉他们那是坏消息。

examples.translation: 就职典礼是一件隆重的大事。

examples.translation: 就要举行隆重的启用仪式了。

examples.translation: 有时庄重的发言会使宴会变得严肃起来。

meanings.meaning: 固体的；实心的；结实的；可靠的

examples.text: Ice is water in solid state.
examples.translation: 冰是水的固体状态。

examples.text: In fact, it was originally a solid rock.
examples.translation: 其实,这本来是实心的岩石。

examples.translation: 你应该提供有说服力的证据来证明你的观点。

examples.translation: 水结冰时便变成固体。

examples.translation: 立方体是个立体图形。

examples.translation: 可溶解的金属氢氧化合物都是碱。

examples.translation: 后续的除髓工序可以继续除去可溶解的和粘附牢固的蔗髓。

meanings.meaning: 解决办法；解答；溶液；溶解；设计

examples.text: He reasoned out a solution to the problem.
examples.translation: 他经过推断,找出了解决问题的办法。

examples.text: We haven't found the solution yet, but I'm sure we're on the right track.
examples.translation: 我们还没有找到解决办法，但我肯定我们的思路是对的。

examples.translation: 我刚想起如何解答这个问题。

examples.text: What color is copper sulphate solution?
examples.translation: 硫酸铜溶液是什么颜色？

examples.text: Litmus paper can be used as an indicator of the presence of acid in a solution.
examples.translation: 石蕊试纸可用以测试溶液是否含酸。

examples.text: The water made a quick solution of the tablet.
examples.translation: 这个药片很快就被水溶解了。

examples.translation: 在最初的滴定溶液里，已知的是卡尔费休试剂，二氧化硫和碘溶解在吡啶和甲醇中。

examples.translation: 这个问题太难,我解决不了。

examples.translation: 你能解答那个难题真是聪明。

examples.translation: 她参加某报纸举办的比赛获胜。

examples.translation: 树丛里有些冰。

examples.translation: 今天上午有你的邮件。

examples.translation: 有些小孩儿在公园里玩儿.

examples.translation: 说他是最好的那是夸大其词,但他是蛮好的。

examples.translation: 来了三十人 有些人一直呆到最后

examples.translation: 我们必须以某种方式把损失的时间补上。

examples.translation: 我希望我能以某种方式报答您的好意。

examples.translation: 他原本能按预定进度做完这件事的，但不知怎地却落后了。

examples.translation: 那个婴儿不知为什么大哭起来。

examples.translation: 照相机拍到了某人突然跳入那房子的画面。

examples.translation: 有人想毒杀我们的狗。

examples.translation: 我好像听到有人在敲门。

examples.text: I'll try and rustle you up something to eat.
examples.translation: 我设法给你弄点吃的。

examples.translation: 我能很准确地预测某事。

examples.text: He thinks he's something.
examples.translation: 他认为他了不起。

examples.translation: 他撞上了一棵树或其他什么东西。

examples.translation: 这东西既象瓦罐又象花瓶。

examples.translation: 她三十几岁。

examples.translation: 这包裹有十磅左右。

examples.translation: 他有点象他哥哥。

examples.translation: 昨晚雨下得很大。

examples.translation: 老人有时爱忘事。

examples.translation: 有时这个病人疼得哭起来。

examples.translation: 他的辩解多少有点过火。

examples.translation: 她的专长是古希腊诗。

examples.translation: 烤牛排是他的拿手好菜。

examples.translation: 包饺子是他的拿手好戏。

examples.translation: "科幻小说不能简单地看成是供消遣的，而实际上它给读者展示更深刻的内容。"

examples.translation: 这是我特意为你生日而做的。

examples.translation: 我特别地以红糖代替白糖做了这个蛋糕。

examples.text: This machine has been specially adapted for underwater use.
examples.translation: 这机器是为水下使用而特别改装的。

examples.text: These goats are specially bred for their wool.
examples.translation: 这些山羊是专为剪取羊毛而饲养的。

examples.text: He came here specially to get a grammar book .
examples.translation: 他来这儿是专门为买到一本语法书。

examples.text: My dad was specially adroit at making small hand-painted ornaments.
examples.translation: 我爸爸尤其擅长做些手工上色的小装饰品。

meanings.meaning: 明确的；特殊的；具有特效的

examples.text: He gave us very specific instructions.
examples.translation: 他给我们做了非常明确的指示。

examples.text: This tells you that there is a specific distinction between the right and the wrong.
examples.translation: 这件事告诉你是与非是有明确的区别的。

examples.translation: 让我们看一看三个特殊的令人关切的领域。

examples.text: There is no specific remedy for the malady.
examples.translation: 没有医治这种病的特效药。

examples.text: He never talked in specifics about his work.
examples.translation: 他从不谈论有关自己工作的详情。

examples.text: The specifics of this data are specified via a schema in the process definition.
examples.translation: 该数据的特性是由过程定义模式决定的。

examples.text: Please specify when you will be at home tomorrow.
examples.translation: 请确切说明你明天何时会在家。

examples.text: Also, you might have to specify the user name and password.
examples.translation: 另外,您可能还需要指定用户名和密码。

examples.translation: 请阐述下这个项目的整个过程。

examples.text: This specimen is richly variegated in colour.
examples.translation: 这件标本上有很多颜色。

examples.text: Arthur brought out his specimen box.
examples.translation: 亚瑟拿出了他的标本箱。

examples.text: He is still a fine specimen of health.
examples.translation: 他仍是健康的典范。

meanings.meaning: 景象；场面；奇观；壮观；公开展示；表相，假相

examples.text: The sunrise was a splendid spectacle.
examples.translation: 日出是个壮观的景象。

examples.text: The celebrations provided a magnificent spectacle.
examples.translation: 庆祝活动呈现一派宏伟的景象。

examples.text: The carnival parade was a magnificent spectacle.
examples.translation: 狂欢节游行场面热烈，蔚为大观。

examples.text: The children took in the spectacle open-mouthed.
examples.translation: 孩子们张着嘴注视精彩表演。

examples.text: The Red Beach is a spectacle of nature.
examples.translation: 特色天成的自然奇观红海滩。

examples.text: The crowd was dazzled by the spectacle.
examples.translation: 人群被这一奇观弄得眼花缭乱。

examples.translation: 一定要留一天给不能错过美的景米尔福德峡湾，它位于新西兰腹地纯自然而壮观的峡湾地区。

examples.text: Congress is keen to avoid the spectacle of sending government workers home.
examples.translation: 国会很想避免把政府职员遣送回家的公开展示。

examples.text: I can't see things through your spectacles.
examples.translation: 我和你的看法不同。

examples.text: The old man put on his spectacles and started reading.
examples.translation: 老人戴上眼镜开始看书。

meanings.meaning: 演说；演讲；言语；语言能力

examples.text: The mayor made a speech at the opening.
examples.translation: 市长在开幕式上发表了演说。

examples.text: The speaker will soon wind up his speech.
examples.translation: 演说者就要结束他的讲话了。

examples.text: I had to give a speech to the press club.
examples.translation: 我得向记者俱乐部发表演说。

examples.text: He closed his speech with a funny joke.
examples.translation: 他用一则有趣的笑话结束了演讲。

examples.text: We express our thoughts by speech.
examples.translation: 我们用言语表达思想。

examples.text: He had lost the power of speech.
examples.translation: 他丧失了语言能力。

examples.text: Only human beings are capable of speech.
examples.translation: 只有人类才具有说话的能力。

examples.text: The police are advising motorists to reduce speed because of the fog.
examples.translation: 由于有雾，警察告诫驾车者减慢速度。

examples.text: This plane can reach speeds in excess of 1000 kilometers an hour.
examples.translation: 这架飞机可以达到每小时一千公里以上的速度。

examples.text: She finished typewriting the letter at speed.
examples.translation: 她迅速打好那封信。

examples.text: All this must be done at very great speed.
examples.translation: 这一切都需要非常迅速地干完。

examples.text: The train soon speeded up.
examples.translation: 火车不久就加快了速度。

examples.text: We'd better speed up if we want to get there in time.
examples.translation: 如果我们想准时到达那里，我们最好加快速度。

examples.text: The holidays simply sped by.
examples.translation: 假期简直是一晃而过。

meanings.meaning: 拼写；拼成；导致；暂时代替

examples.text: I don't know how to spell your name.
examples.translation: 我不会拼写你的名字。

examples.text: Can you spell the word" metropolis"?
examples.translation: 你会拼写“metropolis”这个词吗?

examples.text: Her writing is neat, but she can't spell.
examples.translation: 她的书写很工整，但是她不会拼写。

examples.text: Put them all together, and they spell MOTHER.
examples.translation: 把它们拼在一起

examples.text: C-A-T spells cat.
examples.translation: C-A-T拼成cat。

examples.text: I'd better go spell Mitch for a couple of hours.
examples.translation: 我最好代替米奇几个小时。

examples.text: The witch put the princess under a spell, and she fell asleep for ten years.
examples.translation: 这女巫使公主中了巫术，沉睡了十年。

examples.text: Can you feel the mysterious spell of music?
examples.translation: 你能感受到音乐的神奇魔力吗？

examples.text: After a short spell in hospital she was soon back at work.
examples.translation: 她在医院住了一段时间后，很快又回来上班了。

examples.text: It looks as if we were in for a cold spell.
examples.translation: 看样子要过一段寒潮天气。

examples.text: She had a spell of dizziness, but soon pulled out of it.
examples.translation: 她感到一阵头晕，但不一会儿就好了。

examples.text: It says the spell will last another six days.
examples.translation: 据说轮班还要持续6天。

meanings.meaning: 花费；浪费；度过；用尽（气力等）

examples.text: The average spend on higher education was 55 pounds per head.
examples.translation: 用于高等教育的平均支出是每人55英镑。

examples.text: The new law will put a lid on government spend.
examples.translation: 新法律将限制政府开支。

examples.text: The time I spend in commuting every day adds up to three hours.
examples.translation: 我每天上下班乘车花费的时间加起来有3个小时。

examples.text: You really shouldn't spend so much effort on it.
examples.translation: 你真不该在这件事上花费这么大的精力。

examples.text: We should not spend our fortune.
examples.translation: 我们不能浪费钱财。

examples.text: How do you spend your spare time?
examples.translation: 你业余时间怎么打发？

examples.text: Cowboys spend most of their time out of doors.
examples.translation: 牛仔大部分时间都是在户外度过的。

examples.text: It belongs to the ideological sphere.
examples.translation: 这属于意识形态范围。

examples.text: The scientist is distinguished in many spheres of knowledge.
examples.translation: 这位科学家在许多知识领域中都是杰出的。

examples.text: Suddenly, out in the night sky, a bright sphere flashed into view.
examples.translation: 突然，外面的夜空上有一个闪光的球映入眼帘。

examples.text: The earth is an oblate sphere.
examples.translation: 地球是一扁圆球体。

examples.text: The earth, sun and moon are spheres.
examples.translation: 地球、太阳和月亮都是天体。

meanings.meaning: 蜘蛛；十字叉；三脚架；长柄平底锅

examples.text: The spider can catch insects by cobweb.
examples.translation: 蜘蛛能用蜘蛛网抓住昆虫。

examples.translation: 小女孩认为蜘蛛是一种可怕的生物。

examples.translation: 其主要部件包括十字轴、万向节叉以及滚针轴承等。

meanings.meaning: 溢出；洒；使 ... 流出；泄漏

examples.text: The coffee is so full that it might spill over.
examples.translation: 咖啡太满可能会溢出来。

examples.text: Put the cap back on the bottle, otherwise the juice will spill.
examples.translation: 把瓶盖儿盖好，要不汁液就洒出来了。

examples.translation: 注意一滴药也不要洒。

examples.translation: 桶的摇晃使一些牛奶溢了出来。

examples.translation: 他威胁要将他所知道的事情向警察告发。

examples.text: Mecke couldn't bring himself to spill the beans.
examples.translation: 默克不能让他自己泄露秘密。

examples.translation: 石油的溢泄危及成千上万的鸟儿。

examples.translation: 侍者应懂得如何处理液体外溢。

examples.translation: 他不想看到任何美国人流血牺牲。

examples.text: My sister can spin on her toes like a dancer.
examples.translation: 我妹妹能像舞者一样踮着脚尖旋转。

examples.text: The motorcycles were spinning along at full speed.
examples.translation: 摩托车正全速疾驰。

examples.text: Mother used to spin her own yarn.
examples.translation: 母亲过去一直是自己纺纱的。

examples.text: In spring, they spin their cocoons.
examples.translation: 到了春天，它们才吐丝结茧。

examples.text: My head began to spin after three glasses of wine.
examples.translation: 三杯酒落肚，我的头开始发晕了。

examples.text: Before the invention of spin technology, zoic fur were mainly material.
examples.translation: 在纺织技术尚未发明之前，动物的毛皮是人们服装的主要材料。

examples.text: The pitcher gave a spin to the ball.
examples.translation: 投手使球旋转。

examples.text: I've been in a real spin all morning.
examples.translation: 我整个上午都晕头转向的。

examples.text: Let's go for a spin in my new car.
examples.translation: 坐我的新汽车兜一圈吧。

examples.translation: 他富有为公众服务的精神。

examples.translation: 如果我们要克服困难，我们就要有进取精神。

examples.text: Now the rat of Panic was gnawing at Byron's spirit.
examples.translation: 如今恐慌正象耗子一样在啃啮拜伦的心灵。

examples.text: Music lifted up the listening spirit.
examples.translation: 音乐净化升华了倾听它的心灵。

examples.text: It will evaporate like a spirit.
examples.translation: 它将来总要像幽灵一样化成云烟。

examples.text: They believe that his spirit lives on after death.
examples.translation: 他们相信他死后灵魂还活着。

meanings.meaning: 精神的；心灵的；与上帝有关的

examples.text: Many young people could not resist the spiritual pollution.
examples.translation: 很多年轻人不能抵制精神污染。

examples.text: I care more about the spiritual life than the substantial life.
examples.translation: 和物质生活相比，我更注重精神生活。

examples.translation: 修道士们因不讲授有关心灵的道理而受到指责。

examples.translation: 玛丽喊叫时唾沫四溅。

examples.translation: 这孩子长得活象他父亲。

examples.text: I have a friend who is the dead spit of you.
examples.translation: 我有个朋友长得与你像极了。

examples.translation: 这辆汽车需要擦洗一下。

examples.translation: 那些男孩子向火车窗外吐口水。

examples.translation: 在公共场合随便吐痰是不礼貌的。

examples.translation: 保姆叫孩子把果核吐出来。

examples.translation: 婴儿打嗝时总会吐出一点东西来。

examples.translation: 她恼怒得几乎无法骂出那句充满恨意的话来。

examples.text: It's not raining heavily any more, but it's still spitting a bit.
examples.translation: 大雨已经停了，但是还在飘著小雨。

examples.translation: 把羊肉叉在这根棍子上，在火上翻烤。

examples.text: There was splash in the pond, and a big goldfish bobbed up.
examples.translation: 水池里扑通一声，一条大金鱼窜了起来。

examples.text: He jumped into the water with a splash.
examples.translation: 他噗通一声跳进水里。

examples.text: There's a splash of paint on the white wall.
examples.translation: 白墙上溅上了一片油漆。

examples.text: He achieved a perfectly clean entry,and there is almost no splash.
examples.translation: 他的入水非常漂亮，几乎没有溅起水花。

examples.text: There are some splashes of mud on your trousers.
examples.translation: 你的裤子上溅有泥浆。

examples.text: The princess made quite a splash in Australia.
examples.translation: 公主在澳洲引起了轰动。

examples.text: This's the moive that made a splash in that time.
examples.translation: 这就是那部轰动一时的电影。

examples.text: He poured in a generous splash of rye.
examples.translation: 他搀入了相当多的黑麦威士忌酒。

examples.text: Just a splash of milk in my coffee, please.
examples.translation: 请在我的咖啡里稍为加点儿牛奶。

examples.text: The boys always splash about in rainwater.
examples.translation: 孩子们总是在雨水里玩耍。

examples.text: The waves splashed on the beach.
examples.translation: 波浪飞溅到海滩上。

examples.text: The story was splashed across the front page of the newspaper.
examples.translation: 这篇报道刊登在报纸头版显著位置。

meanings.meaning: 极好的；辉煌的；壮观的；杰出的

examples.translation: 打乒乓球是极好的运动。

examples.text: My kid sister has a splendid memory.
examples.translation: 我小妹记忆力极好。

examples.text: We won another splendid victory.
examples.translation: 我们又赢得了辉煌的胜利。

examples.text: The royal couple appeared in splendid array.
examples.translation: 王室伉俪身穿盛装出现。

examples.text: You're all doing a splendid job; keep up the good work!
examples.translation: 你们干得都很出色，要坚持下去！

examples.text: Our team gave a splendid account of themselves to win the match.
examples.translation: 我们队表现出色，赢了那场比赛。

examples.translation: 该党分裂成若干小派系。

examples.translation: 那场选举使工党分裂了。

examples.translation: 她按四人一组把全班分成若干小组。

examples.translation: 箭把苹果分成两半。

examples.translation: 我的工作生活可以分成三个主要部分。

examples.translation: 我室友和我每个月都会分摊帐单。

examples.translation: 他们两人分担了宴会的费用。

examples.translation: 他们俩结婚1年后就分离了。

examples.translation: 约翰刚刚跟女朋友吹了。

examples.translation: 我那时正在后院劈柴。

examples.translation: 你的大衣接缝处裂开了。

examples.translation: 在高温下木质地板裂开了。

examples.translation: 他一弯腰就把裤裆裂开了。

examples.translation: 霜冻使岩石裂了一条缝。

examples.translation: 人行道上的裂缝越来越大了。

examples.translation: 有关政策的争论导致了党内的分裂。

examples.translation: 每个合伙人得到一份利润。

examples.translation: 溺爱的母亲可能会宠坏她的孩子。

examples.translation: 这个孩子被他的爷爷给惯坏了。

examples.translation: 孩子们不断吵架，破坏了我们的假期。

examples.translation: 他往汤里放盐太多，把汤给糟蹋了。

examples.translation: 天热肉会很快地变得腐坏的。

examples.translation: 侵略者所到之处无不洗劫一空。

meanings.meaning: 用海绵擦拭；吸收掉；抹掉

examples.translation: 海绵将书桌上的水吸了进去。

examples.translation: 那孩子吸收新知识像海绵似的。

examples.translation: 洗热水澡时我喜欢用海绵擦洗全身。

examples.translation: 用海绵擦去车上的污泥。

examples.translation: 罗勃特·布朗先生被宣布为赞助人。

examples.translation: 有个富有的赞助人慷慨捐赠来解救我们。

examples.translation: 谁是这个研究项目的发起人?

examples.translation: 项目主办方在最需要他们的时候退出了。

examples.text: The senator announced that he would sponsor the health care plan.
examples.translation: 这位参议员宣布他将发起这一保健计划。

meanings.meaning: 自发的，自然的，本能的；自然产生的

examples.text: He is spontaneous to offer help.
examples.translation: 他主动提供帮助。

examples.text: It is a spontaneous cheer from the crowd.
examples.translation: 那是群众自发的喝彩。

examples.text: The spontaneous applause cut the singer short.
examples.translation: 自发的掌声打断了歌唱家的演唱。

examples.text: The eruption of volcanoes is spontaneous.
examples.translation: 火山爆发是自然产生的。

examples.text: The spontaneous combustion of the oil-soaked rags caused the barn to catch fire.
examples.translation: 油布碎片的自燃使谷仓起火。

examples.text: The spoon has been rusty from disuse.
examples.translation: 汤匙因弃置不用而生锈了。

examples.text: His soup spoon dropped onto the ground.
examples.translation: 他的汤勺掉到了地上。

examples.text: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
examples.translation: 她生来富贵。

examples.text: You need a spoon to beat the mixture smooth.
examples.translation: 你需要用一把调羹来搅均混合液。

examples.text: He spooned up several cakes of cube sugar and stuffed them into his mouth.
examples.translation: 他舀起了几块方糖,然后把它们全都塞进了嘴里。

examples.text: We think he is an outstanding sportsman.
examples.translation: 我们认为他是一名优秀的运动员。

examples.text: His favourite sportsman is golfer Ian Poulter.
examples.translation: 他最喜欢的运动员是高尔夫球员伊恩.

meanings.meaning: 地点；场所；职位；污点；斑点；少量；聚光灯；插播节目
（使）产生污渍；玷污；认出；用灯光照射

examples.text: This is the spot where the two trucks collided.
examples.translation: 这儿就是两辆卡车相撞的地点。

examples.text: That was the common spot for settling affairs of honour.
examples.translation: 那是他们通常决斗的场所。

examples.text: She found a spot as a secretary.
examples.translation: 她找到一个秘书的职位。

examples.text: He flicked at spot with handkerchief.
examples.translation: 他轻轻地用手帕拂拭污点。

examples.text: All apples with soft spots were rejected.
examples.translation: 所有带软斑点的苹果都被剔除。

examples.text: Billy is adjusting the spot above the stage.
examples.translation: 比利正在调试舞台上的聚光灯。

examples.text: There is a new spot at ten o'clock before the talk show.
examples.translation: 脱口秀前新增了一个十点开始的小节目。

examples.text: Several television stations gave spot coverage to the conference.
examples.translation: 好几家电视台对大会作了现场报导。

examples.text: His boots were spotted with mud.
examples.translation: 他的靴子上沾有泥渍。

examples.text: The scandal spotted his character.
examples.translation: 那件丑闻玷污了他的人格。

examples.text: She spotted her friend in the crowd.
examples.translation: 她在人群中认出了她的朋友。

examples.text: He sprayed paint on the wall.
examples.translation: 他把漆喷在墙上。

examples.text: We should spray some hairspray on your hair.
examples.translation: 我们应该喷些发胶在你的头发上。

examples.text: Please spray some water on the flower.
examples.translation: 请给花洒些水。

examples.text: The gangsters sprayed the car with machinegun bullets.
examples.translation: 匪徒们用机枪狂扫汽车。

examples.text: I've lost my throat spray.
examples.translation: 我的润喉剂喷筒丢了。

examples.text: This spray will exterminate the termites.
examples.translation: 这种喷剂能消灭白蚁。

examples.text: It's better to buy a non-aerosol spray.
examples.translation: 最好买一个非气溶胶喷雾器。

examples.text: We parked the car by the sea and it got covered with spray.
examples.translation: 我们把汽车停在海边，结果车上全是水沫。

examples.text: A cloud of fine spray came up from the waterfall.
examples.translation: 飞瀑溅起一片水雾。

meanings.meaning: 传播；展开；散布；铺开；伸展；涂撒
范围；传播；差额；幅度；盛宴

examples.text: The radio spread the news as soon as the accident happened .
examples.translation: 事故一发生,收音机就把这条消息传播出去了。

examples.text: The rumor was widely spread among the crowd.
examples.translation: 谣言在人群当中广泛地传播开来。

examples.text: She spread her wings and flew lightly down.
examples.translation: 她展开双翅轻轻飞下。

examples.text: I spread my arms as far apart as I could.
examples.translation: 我尽可能地将双臂伸展开。

examples.text: Who spread these rumours?
examples.translation: 谁散布的这些谣言?

examples.text: We spread a rug on the grass for the picnic.
examples.translation: 我们在草地上铺镇开毯子,准备野餐。

examples.text: He spread the map flat out on the floor.
examples.translation: 他把地图平铺在地上。

examples.text: Its branches spread far and wide.
examples.translation: 它的枝条向四面八方伸展开来。

examples.text: But Langston Hughes spread his creative wings even further.
examples.translation: 但蓝斯顿休斯将其创作羽翼更向外伸展。

examples.text: I spread butter on my toast.
examples.translation: 我将黄油涂在吐司上。

examples.text: She spread the bread with butter.
examples.translation: 她把黄油涂在面包上。

examples.text: The survey revealed a wide spread of opinion.
examples.translation: 调查结果表明各种意见差别很大.

examples.text: What can we do to prevent the spread of the disease?
examples.translation: 我们能做些什么来防止这种疾病的传播呢?

examples.text: Tv has become a more powerful vehicle for the spread of news.
examples.translation: 电视已成为影响力更大的传播消息的媒介。

examples.text: The wings of the bird have a 12-inch spread.
examples.translation: 这鸟的翼展有十二英寸。

examples.text: The spread of the prairies was indeed a startling sight.
examples.translation: 草原的浩瀚确是奇观。

examples.text: Our host had a fine spread waiting for us.
examples.translation: 我们的主人准备了盛宴在等我们。

meanings.meaning: 春天；春季；弹簧；弹力；跳；泉水；源头
跳；弹；快速站起；突然提出；触发捕捉器；(使)裂开；爆炸；释放；涌出；生长；出现；耸立；(风)开始吹

examples.text: Spring is here.
examples.translation: 春天来了。

examples.text: It can be quite windy there, especially in spring.
examples.translation: 那里有时容易刮风,特别在春季。

examples.text: When the box was opened, the spring jumped out.
examples.translation: 盒子一打开，弹簧就绷出来了。

examples.text: There is too much spring in this bed.
examples.translation: 这张床太有弹性。

examples.text: The cat made a spring at the mouse.
examples.translation: 猫向老鼠扑去。

examples.text: The spring water is cold and crystal-clear.
examples.translation: 泉水清冽。

examples.text: An ill marriage is a spring of ill fortune.
examples.translation: 不良的婚姻是恶运的来源。

examples.text: The cat crouched ready to spring.
examples.translation: 那猫躬起背准备跳。

examples.text: A clown will spring from the box.
examples.translation: 盒子里会弹出个小丑来。

examples.text: Spring to attention when the captain enters.
examples.translation: 上尉一进来，就要迅速立正站好。

examples.text: I hate to spring this on you at such short notice.
examples.translation: 很抱歉，向你突如其来提出这件事。

examples.text: Why should you spring my cricket bat?
examples.translation: 你干吗非弄弯我的板球拍呢?

examples.text: The barrel began to spring a leak.
examples.translation: 那个木桶开始破裂泄漏了。

examples.text: He'd only get a mouthpiece to spring him.
examples.translation: 他只要找个辩护律师,就能把他释放出来。

examples.text: Out of the sluice springs an inexhaustible supply of water.
examples.translation: 水从水闸中源源流出。

examples.text: The wheat is beginning to spring up.
examples.translation: 小麦正开始迅速生长。

examples.text: The northwest wind will spring up this evening.
examples.translation: 今天傍晚将开始刮西北风。

examples.text: At springtime this river always overruns.
examples.translation: 每到春天这条河总会泛滥。

examples.text: It's springtime, and nature is coming back to life!
examples.translation: 春天到了，大自然渐渐苏醒了！

examples.text: He sprinkled vinegar on his fish and chips.
examples.translation: 他把醋洒在鱼和薯条上。

examples.text: He wanted to tell her to sprinkle the floor.
examples.translation: 他想告诉她在地上洒点水。

examples.text: Sprinkle a little salt on the rice.
examples.translation: 在米饭上撒点盐。

examples.text: Grate the cheese and sprinkle it over the tomatoes.
examples.translation: 把干酪磨碎撒在西红柿上。

examples.text: It sprinkled that evening.
examples.translation: 那天晚上下了小雨。

examples.text: We covered the cakes with chocolate sprinkles.
examples.translation: 我们给蛋糕洒上巧克力末。

examples.text: She put a sprinkle of sugar on the top of her cake.
examples.translation: 她在蛋糕上洒了一点糖。

examples.text: She went to London on the spur of the moment.
examples.translation: 她一时兴起就到伦敦去了。

examples.text: International competition was a spur to modernization.
examples.translation: 国际竞争是实现现代化的动力。

examples.text: The thought of the prize was the spur for the team.
examples.translation: 夺取锦标的想法是该队的动力。

examples.text: What spurred her to do that?
examples.translation: 是什么促使她那么干的？

examples.text: This book is a spur to the child's imagination.
examples.translation: 这本书能促进孩子的想象力。

examples.text: Several strong targets have been set to spur action and guide the way forward.
examples.translation: 已经制订了若干强大的目标来促进行动和指导我们前进的道路。

examples.text: The spy was expelled from the realm.
examples.translation: 这名间谍被驱逐出境。

examples.text: This evidence reinforces my view that he is a spy.
examples.translation: 这个证据证实了我认为他是间谍的这一看法。

examples.text: The scout was sent to spy out the land.
examples.translation: 侦探被派出去秘密侦察高地去了。

examples.text: She hired a detective to spy on her husband.
examples.translation: 她雇了一个侦探来监视她丈夫。

examples.text: They read the histories and talk about the weapons and spy tools.
examples.translation: 他们阅读历史记录，谈论武器和侦察工具。

examples.text: The scout was sent to spy out the land.
examples.translation: 侦探被派出去秘密侦察高地去了。

examples.text: It's wrong to spy into people's affairs.
examples.translation: 刺探他人的私事是错误的。

examples.text: He is paid by the police to spy on other students.
examples.translation: 警察收买他去监视其他学生。

examples.text: He sent out a party to spy the enemy.
examples.translation: 他派出一个小分队暗中监视敌人的行动。

examples.text: How much did you pay the man to spy on me?
examples.translation: 你付那人多少钱来监视我?

examples.text: The Cassini orbiter may be able to spy some of the hidden puppeteers.
examples.translation: 卡西尼太空船也许能够找出这些幕后的操纵者。

examples.text: I do spy some marks of love in her.
examples.translation: 我真的从她脸上看出几分爱我的意思来了。

meanings.meaning: 正方形；广场；街区；平方；直角尺；古板的人
正方形的；规矩的；结实的；公正的；断然的
一致；结清；收买；使 ... 成方形；使成平方；调整
成直角；直接的；正方形地

examples.text: The little girl drew a square on the paper.
examples.translation: 小女孩在纸上画了一个正方形。

examples.text: Everybody goes to this vast square in the evening.
examples.translation: 每天傍晚，人人都上这宽阔的广场上来。

examples.text: The crowds in the square were elated by the news.
examples.translation: 这消息使广场上的人群欢欣鼓舞。

examples.text: 25 is a perfect square of 5.
examples.translation: 25是5的完全平方。

examples.text: The carpenter who built this room must have lost his square.
examples.translation: 建这座房子的人一定丢了他的直角尺。

examples.text: I'm basically a bit of a square.
examples.translation: 我是比较古板的。

examples.text: A handkerchief is usually square.
examples.translation: 手帕通常是正方形的。

examples.text: A strong square jaw is a sign of firm character.
examples.translation: 强健的方颚是性格坚定的象征。

examples.text: The mayor is a man of square frame.
examples.translation: 市长是个体格魁梧的人。

examples.text: I ask no odds, I just want you to be fair and square.
examples.translation: 我不要求特殊照顾,我只要求您公正。

examples.text: They offered to buy his farm but met a square refusal.
examples.translation: 他们出价要买他的农场，但遭到断然拒绝。

examples.text: His conduct does not square with his words.
examples.translation: 他言行不一致。

examples.text: I must square my account with you.
examples.translation: 我必须和你结清我的帐目。

examples.text: There is only one person besides ourselves who knows anything about this affair, and it shouldn't be difficult to square him.
examples.translation: 除了我们自己,只有一个人知道这件事,收买他应该不难。

examples.text: Square the page off with your ruler.
examples.translation: 用尺在这页纸上打上方格。

examples.text: 3 squared is 9.
examples.translation: 3的平方是9。

examples.text: Dear, you have to square your way to eat.
examples.translation: 亲爱的，你得改一下你吃饭的姿势。

examples.text: The road turned square to the left.
examples.translation: 这条路成直角向左转去。

meanings.meaning: 挤压；塞进；压榨；设法腾出
挤压；少量；拥挤；严控；财政困难

examples.text: Kara squeezed the bottle, and the water rushed out.
examples.translation: 卡拉挤压着那个瓶子,水一下子喷了出来。

examples.text: It took some ingenuity to squeeze all the furniture into the little room.
examples.translation: 把全部家具都塞进那个小房间是很费了一番心思的。

examples.text: Supermarkets are accused of squeezing both customers and suppliers.
examples.translation: 超市因压榨顾客和供货商而遭到指控。

examples.text: I can squeeze a meeting in early tomorrow morning.
examples.translation: 我可以在明天清早挤出时间开个会。

examples.text: He gave my hand a gentle squeeze.
examples.translation: 他握着我的手,轻轻捏了捏。

examples.text: The host put a squeeze of lemon in my drink.
examples.translation: 主人往我的饮料中挤了少量柠檬汁。

examples.text: We managed to get all the luggage into the car but it was a tight squeeze.
examples.translation: 我们总算把行李都塞进汽车里了，不过挤得要命。

examples.text: She's just lost her job, so they're really feeling the squeeze.
examples.translation: 她刚失了业，这下他们真正感到艰难了。

examples.text: The squirrel is a lovely small animal.
examples.translation: 松鼠是一种可爱的小动物。

examples.text: The squirrel hoards up nuts for the winter.
examples.translation: 松鼠储藏坚果以防冬天。

examples.text: Nervous householders continue to squirrel more money away in the banks.
examples.translation: 不安的居民持续不断地把更多钱存入银行里。

examples.text: Good friends stab you in the front.
examples.translation: 当面刺痛你的是你的好朋友。

examples.text: He stabbed at the earth with his stick.
examples.translation: 他拿手杖戳著地。

examples.text: She stabbed at the air with her finger to emphasize what she was saying.
examples.translation: 她手指一戳一戳的，强调她说的话。

examples.text: He stabbed the meat with his fork/stabbed his fork into the meat.
examples.translation: 他用叉子叉肉。

examples.text: She stabbed him in the leg with a kitchen knife.
examples.translation: 她拿菜刀捅伤了他的腿。

examples.text: The hunter made a stab at the wolf, but missed.
examples.translation: 猎人向狼刺去，但没有刺中。

examples.text: A stab of misgiving shot through Val.
examples.translation: 一阵惶惑象匕首一样戳了法尔一下。

examples.text: A sudden stab of pain twisted him up.
examples.translation: 一阵突然的刺痛使他弯下身去。

examples.text: You'll never mend your car like that let me have a stab at it.
examples.translation: 你这样怎么能修好汽车--让我来试试吧。

examples.text: The government has taken a measure to maintain the stability of prices.
examples.translation: 政府已经采取了措施以确保物价稳定。

examples.text: The question of stability of an equilibrium is very important.
examples.translation: 一个平衡点的稳定性问题是非常重要的。

examples.text: Markets are flourishing and prices are stable.
examples.translation: 市场繁荣, 物价稳定。

examples.text: In order that our country could flourish and achieve its own goals, a stable environment within the country is definitely not dispensable.
examples.translation: 国家要发展，要实现自己的目标，这是必不可少的条件，就是要国内有安定的环境。

examples.text: The Sunnis hold a majority in four provinces and any government will have to respect them if they wish to administer a stable state.
examples.translation: 逊尼派在四个省份里都是多数群体，而任何政府只要想管理一个安定的国家，就不得不对他们予以尊重。

examples.text: He is a bit neurotic, but his wife is a very stable person.
examples.translation: 他有点神经质，但他的妻子是一个非常稳重的人。

examples.text: The horse in the stable has broken out.
examples.translation: 马厩里的那匹马跑了。

examples.text: Who opened the stable door?
examples.translation: 谁打开了马房的门？

examples.text: He has a whole stable of informers working for him.
examples.translation: 他有一群告密者为他效劳。

examples.text: Where do you stable your pony?
examples.translation: 你那匹矮种马养在哪儿?（《牛津高阶英汉双解词典》）

meanings.meaning: 堆；一大堆；【计】存储栈；迭式存储器，栈式存储器；存储栈数据

examples.text: The grain has gone mouldy in the stack.
examples.translation: 垛里的谷子发霉了。

examples.text: He placed his books in a neat stack.
examples.translation: 他把书整整齐齐放成一堆。

examples.text: I've got stacks of work to do.
examples.translation: 我有一大堆活儿要做。

examples.text: There is a stack of dishes to be washed in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 厨房里还有一大堆盘子要洗。

examples.text: Please stack the materials up here.
examples.translation: 请把材料堆在这里。

examples.text: Traffic was stacked up for miles because of the accident.
examples.translation: 车祸引起了交通堵塞，车辆排起的长龙有好几里长。

examples.text: The whole garden was stacked with bricks.
examples.translation: 园子里堆满了砖。

examples.text: The crowds drifted away from the stadium.
examples.translation: 人群慢慢从体育场散去。

examples.text: Keep on past the church; the stadium is about half a mile further on.
examples.translation: 一直向前走过了教堂，约莫半英里就是体育场。

examples.text: We will go to the stadium to watch a football match.
examples.translation: 我们将去体育场观看足球比赛。

examples.text: The takings at the football stadium has fallen off.
examples.translation: 足球运动场的收入减少了。

examples.text: Supporters crowded through the gates into the stadium.
examples.translation: 来捧场的人挤过大门，涌入运动场。

examples.text: (1) I find the hotel staff particularly courteous.
examples.translation: (1) 我发现饭店员工特别谦恭有礼。

examples.text: She stood alone on the enormous stage.
examples.translation: 她孤零零地站在巨大的舞台上。

examples.text: He quitted the stage of politics.
examples.translation: 他退出了政治舞台。

examples.translation: 小说常常改编为戏剧。

examples.translation: 这疾病仍然在初发阶段。

examples.text: Negotiations were at a crucial stage.
examples.translation: 谈判正处于一个关键的阶段。

examples.text: The pay increase will be introduced in stages.
examples.translation: 工资的提高将分步进行。

examples.text: She did the first stage of the trip by train.
examples.translation: 她行程的第一段是乘火车的。

examples.translation: 他们决定举行总罢工。

examples.text: They were going to stage a large-scale money collecting.
examples.translation: 他们筹划举办一个大型募捐活动。

examples.translation: 退役五年之后，他又复出国际网坛。

examples.text: The stain on his shirt is difficult to clean off.
examples.translation: 他衬衣上的污点很难去除掉。

examples.text: It will remain an indelible stain on his memory.
examples.translation: 这将成为他记忆中一个不可磨灭的污点。

examples.translation: 这种人是人类的耻辱。

examples.text: There isn't a stain on her reputation.
examples.translation: 她的名誉没有半点瑕疵。

examples.translation: 木材着色剂是美式涂装中极其重要的涂装材料。

examples.translation: 给这张桌子上色，我得买多少颜料？

examples.text: These carpets won't stain easily.
examples.translation: 这些地毯不易弄脏。

examples.text: He stained the family honor.
examples.translation: 他玷污了家族的荣誉。

examples.text: The child was sitting on the bottom stair.
